title: The Transmission Mechanism of Credit Support Policies in the Euro Area
affiliations: , Independent and University of Antwerp

detail.title: The Transmission Mechanism of Credit Support Policies in the Euro Area

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBB WP 302
publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use an original monthly dataset of 131 individual euro area banks to examine the e¤ectiveness and transmission mechanism of the Eurosystem's credit support policies since the start of the crisis. First, we show that these policies have indeed been succesful in stimulating the credit ‡ow of banks to the private sector. Second, we …nd support for the "bank lending view" of monetary transmission. Speci…cally, the policies have had a greater impact on loan supply of banks that are more constrained to obtain unsecured external funding, i.e. small banks (size e¤ ect), banks with less liquid balance sheets (liquidity e¤ ect), banks that depend more on wholesale funding (retail e¤ ect) and low-capitalized banks (capital e¤ ect). The role of bank capital is, however, ambiguous. Besides the above favorable direct e¤ect on loan supply, lower levels of bank capitalization at the same time mitigate the size, retail and liquidity e¤ects of the policies. The drag on the other channels has even been dominant during the sample period, i.e. better capitalized banks have on average responded more to the credit support policies of the Eurosystem as a result of more favourable size, retail and liquidity e¤ects.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用欧元区131家银行的月度数据，分析了欧洲央行信贷支持政策的有效性及传导机制。研究发现这些政策成功刺激了银行对私营部门的信贷流动，并支持"银行信贷观点"的货币政策传导机制。政策对获取无担保外部融资受限的银行（小型银行、流动性较差银行、依赖批发融资银行、资本充足率较低银行）影响更大，但银行资本的作用存在矛盾性。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行的信贷支持政策是否有效？其传导机制如何运作？特别是，这些政策如何通过银行特征（规模、流动性、融资结构、资本充足率）影响信贷供给？
AI.motivation: 金融危机后，欧洲央行实施了一系列信贷支持政策，但政策效果和传导机制尚不明确。理解这些政策如何通过银行体系传导至实体经济，对于评估政策有效性和未来政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"银行信贷观点"的货币政策传导理论，该理论强调货币政策通过影响银行信贷供给来影响实体经济。研究检验了银行特征（规模、流动性、融资结构、资本充足率）在政策传导中的作用。
AI.method: 使用131家欧元区银行的原始月度面板数据，采用实证分析方法检验信贷支持政策对银行信贷供给的影响，并分析银行特征（规模效应、流动性效应、零售效应、资本效应）的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 信贷支持政策成功刺激了银行对私营部门的信贷流动；2. 政策对获取无担保外部融资受限的银行影响更大：小型银行（规模效应）、流动性较差银行（流动性效应）、依赖批发融资银行（零售效应）、资本充足率较低银行（资本效应）；3. 银行资本作用存在矛盾：虽然资本充足率低直接促进信贷供给，但同时削弱了规模、零售和流动性效应，且这种削弱效应在研究期间占主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为"银行信贷观点"提供了实证支持；2. 揭示了银行特征在货币政策传导中的异质性作用；3. 发现了银行资本在政策传导中的双重作用（直接促进效应与间接削弱效应）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧洲央行信贷支持政策的有效性提供了证据；2. 揭示了政策传导的银行异质性，有助于政策制定者针对不同类型银行设计更有效的政策工具；3. 强调了银行资本充足率在政策传导中的复杂作用，对银行监管和资本要求政策有启示意义。

title: Government and Business Need To Approach Strategy Differently in a Turbulent World, As Reflected in Canada’s EV Experience
affiliations: and Sasin School of Management, Chulalongkorn University

detail.title: Government and Business Need To Approach Strategy Differently in a Turbulent World, As Reflected in Canada’s EV Experience
detail.abstract:
Strategies of governments and firms are anchored in specific expectations about the future in the form of assumptions, based on available data. During periods of transition, when past certainties are in question, the gap widens significantly between expectations and outcomes. Decision makers need to rigorously frame, assess, and monitor critical, often implicit assumptions of strategies and projects. We term this approach strategic assumptions analysis. 

In a highly uncertain world, widely different expectations can yield disparate but equally plausible strategy options. Evidence suggests that engaging in structured constructive

argumentation over alternative options incorporating very diﬀerent sets of assumptions, can greatly improve strategic decision-making. We term this approach dialectic planning.

The Electric Vehicle (EV) case in Canada provides an illustration of the strategy challenge, and how the suggested approaches can help strengthen strategic decisions to reduce the gap between expectations and outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出战略假设分析和辩证规划两种方法，帮助决策者在高度不确定的转型时期，通过系统性地审视和辩论不同假设来缩小期望与结果之间的差距，并以加拿大电动汽车案例进行说明。
AI.research_question: 在转型时期，当过去的确定性受到质疑时，如何通过系统性的方法来缩小战略期望与实际结果之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 在转型时期，基于过去数据的假设变得不可靠，导致期望与结果之间的差距显著扩大。决策者需要更严谨的方法来处理战略和项目中的关键假设，以应对高度不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略假设分析（Strategic Assumptions Analysis）和辩证规划（Dialectic Planning）构成了本文的理论框架。前者强调对战略假设的系统性审视，后者关注通过结构化辩论来评估不同假设下的战略选项。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性分析框架，并通过加拿大电动汽车（EV）案例进行说明性应用，展示所提方法如何帮助加强战略决策。
AI.findings: 在高度不确定的世界中，不同的期望可以产生不同但同样合理的战略选择。通过结构化、建设性的辩论来评估包含不同假设的替代选项，可以显著改善战略决策质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了战略假设分析和辩证规划两个概念框架，为在转型时期管理战略不确定性提供了理论工具，丰富了战略决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业决策者提供了具体的方法论工具，帮助他们在转型时期更有效地制定和评估战略，减少期望与结果之间的差距，特别是在加拿大电动汽车等复杂战略挑战中。

reference: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2025-07
title: Closing Multiple Sanction Loopholes
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance and Dresden University of Technology - Faculty of Economics and Business Management

detail.title: Closing Multiple Sanction Loopholes

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2025-07
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The enforcement of international sanctions is frequently undermined by multiple third-party sanction-breaking countries. This paper ex amines how a sanctioning country can optimally negotiate with several such loophole countries to close the enforcement gaps. We compare several sequential and simultaneous bargaining strategies. Suitably chosen sequencing, but also simultaneous negotiations under the Single-Undertaking Principle can minimize the cost to the sanctioning country by creating competitive pressure among the loophole countries. We find that, if the desire to make the sanctioning regime effective is sufficiently high, the ultimate goal of closing the sanction loopholes is achieved for all sequencing rules of ultimatum bargaining we consider. However, the equilibrium size and distribution of compensation among loophole countries differ. We characterize the optimal sequential strategy and the optimal simultaneous-offer strategy. Furthermore, for well-chosen negotiation strategies the sum of compensations paid to multiple loophole countries is lower than if there is only one loophole country.

AI.tldr: 本文研究制裁国如何与多个第三方制裁破坏国进行最优谈判以填补制裁漏洞。通过比较顺序和同时谈判策略，发现适当的谈判顺序和"单一承诺原则"下的同时谈判可以通过在漏洞国之间制造竞争压力来最小化制裁国成本。当制裁国对制裁机制有效性的需求足够高时，所有最后通牒谈判顺序都能实现关闭制裁漏洞的最终目标，但补偿规模和分配方式不同。
AI.research_question: 制裁国如何与多个第三方制裁破坏国进行最优谈判以填补制裁漏洞？
AI.motivation: 国际制裁的执行经常因多个第三方制裁破坏国的存在而受到削弱，这些国家制造了制裁漏洞。制裁国需要找到有效的方法与这些漏洞国谈判，以关闭执行缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论中的谈判理论、顺序谈判与同时谈判策略、最后通牒谈判、单一承诺原则、竞争压力理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，比较分析顺序谈判策略（包括不同顺序规则）和同时谈判策略（基于单一承诺原则），通过博弈论框架分析谈判均衡结果
AI.findings: 1. 适当的谈判顺序和单一承诺原则下的同时谈判可以通过在漏洞国之间制造竞争压力来最小化制裁国成本；2. 当制裁国对制裁机制有效性的需求足够高时，所有最后通牒谈判顺序都能实现关闭制裁漏洞的最终目标；3. 不同谈判策略下，补偿的规模和分配方式存在差异；4. 最优顺序策略和最优同时报价策略可以被特征化；5. 精心选择的谈判策略下，支付给多个漏洞国的补偿总额低于只有一个漏洞国的情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为国际制裁执行中的多边谈判问题提供了系统的理论框架；2. 比较了顺序谈判和同时谈判策略的优劣；3. 揭示了竞争压力在降低谈判成本中的作用机制；4. 特征化了最优谈判策略的条件和形式
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制裁国设计有效的谈判策略提供了具体指导；2. 展示了如何通过谈判顺序安排降低补偿成本；3. 为国际制裁执行的实际操作提供了理论依据；4. 帮助政策制定者理解多边谈判中的策略选择

title: Identifying Policy Regimes
affiliations: University of Cyprus - Department of Economics

detail.title: Identifying Policy Regimes
detail.abstract: This paper develops tests for equilibrium determinacy and for distinguishing monetary from fiscally active inflation regimes, without relying on DSGE-specific parameterizations. The analysis revisits a familiar critique: the endogeneity of inflation to unobserved structural disturbances, often viewed as an obstacle to identification. I show that, in a determinate rational-expectations equilibrium, this endogeneity allows recovery of the shocks, whereas under sunspot indeterminacy, shock recoverability fails. The reduced form used to recover the shocks nests all regimes, but the OLS estimator in standard policy-rule regressions behaves differently across regimes when the estimated shocks are included. These differences can be exploited to test for alternative regimes of inflation determination. An application to U.S. data suggests indeterminacy before 1979 and determinacy thereafter, with no strong evidence of a fiscally active regime.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了不依赖DSGE特定参数化的均衡确定性检验方法，用于区分货币主导与财政主导的通胀机制。研究发现，在确定性均衡中，通胀对未观测结构冲击的内生性允许恢复这些冲击，而在太阳黑子不确定性下则无法恢复。通过分析标准政策规则回归中OLS估计量的不同行为，可以检验通胀决定机制。对美国数据的应用表明，1979年前存在不确定性，之后为确定性，没有强烈证据支持财政主导机制。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖DSGE特定参数化的情况下，检验均衡确定性并区分货币主导与财政主导的通胀机制？
AI.motivation: 传统上，通胀对未观测结构冲击的内生性被视为识别障碍，但作者认为在确定性理性预期均衡中，这种内生性实际上允许恢复冲击，这为检验通胀决定机制提供了新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期均衡理论，确定性均衡与太阳黑子不确定性理论，货币主导与财政主导通胀机制理论，政策规则回归分析框架。
AI.method: 开发基于简化形式的检验方法，通过分析标准政策规则回归中OLS估计量在不同机制下的行为差异来检验通胀决定机制，不依赖DSGE特定参数化。
AI.findings: 在确定性均衡中，通胀的内生性允许恢复未观测结构冲击，而在太阳黑子不确定性下无法恢复。对美国数据的实证分析表明，1979年之前存在不确定性，之后为确定性，没有强烈证据支持财政主导机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 重新阐释了通胀内生性的作用：在确定性均衡中，内生性不是识别障碍而是恢复冲击的工具；2) 开发了不依赖DSGE参数化的均衡确定性检验方法；3) 提供了区分货币主导与财政主导通胀机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了检验通胀机制的工具；2) 对美国货币政策历史的实证分析为政策评估提供了新证据；3) 方法不依赖特定模型参数化，具有更广泛的适用性。

title: After Assad: US Sanctions, Israeli Security, and the Future of Syria
affiliations: University of Haifa

detail.title: After Assad: US Sanctions, Israeli Security, and the Future of Syria

publicationDetails.detailsText: Center for Governance and Markets Paper No. GDD10-2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Governance & Markets Paper Series

detail.abstract: Syria’s reintegration into the Arab League following the fall of the Assad regime was anticipated. What was not foreseen was the United States’ announcement regarding the lifting of sanctions on Syria’s new government nor the apparent absence of Israel from American regional policymaking during President Donald Trump’s visit to the Gulf states in May 2025. It is with Syria and Syria’s future, however, that American and Israeli interests converge, especially with regard to the lifting of sanctions. Syria is now in a state of economic and military weakness, marked by a profound dependence on foreign aid. This situation presents a historic opportunity to urge the country to undertake democratization processes and advance its integration into the July 2025 Abraham Accords, without conditioning this progress on an Israeli withdrawal from the Golan Heights. The character of the new Syrian regime will directly affect the security situation along Israel’s northern border as well as determine the extent of the United States’ influence in Syria. This policy brief provides an overview of these recent developments and offers suggestions on ways to move forward with an alternative sanctions policy toward Syria.

AI.tldr: 美国在特朗普2025年访问海湾国家期间宣布解除对叙利亚新政府的制裁，这为叙利亚民主化和融入亚伯拉罕协议创造了历史机遇，无需以以色列从戈兰高地撤军为条件。
AI.research_question: 在美国解除对叙利亚制裁的背景下，如何通过替代性制裁政策推动叙利亚民主化进程并促进其融入亚伯拉罕协议，同时保障以色列北部边境安全？
AI.motivation: 叙利亚政权更迭后重返阿拉伯联盟，美国意外宣布解除对叙利亚新政府制裁，且以色列在美国地区政策制定中明显缺席，这些发展为叙利亚未来创造了新的地缘政治机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治理论、制裁政策有效性理论、民主化进程理论、区域安全框架理论
AI.method: 政策简报分析，基于近期地缘政治发展的事件分析，结合叙利亚当前经济军事脆弱性和对外援助依赖的现状评估
AI.findings: 叙利亚目前处于经济和军事脆弱状态，严重依赖外援，这为促使其进行民主化并融入亚伯拉罕协议提供了历史性机会，无需以以色列从戈兰高地撤军为条件。新叙利亚政权的性质将直接影响以色列北部边境安全并决定美国在叙利亚的影响力程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在政权更迭后通过有条件制裁解除促进民主化的新框架，挑战了传统上以领土问题为先决条件的和平进程模式，为制裁政策作为民主化工具提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了针对叙利亚的替代性制裁政策建议，为美国决策者提供了推动叙利亚民主化、保障以色列边境安全、增强美国地区影响力的具体政策路径，同时为叙利亚融入区域经济和安全架构提供了操作方案。

reference: NBB WP 445
title: Nowcasting GDP Through the Lens of Economic States
affiliations: Ghent University, Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) - Faculty of Economic, Social and Political Sciences, Independent and National Bank of Belgium

detail.title: Nowcasting GDP Through the Lens of Economic States

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBB WP 445
publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Common sense tells that historical data are more informative for the estimation of today’s nowcasting models when observed in a similar economic state as today. We operationalise this intuition by proposing a state-based weighted estimation procedure of GDP nowcasting models, in which observations are weighted based on the similarity with the current economic state. For this end, we also construct new state variables for measuring the similarity of economic time periods using news data, in addition to traditional variables. We find that the state-based weighting of observations leads to economically significant nowcasting gains for predicting GDP growth in Belgium as compared to traditional unweighted approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于经济状态加权的GDP实时预测方法，通过新闻数据构建新的状态变量来衡量经济时期的相似性，相比传统不加权方法在比利时GDP增长预测中取得了显著改进。
AI.research_question: 如何利用经济状态相似性来改进GDP实时预测模型的准确性？
AI.motivation: 常识表明，与当前经济状态相似的历史数据对今天的实时预测模型更有信息价值，但传统方法未充分利用这一直觉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相似性加权的预测理论，经济状态依赖的预测模型，信息加权估计方法。
AI.method: 提出基于状态加权的GDP实时预测模型估计程序，使用新闻数据构建新的状态变量来衡量经济时期相似性，与传统变量结合，对观测值进行基于相似性的加权。
AI.findings: 基于状态加权的观测值方法相比传统不加权方法，在比利时GDP增长预测中取得了经济上显著的实时预测改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于经济状态相似性的加权预测理论框架，将新闻数据纳入状态变量构建，扩展了实时预测方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济分析师提供了更准确的GDP实时预测工具，特别是在经济状态变化时期，有助于及时决策。

title: The Economic Crisis in Mozambique: Structural Causes and Developmental Implications
affiliations: , RMIT University and La Trobe University and KL University

detail.title: The Economic Crisis in Mozambique: Structural Causes and Developmental Implications
detail.abstract: This study examines the structural causes and developmental implications of Mozambique's ongoing economic crisis, arguing that the country's predicament reflects deep-seated systemic weaknesses rather than temporary macroeconomic imbalances. Once hailed as a post-conflict success story, Mozambique has faced prolonged economic stagnation and fiscal distress following the 2016 hidden debt scandal, which exposed the fragility of its externally driven growth model. Drawing on a mixed-methods approach that combines macroeconomic data analysis with institutional and policy evaluation, the study investigates how dependence on extractive industries, foreign capital, and donor aid has produced growth without structural transformation. Quantitative findings reveal persistent fiscal fragility, external indebtedness, and limited diversification, with growth concentrated in capital-intensive extractive megaprojects that contribute minimally to employment and domestic value creation. The agricultural sector remains stagnant, industrialization weak, and services dominated by informal and low-productivity activities. Qualitative analysis further highlights the central role of governance failures, elite patronage, and institutional weaknesses in perpetuating inequality, regional disparities, and vulnerability to external shocks. The study concludes that Mozambique's economic crisis is structural, rooted in an economic dualism that separates a narrow enclave of foreign-dominated industries from a vast subsistence-based domestic economy. Sustainable recovery requires a strategic reorientation toward productive diversification, institutional accountability, and inclusive development. Policies aimed at strengthening agriculture, fostering small and medium-sized enterprises, and ensuring transparent resource governance are essential to transforming Mozambique's growth trajectory. Ultimately, the country's future stability and development depend on its ability to move beyond dependence on external rents toward a more resilient and equitable economic structure.

AI.tldr: 莫桑比克经济危机是结构性的，源于依赖采掘业、外国资本和援助的外部驱动增长模式，导致增长无结构转型、财政脆弱、不平等加剧。可持续复苏需要转向生产多样化、制度问责和包容性发展。
AI.research_question: 莫桑比克持续经济危机的结构性原因是什么？这些结构性弱点如何影响国家发展？
AI.motivation: 莫桑比克曾被视为后冲突成功案例，但2016年隐性债务丑闻后陷入长期经济停滞和财政困境，暴露了其外部驱动增长模式的脆弱性，需要深入分析系统性弱点而非临时宏观经济失衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构转型理论、经济二元论（外国主导产业飞地与自给自足国内经济分离）、依赖理论（对采掘业、外国资本和援助的依赖）、制度经济学（治理失败和精英庇护）
AI.method: 混合方法：宏观经济数据分析与制度和政策评估相结合
AI.findings: 1. 持续财政脆弱、外部负债和有限多样化；2. 增长集中在资本密集型采掘大型项目，对就业和国内价值创造贡献极小；3. 农业停滞、工业化薄弱、服务业被非正式和低生产率活动主导；4. 治理失败、精英庇护和制度弱点加剧不平等、区域差异和外部冲击脆弱性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将莫桑比克经济危机概念化为结构性而非周期性现象；2. 阐明经济二元论如何导致增长无结构转型；3. 扩展对依赖外部租金经济体的脆弱性理解；4. 强调制度因素在维持经济危机中的核心作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供具体改革方向：加强农业、培育中小企业、确保透明资源治理；2. 提出从依赖外部租金转向更具韧性和公平经济结构的战略；3. 为类似依赖采掘业的发展中国家提供警示和借鉴

reference: NBB WP 409
title: Optimal Defi Cit-Spending in a Liquidity Trap with Long-Term Government Debt
affiliations: Research Department

detail.title: Optimal Defi Cit-Spending in a Liquidity Trap with Long-Term Government Debt

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBB WP 409
publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: When the government issues long-term bonds, the optimal time-consistent fiscal and monetary policy is to consolidate debt in a liquidity trap by increasing taxes and by taming public spending. This prescription is at odds with large deficit-spending undertaken in the US during previous liquidity trap episodes. In this article, I show that accumulating debt turns optimal with long-term bonds and flexible wages if labor taxes are kept constant or if monetary policy is conducted non optimally. Moreover, even when labor taxes fluctuate and policy is fully coordinated, optimal deficit-spending in a liquidity trap emerges in a medium-scale model with sticky wages and rule-of-thumb consumers. In this case, debt consolidation occurs only after the nominal interest rate has lifted-off the zero lower bound, in accordance with conventional wisdom that a government should fix the roof while the sun is shining.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在流动性陷阱中政府发行长期债券时的最优财政货币政策。传统观点认为应通过增税和削减支出来巩固债务，但美国历史经验显示大规模赤字支出更为常见。作者发现，在长期债券和灵活工资条件下，如果劳动税率保持不变或货币政策非最优，债务积累反而是最优的。即使在完全协调的政策下，具有粘性工资和拇指规则消费者的中等规模模型中也支持流动性陷阱中的最优赤字支出。
AI.research_question: 在流动性陷阱中，当政府发行长期债券时，最优的财政和货币政策是什么？为什么实际政策（如美国的赤字支出）与传统理论建议（债务巩固）存在差异？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为在流动性陷阱中，政府应通过增税和削减支出来巩固债务，但这与美国历史经验中大规模赤字支出的做法相矛盾。作者旨在解释这种理论与实践的差异，并探讨在什么条件下赤字支出才是最优的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间一致性财政货币政策理论、流动性陷阱理论、长期债券定价理论，结合粘性工资、拇指规则消费者等新凯恩斯主义框架要素。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，包括：1）长期债券和灵活工资条件下的最优政策分析；2）考虑劳动税率恒定或货币政策非最优的情况；3）构建中等规模模型，包含粘性工资和拇指规则消费者，分析完全协调政策下的最优赤字支出。
AI.findings: 1）在长期债券和灵活工资条件下，如果劳动税率保持不变或货币政策非最优，债务积累是最优的；2）即使在完全协调的政策下，具有粘性工资和拇指规则消费者的中等规模模型中也支持流动性陷阱中的最优赤字支出；3）债务巩固仅在名义利率脱离零下限后才应进行，符合"晴天修屋顶"的传统智慧。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战了流动性陷阱中应进行债务巩固的传统理论；2）识别了支持赤字支出的关键条件（长期债券、灵活工资、特定政策约束）；3）在更现实的模型设定中证明了赤字支出的最优性；4）为理论与实践的差异提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者在流动性陷阱中实施赤字支出提供了理论依据；2）明确了债务巩固的时机应在利率脱离零下限之后；3）帮助理解美国历史赤字支出政策的合理性；4）为财政货币政策协调提供了实践指导。

reference: BOFIT Discussion Paper No. 11/2025
title: Trade Sanctions
affiliations: University of Antwerp, Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Trade Sanctions

publicationDetails.detailsText: BOFIT Discussion Paper No. 11/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How effective are trade sanctions? We study the unprecedented sanctions imposed on Russia following February 2022, when Western countries banned exports accounting for 36% of Russia’s prewar import value. Combining novel, hand-collected records of these sanctions with Russian customs data, firm balance sheets, domestic railway shipments, and government procurement contracts, we provide the most comprehensive analysis to date of the economic impact of trade sanctions on a target country. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that imports of sanctioned country-product varieties into Russia saw a sharp 55% decline after the war’s onset. Although we document substantial rerouting through third countries, it has not fully offset the direct import losses: total imports of sanctioned products fell by 27% through 2023. Russian firms that had relied on soon-to-be-sanctioned imports experienced a 14% decline in output during the same period, not offset by competing firms or entrants. Similar declines are present for manufacturing and technology firms, and firms along the military supply chain. Affected firms have also experienced reduced government procurement sales and incurred additional losses when their buyers or suppliers were exposed to sanctions. Overall, our findings suggest that, contrary to widespread claims of ineffectiveness, export sanctions on Russia have had far-reaching adverse effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2022年2月后西方国家对俄罗斯实施的贸易制裁效果，发现尽管存在第三国转口贸易，但制裁产品进口仍下降27%，依赖制裁进口的俄罗斯企业产出下降14%，表明制裁对俄罗斯经济产生了显著负面影响。
AI.research_question: 贸易制裁的有效性如何？特别是2022年2月后西方国家对俄罗斯实施的史无前例制裁对俄罗斯经济产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管有广泛声称制裁无效，但缺乏对俄罗斯制裁经济影响的全面实证分析。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估贸易制裁的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易制裁理论、国际贸易理论、企业供应链理论、差异中的差异（DID）计量经济学方法。
AI.method: 结合手工收集的制裁记录、俄罗斯海关数据、企业资产负债表、国内铁路运输数据和政府采购合同，采用差异中的差异（DID）方法进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 受制裁国家-产品品种进口下降55%；2. 尽管存在第三国转口贸易，但制裁产品总进口仍下降27%；3. 依赖制裁进口的企业产出下降14%；4. 制造业、科技企业和军事供应链企业都受到类似影响；5. 受影响企业的政府采购销售减少，且当买家或供应商受制裁影响时遭受额外损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了贸易制裁有效性的实证证据，挑战了"制裁无效"的普遍说法；展示了制裁通过供应链传导的机制；为制裁经济学理论提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了制裁效果的实际数据；揭示了第三国转口贸易的局限性；展示了制裁对企业层面和供应链的深远影响；为未来制裁政策设计提供了参考。

title: On Measuring Economic Convergence
affiliations: Universidad Alberto Hurtado

detail.title: On Measuring Economic Convergence
detail.abstract: This paper challenges the prevailing view that unconditional economic convergence across countries does not generally apply by demonstrating that this belief is rooted in flawed measurement. Through theoretical modeling and empirical analysis, the study demonstrates that official national accounts can obscure genuine convergence trends across countries. Using highly measurable and consistently available proxies—such as primary energy consumption, electricity generation, and life expectancy—the paper finds robust evidence of unconditional convergence in GDP per capita across a broad sample of countries. The results reveal that convergence is significantly stronger when measured through these proxies than through national accounts. The study calls for a reevaluation of how economists utilize GDP statistics and advocates for incorporating alternative development indicators to more accurately monitor global development in the long run.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了无条件经济收敛不普遍存在的观点，指出这一观点源于有缺陷的测量方法。通过理论建模和实证分析，研究发现官方国民账户可能掩盖国家间的真实收敛趋势。使用可高度测量且持续可得的代理指标（如一次能源消费、发电量和预期寿命），论文发现了广泛国家样本中人均GDP无条件收敛的强有力证据。结果显示，通过这些代理指标测量的收敛性比通过国民账户测量的收敛性显著更强。研究呼吁重新评估经济学家如何使用GDP统计数据，并主张纳入替代发展指标以更准确地监测长期全球发展。
AI.research_question: 无条件经济收敛是否普遍存在于各国之间？官方国民账户是否掩盖了真实的收敛趋势？
AI.motivation: 挑战当前经济学界普遍认为无条件经济收敛不普遍存在的观点，指出这一观点可能源于有缺陷的测量方法，特别是官方国民账户数据的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长收敛理论，特别是无条件收敛假说；测量误差理论；替代发展指标理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合。使用高度可测量且持续可得的代理指标（一次能源消费、发电量、预期寿命）作为GDP的替代测量，对广泛国家样本进行收敛性检验。
AI.findings: 发现了人均GDP无条件收敛的强有力证据；通过代理指标测量的收敛性比通过官方国民账户测量的收敛性显著更强；官方国民账户确实可能掩盖真实的收敛趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了无条件收敛不普遍存在的传统观点；提出了测量误差可能扭曲收敛性检验的理论框架；为经济增长收敛理论提供了新的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁重新评估GDP统计数据的使用方法；主张纳入替代发展指标以更准确地监测全球发展；为政策制定者提供了更可靠的发展监测工具。

reference: NBB WP 390
title: Going Green by Putting a Price on Pollution : Firm-Level Evidence from the EU
affiliations: Tilburg University,  and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Going Green by Putting a Price on Pollution : Firm-Level Evidence from the EU

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBB WP 390
publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper shows that, when the price of emission allowances is sufficiently high, emission trading schemes improve the emission efficiency of highly polluting firms. The efficiency gain comes from a relative decrease in emissions rather than a relative increase in operating revenue. Part of the improvement is realized via the acquisition of green firms. The size of the improvement depends on the initial allo cation of free emission allowances: highly polluting firms receiving more emission allowances for free, such as firms on the carbon leakage list, have a weaker incentive to become more efficient. For identification, we exploit the tightening in EU ETS regulation in 2017, which led to a steep price increase of emission allowances and madethe ETS regulation more binding for polluting firms.

AI.tldr: 当碳排放配额价格足够高时，排放交易体系能提高高污染企业的排放效率，这种效率提升主要来自排放的相对减少而非营收增加，部分通过收购绿色企业实现。效率改善程度取决于初始免费配额分配：获得更多免费配额的企业（如碳泄漏名单上的企业）改善动机较弱。
AI.research_question: 排放交易体系（ETS）如何影响高污染企业的排放效率？这种效率提升的机制是什么？初始免费配额分配如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 理解排放交易体系的实际效果对气候政策设计至关重要。虽然理论上ETS能激励减排，但实际中企业如何响应价格信号、通过何种机制提升效率、以及初始配额分配如何影响激励效果，都需要实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和公司金融理论，结合科斯定理（产权交易）和波特假说（环境规制促进创新），分析ETS通过价格信号影响企业行为的机制。
AI.method: 利用2017年欧盟ETS监管收紧的自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）等方法，比较政策前后高污染企业的排放效率变化，分析价格冲击的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 当配额价格足够高时，ETS显著提高高污染企业排放效率；2. 效率提升主要来自排放减少而非营收增加；3. 部分企业通过收购绿色企业实现改善；4. 初始免费配额越多（如碳泄漏名单企业），改善动机越弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证ETS在高价格下的有效性；2. 揭示效率提升的具体机制（排放减少vs营收增加）；3. 识别企业战略响应（绿色并购）；4. 证明初始配额分配的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计ETS提供依据：确保价格足够高；2. 优化免费配额分配机制，避免削弱激励；3. 帮助企业理解合规策略；4. 为评估气候政策效果提供方法。

detail.abstract: We estimate the effects of exogenous innovations to the balance sheet of the ECB since the start of the financial crisis within a structural VAR framework. An expansionary balance sheet shock stimulates bank lending, stabilizes financial markets, and has a positive impact on economic activity and prices. The effects on bank lending and output turn out to be smaller in the member countries that have been more affected by the financial crisis, in particular those countries where the banking system is less well-capitalized.

AI.tldr: 本文使用结构VAR框架估计了自金融危机开始以来ECB资产负债表外生冲击的影响。扩张性资产负债表冲击刺激银行放贷、稳定金融市场，并对经济活动和价格产生积极影响。在受金融危机影响更大的成员国，特别是银行体系资本充足率较低的国家，对银行放贷和产出的影响较小。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行资产负债表外生冲击对银行放贷、金融市场、经济活动和价格有何影响？这些影响在不同成员国间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 自金融危机以来，欧洲央行实施了各种资产负债表扩张政策，但对其实际效果和异质性影响缺乏系统评估，特别是在不同成员国间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构VAR框架，资产负债表渠道理论，银行信贷传导机制，货币政策传导的异质性效应。
AI.method: 结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，用于估计欧洲央行资产负债表外生冲击的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 扩张性资产负债表冲击刺激银行放贷、稳定金融市场，并对经济活动和价格产生积极影响。2. 在受金融危机影响更大的成员国，特别是银行体系资本充足率较低的国家，对银行放贷和产出的影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为资产负债表渠道理论提供了实证支持。2. 揭示了货币政策传导的异质性，特别是银行资本充足率在传导机制中的重要作用。3. 扩展了SVAR在央行资产负债表政策评估中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧洲央行资产负债表政策的有效性提供了实证证据。2. 强调了银行体系健康对货币政策传导的重要性。3. 为政策制定者在不同成员国实施差异化政策提供了参考依据。

detail.title: Estate Owners’ Ensemble— Mapping Commercial Real Estate Concentration using Finnish Firm Ownership Network

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 12/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The commercial real estate (CRE) market is an important source of financial stability risks, yet ownership structures remain opaque. This paper uses comprehensive Finnish register data to construct firm-level ownership network and identify owners of CRE firms. We document that government entities are the most important ultimate owners, holding about 10% of the sector’s balance sheet. We show that government ownership predicts lower interest rate spreads on CRE bank loans, consistent with creditors perceiving such firms as less risky. Our results highlight the need to incorporate ownership structures into financial stability assessments and credit risk models.

AI.tldr: 使用芬兰注册数据构建商业地产公司所有权网络，发现政府实体是最重要的最终所有者，持有约10%的资产负债表份额。政府所有权预测较低的银行贷款利率利差，表明债权人认为此类公司风险较低。
AI.research_question: 商业地产公司的所有权结构如何影响其信贷风险和金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 商业地产市场是金融稳定风险的重要来源，但所有权结构仍然不透明，需要更清晰地了解所有权如何影响信贷风险和金融稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 所有权结构理论、信贷风险定价理论、政府所有权与风险感知理论
AI.method: 使用全面的芬兰注册数据构建公司层面的所有权网络，识别商业地产公司的最终所有者，并分析政府所有权与银行贷款利率利差之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 政府实体是商业地产公司最重要的最终所有者，持有约10%的资产负债表份额；2. 政府所有权预测较低的商业地产银行贷款利率利差，表明债权人认为此类公司风险较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了商业地产市场所有权结构的重要性；2. 提供了政府所有权影响信贷风险定价的经验证据；3. 强调了所有权网络分析在金融稳定性评估中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供了将所有权结构纳入金融稳定性评估的方法；2. 为银行和信贷机构改进了信用风险模型；3. 强调了透明度在商业地产市场中的重要性。

detail.title: Ethical and Governance Challenges of Explainable AI (XAI) in Critical Decision-Making Systems (Medicine and Finance)
detail.abstract: This expert review provides an exhaustive analysis of the tension between the technical capabilities of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and the rising ethical and governance mandates governing high-risk decision systems, specifically in the domains of health sciences and finance. The report details the foundational concepts and taxonomy of XAI, scrutinizes the ethical liabilities stemming from phenomena like the proxy variable problem and technical instability, and maps these challenges against stringent regulatory frameworks, particularly the EU AI Act. The analysis highlights a critical disconnect: where legal frameworks demand causal justification, technical XAI often only provides correlational attribution, leading to an institutional risk of “Explainability Illusion.” Ultimately, achieving legally responsible AI requires prioritizing robust, stable explanation methods and mandating interdisciplinary integration across technology, law, and applied ethics.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析了可解释人工智能（XAI）技术能力与高风险决策系统（特别是医疗和金融领域）日益严格的伦理和治理要求之间的紧张关系，揭示了法律框架要求因果解释而技术XAI仅提供相关性归因的"可解释性幻觉"风险，最终提出实现合法AI需要优先发展稳健稳定的解释方法并强制跨学科整合。
AI.research_question: 在高风险决策系统（特别是医疗和金融领域）中，可解释人工智能（XAI）的技术能力如何与日益严格的伦理和治理要求相匹配？法律框架要求的因果解释与技术XAI提供的相关性归因之间的差距如何解决？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在高风险决策领域的广泛应用，特别是医疗和金融领域，监管框架（如欧盟AI法案）对AI系统的可解释性和问责制提出了严格要求。然而，当前XAI技术能力与这些法律和伦理要求之间存在显著差距，可能导致"可解释性幻觉"风险，即系统看似可解释但实际上无法满足法律要求的因果解释标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 可解释人工智能（XAI）的基础概念和分类学；2. 代理变量问题和技术不稳定性等伦理责任理论；3. 监管框架理论（特别是欧盟AI法案）；4. 因果解释与相关性归因的认知差距理论；5. 跨学科整合理论（技术、法律、应用伦理学的融合）。
AI.method: 专家综述方法：对XAI技术能力与伦理治理要求之间的紧张关系进行全面分析；详细阐述XAI基础概念和分类学；审查代理变量问题和技术不稳定性等伦理责任；将这些挑战映射到严格的监管框架（特别是欧盟AI法案）；分析法律要求与技术能力之间的脱节。
AI.findings: 研究发现存在关键脱节：法律框架要求因果解释，但技术XAI通常只提供相关性归因，导致"可解释性幻觉"的制度风险。代理变量问题和技术不稳定性等伦理责任进一步加剧了这种脱节。当前XAI方法在满足欧盟AI法案等严格监管要求方面存在显著不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统化分析了XAI技术能力与伦理治理要求之间的理论紧张关系；2. 提出了"可解释性幻觉"概念，描述法律要求的因果解释与技术提供的相关性归因之间的差距；3. 建立了XAI伦理责任（代理变量问题、技术不稳定性）与监管框架的理论映射；4. 发展了跨学科整合的理论框架，强调技术、法律和应用伦理学的协同。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高风险AI系统开发者提供了满足监管要求的实用指南；2. 为政策制定者提供了改进监管框架的实证基础；3. 为组织实施AI治理提供了跨学科整合的具体路径；4. 强调了优先发展稳健稳定解释方法的实践必要性；5. 为医疗和金融领域的AI应用提供了具体的合规建议。

title: Knowledge and Technology Transfer in German Public Non-University Research Institutions: Development of a Reference Model
affiliations: University of Koblenz-Landau, Saarland University, Saarbrücken, Germany, TU Braunschweig, University of Koblenz-Landau, University of Koblenz-Landau, University of Koblenz-Landau and Saarland University, DFKI

detail.title: Knowledge and Technology Transfer in German Public Non-University Research Institutions: Development of a Reference Model

declarations.funderStatement: This study was conducted within the project “DiMeKI” (03IO2307C), funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR).

detail.abstract: Non-university research institutions (NURI) play a vital role in the research landscape. Given the challenges and limited publications on knowledge and technology transfer (KTT) within NURI, this study investigates how KTT within NURI can be represented as an as-is model. The approach of this paper is based on inductive reference modeling, integrating a web analysis and interviews to capture key processes, actors, and databases regarding KTT of NURI. The study results in two reference models. The first reference model provides an overview of actors and their relations. The second reference model focuses on processes, extending previous KTT models to include more details of both commercial and non-commercial aspects. The study also offers insights into potential opportunities and concerns related to emerging technologies expressed by the interviewees. Future research should focus on the integration of advanced technologies, especially AI, to further enhance the KTT process.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过归纳参考建模方法，为非大学研究机构的知识与技术转移构建了两个参考模型：一个关注参与者及其关系，另一个关注流程细节，扩展了现有KTT模型，并探讨了新兴技术带来的机遇与挑战。
AI.research_question: 非大学研究机构的知识与技术转移如何被表示为现状模型？
AI.motivation: 非大学研究机构在科研生态中扮演重要角色，但关于其知识与技术转移的研究面临挑战且文献有限，需要建立系统的参考模型来理解其KTT过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 归纳参考建模理论，知识与技术转移理论，组织间知识流动理论
AI.method: 基于归纳参考建模方法，结合网络分析和访谈，收集NURI中KTT的关键流程、参与者和数据库信息
AI.findings: 开发了两个参考模型：第一个模型展示参与者及其关系；第二个模型聚焦流程，扩展了现有KTT模型，包含商业和非商业方面的更多细节；同时识别了新兴技术带来的机遇和担忧
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了知识与技术转移理论在非大学研究机构中的应用，提供了系统化的参考建模框架，丰富了组织间知识流动的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为NURI管理者提供了实用的KTT流程参考模型，帮助识别改进机会；为政策制定者提供了理解NURI技术转移的框架；指出了AI等先进技术在增强KTT过程中的应用方向

title: Influence of TikTok Shop Engagement on Skincare Beauty Product Sales in TikTok Shop Philippines
affiliations: , Independent and Independent

detail.title: Influence of TikTok Shop Engagement on Skincare Beauty Product Sales in TikTok Shop Philippines
detail.abstract: The growing influence of social commerce platforms has transformed how consumers make purchasing decisions, particularly in the beauty and skincare industry. Despite the rapid rise of TikTok Shop in the Philippines, limited research has explored how its engagement metrics directly affect product sales. Addressing this gap, the research investigated the relationship between TikTok Shop engagement—measured through the number of customer reviews/stars and average product ratings—and the sales performance of skincare beauty products. Using a quantitative descriptive–correlational design, data were gathered from 130 skincare products listed on TikTok Shop between January and March 2025. Descriptive analysis revealed that engagement and sales were highly skewed, with a few viral products dominating consumer attention and purchases. Regression results showed that the number of reviews or stars strongly predicted sales performance, explaining 97.2% of the variance, while average ratings explained only 26.1%. These findings emphasize that the volume of social proof, rather than rating quality, plays a more decisive role in influencing consumer buying behavior in algorithm-driven platforms. The implications suggest that sellers and marketers should focus on strategies that boost customer engagement and review volume to improve visibility and maximize sales potential in social commerce environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了TikTok Shop上护肤品销售与用户参与度指标之间的关系，发现评论数量比平均评分更能预测销售表现，强调了社交证明数量在算法驱动平台中的重要性。
AI.research_question: TikTok Shop上的用户参与度指标（客户评论/星星数量和平均产品评分）如何影响护肤品产品的销售表现？
AI.motivation: 社交商务平台影响力日益增长，特别是在美妆护肤行业。尽管TikTok Shop在菲律宾迅速崛起，但关于其参与度指标如何直接影响产品销售的研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交商务、用户参与度理论、社交证明理论、算法驱动平台中的消费者行为理论。
AI.method: 采用定量描述-相关性设计，收集2025年1月至3月期间TikTok Shop上130个护肤产品的数据，进行描述性分析和回归分析。
AI.findings: 1. 参与度和销售数据高度偏斜，少数爆款产品主导了消费者关注和购买；2. 评论/星星数量能强烈预测销售表现，解释97.2%的方差；3. 平均评分仅解释26.1%的方差；4. 社交证明的数量而非质量在算法驱动平台中对消费者购买行为影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了社交商务环境下用户参与度与销售关系的研究；2. 区分了社交证明数量与质量的不同影响；3. 为算法驱动平台中的消费者行为理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议卖家和营销人员应专注于提升客户参与度和评论数量的策略；2. 强调在社交商务环境中提高产品可见性和最大化销售潜力的方法；3. 为TikTok Shop等平台的营销策略提供具体指导。

title: LLMs for Explainable Business Decision-Making: A Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning Approach
affiliations: , University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: LLMs for Explainable Business Decision-Making: A Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning Approach
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models increasingly drive high-stakes consumer interactions, such as credit approvals, yet their decision logic often remains opaque. Prevailing explainable AI techniques rely on post hoc numerical feature attributions, which fail to provide coherent narratives behind model decisions. Large language models (LLMs) present an opportunity to generate natural-language explanations, but three design challenges remain unresolved: explanations must be both decision-correct and faithful to the factors that drive the prediction; they should be able to serve multiple audiences without shifting the underlying decision rule; and they should be trained in a label-efficient way that does not depend on large corpora of human-scored explanations. To address these challenges, we introduce LEXMA (LLM-based EXplanations for Multi-Audience decisions), a reinforcement-learning-based fine-tuning framework that produces narrative-driven, audience-appropriate explanations. LEXMA combines reflection-augmented supervised fine-tuning with two stages of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Specifically, it fine-tunes two separate parameter sets to improve decision correctness and satisfy stylistic requirements for different audiences, using reward signals that do not rely on human-annotated explanations. We instantiate LEXMA in the context of mortgage approval decisions. Results demonstrate that LEXMA yields significant improvements in predictive performance compared with other LLM baselines. Moreover, human evaluations show that expert-facing explanations generated by our approach are more risk-focused, and consumer-facing explanations are clearer, more actionable, and more polite. Our study contributes a cost-efficient, systematic LLM fine-tuning approach to enhance explanation quality for business decisions, offering strong potential for scalable deployment of transparent AI systems.

AI.tldr: LEXMA是一个基于强化学习的LLM微调框架，用于为多受众生成叙事驱动的AI决策解释，解决了现有解释方法在忠实性、多受众适应性和标签效率方面的挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够为不同受众生成既忠实于AI模型决策逻辑又具有适当叙事风格的自动化解释系统？
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型在高风险消费者决策（如信贷审批）中应用广泛，但现有解释方法存在三个主要问题：1）事后数值特征归因无法提供连贯的叙事解释；2）缺乏针对不同受众（专家vs消费者）的适应性解释；3）需要大量人工标注的解释数据来训练。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强化学习的LLM微调理论，结合反思增强的监督微调和两阶段组相对策略优化（GRPO），通过分离参数集来分别优化决策正确性和不同受众的文体要求。
AI.method: LEXMA框架：1）反思增强的监督微调；2）两阶段GRPO优化，分别针对决策正确性和受众风格要求；3）在抵押贷款审批决策场景中实例化；4）使用无需人工标注解释的奖励信号进行训练。
AI.findings: 1）LEXMA在预测性能上显著优于其他LLM基线；2）专家面向的解释更加关注风险因素；3）消费者面向的解释更清晰、更具可操作性、更有礼貌；4）框架具有成本效益，适合大规模部署透明AI系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了首个结合反思增强监督微调和GRPO的多受众解释生成框架；2）解决了解释忠实性、多受众适应性和标签效率三个核心设计挑战；3）为AI透明度研究提供了新的强化学习应用范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了可实际部署的LEXMA系统；2）在抵押贷款审批场景中验证了有效性；3）提供了成本高效的LLM微调方法；4）支持专家和消费者两种不同受众的解释需求；5）为金融机构等企业提供了可扩展的透明AI解决方案。

detail.abstract: The rapid evolution of e-commerce and digital technologies has transformed traditional auction markets into highly dynamic online auction systems. These platforms enable sellers to reach wider audiences and facilitate real-time, locationindependent bidding, but also raise significant challenges in security, trust, and efficiency [1], [2]. Research has proposed secure architectures using cryptography, blockchain, and smart contracts to ensure privacy, integrity, and fairness in transactions [3]. Specific implementations, such as Bidify, have demonstrated the potential for improved user experience, fraud reduction, and enhanced bidding processes [4]. Auction mechanisms have also been explored in cloud computing, edge computing, and other domains, emphasizing efficient resource allocation, truthful bidding, and incentive compatibility [5], [6]. Studies further analyze policy effects, information disclosure, and multi-objective optimization to balance revenue, quality, and user utility [7], [8]. Novel designs, such as online double auctions and reverse auction mechanisms, have been applied to areas like smart grids, ride-sharing, and UAV-enabled crowd-sensing to maximize social welfare and operational efficiency [9]. Overall, literature highlights that continuous improvement in security protocols, auction design, and user-centric features is essential for fostering trust, increasing participation, and ensuring the long-term success of online auction platforms [1], [6].

AI.tldr: 在线拍卖系统在电子商务和数字技术推动下快速发展，但面临安全、信任和效率挑战。研究通过加密、区块链和智能合约等技术提升安全性，同时优化拍卖机制设计以提高资源分配效率和社会福利。
AI.research_question: 如何设计安全、高效且用户友好的在线拍卖系统，以应对数字时代的安全、信任和效率挑战？
AI.motivation: 电子商务和数字技术的快速发展将传统拍卖市场转变为高度动态的在线拍卖系统，这些平台虽然扩大了卖家受众并实现了实时、位置独立的竞价，但也带来了安全、信任和效率方面的重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拍卖理论、机制设计理论、密码学理论、区块链技术、智能合约理论、资源分配理论、激励相容理论、多目标优化理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，分析现有研究提出的安全架构（加密、区块链、智能合约）、具体实现案例（如Bidify）、拍卖机制在不同领域的应用（云计算、边缘计算）、政策效果分析、信息披露研究、多目标优化方法以及新型拍卖设计（在线双重拍卖、反向拍卖机制）
AI.findings: 1. 安全技术（加密、区块链、智能合约）能有效确保交易隐私、完整性和公平性；2. 具体实现如Bidify展示了改善用户体验、减少欺诈和增强竞价过程的潜力；3. 拍卖机制在云计算、边缘计算等领域强调高效资源分配、真实竞价和激励相容；4. 政策效果、信息披露和多目标优化研究有助于平衡收入、质量和用户效用；5. 新型拍卖设计（在线双重拍卖、反向拍卖）在智能电网、共享出行和无人机群感知等领域能最大化社会福利和运营效率
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合了拍卖理论与现代数字技术，为在线拍卖系统提供了理论框架；2. 扩展了机制设计理论在数字环境中的应用；3. 提出了安全、信任和效率平衡的理论模型；4. 发展了多目标优化在拍卖设计中的理论方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为在线拍卖平台提供了具体的安全架构实现方案；2. 展示了Bidify等实际系统的成功案例；3. 为云计算、边缘计算等领域的资源分配提供了拍卖机制解决方案；4. 为智能电网、共享出行等新兴领域提供了创新的拍卖设计；5. 为平台运营者提供了提升用户信任和参与度的实用建议

detail.title: Network Effects and Research Collaborations

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBB WP 388
publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the determinants of new and repeated research collaborations, drawing on the co authorship network of the International Monetary Fund (IMF)’s Working Papers series. Being an outlet where authors express their views on topics of interest, and given that IMF staff is not subject to the “publish-or-perish” conditions of the academia, the IMF Working Papers series constitutes an appropriate testing ground to examine the endogenous nature of co-authorship formation. We show that the co-authorship network is characterized by many authors with few direct co-authors, yet indirectly connected to each other through short co-authorship chains. We find that a shorter distance in the co-authorship network is key for starting research collaborations. Also, higher research productivity, being employed in the same department, and having citizenship of the same region help to start and repeat collaborations. Furthermore, authors with different co-authorship network sizes are more likely to collaborate, possibly reflecting synergies between senior and junior staff members.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用IMF工作论文系列的合作网络，分析了新合作和重复合作的决定因素。研究发现：合作网络距离越短越容易开始合作；研究生产力高、同部门工作、同地区公民身份有助于开始和重复合作；不同合作网络规模的作者更可能合作，可能反映了资深与初级员工之间的协同效应。
AI.research_question: 什么因素决定了国际货币基金组织工作论文系列中新合作和重复研究合作的形成？
AI.motivation: IMF工作论文系列为研究合作形成的内生性提供了理想的测试环境，因为作者在此表达个人观点而非受学术界的"不发表就淘汰"压力驱动，这有助于更纯粹地分析合作决策的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合作网络理论和社会资本理论，研究合作网络结构对合作形成的影响，包括网络距离、部门同质性、地理邻近性等因素。
AI.method: 利用IMF工作论文系列的合著网络数据，采用网络分析方法研究合作模式，分析网络距离、研究生产力、部门隶属、公民身份等因素对合作形成的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 合作网络距离越短越容易开始新合作；2. 研究生产力高、同部门工作、同地区公民身份有助于开始和重复合作；3. 不同合作网络规模的作者更可能合作，可能反映了资深与初级员工之间的协同效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为研究合作形成的内生性提供了实证证据，揭示了在非学术压力环境下合作网络的结构特征和形成机制，丰富了组织内研究合作的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际组织如IMF优化研究合作提供指导，帮助理解如何促进跨部门、跨资历的研究合作，提高研究产出效率和质量。

detail.abstract: Human Resource Management (HRM) and Organisational Behaviour (OB) represent synergistic approaches for strategy to feed performance. This article integrates current findings about how integrated systems of HRM involving planning, selection, individual and group development, rewards, and employee relations, in conjunction with OB processes, influence innovation, responsiveness, and organisational integrity. First, three micro-meso designshave been found to have a positive effect across all studies regardless of data type or analysis applied: decentralised HRM systems enabling line managers as organisational-level participants in people work activities, caring HRM supporting increased perceptions of Organisational Support and organisation-level engagement and change readiness through it, and OB approaches building a positive work routine through Self-Efficacy beliefs and job crafting. On a macro-meso strategiclevel perspective, as a strategy-aligned explanatory theory, extended strategic HRM incorporates an extended version of the Resource-Based View of Strategy by explaining how a combination of human resources capabilities produces a unique, costly-to-beature battery of human and social capital that secure long-term competitiveness. An extended mandate as a strategic-level research field puts a new priority upon corporate social responsibility as a mediating variable in strategic action. Current systems-modelling theories of practice in OB offer greater insight why participative designs for workers outperform rigidly hierarchical designs in periods of organisational instability or flux.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了人力资源管理(HRM)与组织行为(OB)如何协同影响组织绩效，识别了三个有效的微观-中观设计，并提出了扩展的战略人力资源管理理论框架。
AI.research_question: 综合的人力资源管理系统与组织行为过程如何共同影响创新、响应能力和组织完整性？
AI.motivation: 人力资源管理(HRM)和组织行为(OB)代表了促进战略转化为绩效的协同方法，需要整合当前研究发现，理解两者如何共同影响组织关键能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的战略人力资源管理理论，基于扩展的资源基础观，解释人力资源能力如何形成独特、难以模仿的人力和社会资本组合，确保长期竞争力。
AI.method: 文献综述和整合分析，综合当前研究发现，涵盖多种数据类型和分析方法。
AI.findings: 三个微观-中观设计在所有研究中都显示积极效果：1)分散化HRM系统让直线经理参与人员工作；2)关怀型HRM增强组织支持感和组织层面参与度；3)OB方法通过自我效能信念和工作塑造建立积极工作常规。宏观-中观层面，战略HRM解释了人力资源能力如何创造竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了扩展的战略人力资源管理理论框架，将企业社会责任作为战略行动的中介变量，强调OB实践理论为参与式设计在组织不稳定时期的优势提供更深入解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计提供了具体建议：实施分散化HRM系统、关怀型HRM实践和基于OB的积极工作常规建设，特别是在组织不稳定时期应采用参与式而非僵化的层级设计。

detail.abstract: Management psychology highlights how leaders’ cognitions, emotions, and actions drive routine activities in which strategy is implemented, while a Human Potential Index (HPI) attempts to enumerate a “stock and flows of knowledge, skills, and psychological assets that an organization uses to learn, adapt, and innovate” (Mihmanari & Côté, 2021, 2676). Recent findings indicate that managerial-level psychological well-being is objectively related to leadership performance through shared cultural background—supportive work conditions mitigate stresses while allowing more transformative and proactive types of leading—to a greater degree than in poor mental health, which inclines leaders towards poorer practices (Dextras-Gauthier, Gilbert, Dima, & Adou, 2023). By side, hope, self-efficacy, resilience, and optimism as components of “Cumulative Psychological Capital” represent a holistic, constantly renewable “organizational-level” innovation performance amplifier through such mechanics as knowledge-sharing, “psychological safety,” and “recovery from setbacks” in individual as well as collective human units (Cui, Jin, & Lee, 2020; Grözinger, Wolff, Ruf, & Moog, 2021; Hu et al., 2023; Liu, Chen, & Han, 2023). Building an appropriately “decision-useful” Human Potential Index demands not only qualitative assessments of “achievements and learning capabilities” in a firm's history but also quantitative constructs of human assets that have been psychologically validated in a multi-dimensional manner (“covering cognitive, affective, and sociocultural facets”; Loseva, Abdikeev, & Melnichuk, 2020; Robledo-Ardila & Román-Calderón, 2020; Zhang, Van Iddekinge, Ployhart, Arnold, & Jordan, 2023). By its turn, while “management psychology offers a set of levers,” a Human Potential Index offers “a set of instrumentation that when paired together will yield a data-grounded, fact—to–root ethical vision of an organization’s human potential—that goes well beyond measures of human assets conveyed by measures of overall "head counts" or "job titles" altogether.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何结合管理心理学与人类潜力指数(HPI)来更全面地衡量和提升组织的人力资本，超越传统的人力资源指标如员工人数或职位头衔。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既包含管理心理学洞见又具备决策实用性的"人类潜力指数"(HPI)，以更全面地衡量和提升组织的人力资本？
AI.motivation: 传统的人力资源指标(如员工人数、职位头衔)无法充分反映组织的真实人力潜力。管理心理学强调领导者的认知、情感和行为对战略实施的影响，而人类潜力指数试图量化组织的知识、技能和心理资产。两者结合可以提供一个更全面、数据驱动的人力资本评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 管理心理学理论：关注领导者认知、情感和行为对组织日常活动和战略实施的影响
2. 人类潜力指数(HPI)理论：衡量组织知识、技能和心理资产的"存量与流量"
3. 累积心理资本理论：包括希望、自我效能、韧性和乐观等要素，作为组织层面的创新绩效放大器
4. 心理安全理论：支持知识分享和从挫折中恢复的心理环境
AI.method:
本文采用理论整合方法，综合现有研究构建概念框架。方法包括：
1. 文献综述：整合管理心理学和人类潜力指数的相关研究
2. 多维度验证：强调需要涵盖认知、情感和社会文化层面的心理验证
3. 定性与定量结合：既包含组织历史成就和学习能力的定性评估，也包含人类资产的定量构建
AI.findings:
1. 管理者心理健康与领导绩效正相关，支持性工作条件能减轻压力并促进变革型领导
2. 累积心理资本(希望、自我效能、韧性、乐观)通过知识分享、心理安全和挫折恢复等机制放大组织创新绩效
3. 构建有效的HPI需要多维度的心理验证，涵盖认知、情感和社会文化层面
4. 管理心理学提供"杠杆"，HPI提供"测量工具"，两者结合能产生数据驱动的组织人力潜力评估
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 理论整合：将管理心理学与人类潜力指数理论相结合，提出更全面的人力资本评估框架
2. 概念发展：明确了"决策实用性"HPI的构建原则，强调多维度心理验证的重要性
3. 机制阐明：揭示了心理资本通过知识分享、心理安全等机制影响组织创新绩效的具体路径
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为组织提供了超越传统人力资源指标(员工人数、职位头衔)的人力资本评估工具
2. 指导管理者如何通过支持性工作条件提升领导绩效和组织创新
3. 为企业构建有效的HPI提供了具体的方法论指导，包括定性与定量结合、多维度验证等
4. 帮助组织建立数据驱动的、基于事实的人力潜力发展愿景

title: Multilingual Sentiment Analysis in Economics and Translation-Induced Distortions
affiliations: and

detail.title: Multilingual Sentiment Analysis in Economics and Translation-Induced Distortions
detail.abstract: Multilingual sentiment analysis is increasingly used in economics, with the common approach being to machine-translate texts into English before applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools. Such translation can introduce distortions that affect the comparability of sentiment measures across languages. Using a unique dataset of economic articles professionally translated into five languages, we assess the empirical relevance of these distortions across several NLP tools. The severity of the distortions varies by tool and approach. Shapiro et al. (2022)'s method exhibits the highest consistency across languages, while models applied to the original text, such as GPT and BERT, perform reasonably well but do not consistently outperform simpler alternatives. Aggregating sentiment scores across texts reduces distortion and can render it negligible, supporting the use of multilingual sentiment analysis. Our results provide practical guidance for researchers working with cross-language sentiment indicators.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多语言情感分析中机器翻译对情感测量可比性的影响，发现不同NLP工具受翻译扭曲的程度不同，聚合情感分数可减少扭曲，为跨语言情感指标研究提供实用指导。
AI.research_question: 机器翻译对多语言情感分析中情感测量可比性产生多大程度的扭曲？不同NLP工具在跨语言应用中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 经济学中多语言情感分析日益重要，但通常做法是将文本机器翻译成英文再应用NLP工具，这种翻译可能引入扭曲，影响跨语言情感测量的可比性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多语言情感分析理论、机器翻译对语义和情感表达的影响、跨语言文本分析的可比性理论。
AI.method: 使用独特数据集：经济文章专业翻译成五种语言，评估多个NLP工具（包括Shapiro et al.方法、GPT、BERT等）在翻译文本上的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 扭曲严重程度因工具和方法而异；2. Shapiro et al.方法跨语言一致性最高；3. GPT和BERT等应用于原始文本表现良好但不总是优于简单方法；4. 聚合情感分数可显著减少扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对机器翻译在多语言情感分析中影响的理解，提供了评估跨语言情感测量可比性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供实用指导：1. 推荐使用Shapiro et al.方法提高跨语言一致性；2. 建议通过聚合情感分数减少翻译扭曲；3. 支持多语言情感分析的有效应用。

detail.abstract: Uncertainty—whether caused by economic crisis, conflict, epidemic, or radical technological change—puts un usual pressures on “people systems” at the same time as it amplifies the value of flexibility, trust, and learning. This article distills emerging research findings about how personnel or human resources (HR) practices can turn uncertainty into learning and agility through flexible structures and processes, strategic risk planning, psych support, and innovation through culture. Empirical studies in diverse sectors find that flexible organisational structures and designs, remote work arrangements, and digital communication platforms mitigate “coordinaton problems” that decrease work performance when interdependence rises fast in rapidly changing conditions (Leonov, Zheltoborodov, Olkhovyi, Prykhodko, & Pober, 2024; Azizi, Atlasi, Ziapour, Abbas, & Naemi, 2021; Airyq, Pertiwi, &, 2024). Risk or security-focused designs of human resources systems that locate sources of uncertainty, install monitoring systems or crisis plans, and define decision rights build “legitimacy” of systems through “signals” (Molozhanov & Momot, 2024; A. А. Лі́пич, 2024; Taganova, 2024; Sanders, Nguyen, Bouckenooghe, Rafferty, & Schwarz, 2024). At the same time, activities supporting “psychological well-being,” open communications, and participative decision-making maintain and shore-up “motivations” or “discretionary performance” of knowledge workers or front line employees in particular (Kovtunenko, Kovtunenko, Fomina, Kovalchuk, & Kovtunenko, 2022; Konel’ ina & Gr’yd in, 2025; Cherkasova, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在不确定性环境下，人力资源实践如何通过灵活结构、风险规划、心理支持和创新文化将不确定性转化为学习与敏捷性，提升组织韧性。
AI.research_question: 在不确定性环境下，人力资源实践如何通过灵活结构、风险规划、心理支持和创新文化将不确定性转化为学习与敏捷性？
AI.motivation: 不确定性（经济危机、冲突、流行病、技术变革）给"人员系统"带来异常压力，同时放大了灵活性、信任和学习的重要性。需要研究如何通过人力资源实践应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于协调问题理论、信号理论、心理契约理论和组织学习理论，探讨人力资源实践在不确定性环境中的作用机制。
AI.method: 文献综述和实证研究分析，整合多个跨行业研究（包括Leonov等2024、Azizi等2021、Molozhanov等2024、Kovtunenko等2022的研究）。
AI.findings: 1）灵活组织结构、远程工作安排和数字通信平台缓解协调问题；2）风险导向的人力资源系统设计通过信号建立合法性；3）心理支持、开放沟通和参与式决策维持员工动机和自主绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了不确定性环境下人力资源实践的多理论视角，提出了将不确定性转化为学习机会的理论框架，扩展了组织韧性和敏捷性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供具体的人力资源实践建议：实施灵活结构、建立风险监测系统、加强心理支持、培养创新文化，以在不确定性中保持竞争优势。

title: China's EV Bubble (?): Failed EV Startups in China

detail.title: China's EV Bubble (?): Failed EV Startups in China
detail.abstract: Is the electric vehicle industry in China a bubble? If so, has it already popped or when will it pop? While it is too early at this point to ascertain, a significant  culling of China’s EV companies is certainly ongoing after hundreds of EV brands sprung up in the country over the past decade. At one point in 2018, there were a staggering 500+ EV startups that were registered in China, but since then over 400 of these startups have ceased operations, leaving only 100 or so EV brands still standing. Skeptics point to these failures and other factors like the imminent cancellation of EV subsidies in China and tariff barriers as harbingers of doom for China's EV companies. But while it is true that many EV companies in China are destined to go bust in the near future, this is more reflective of a healthy consolidation of the market rather than a speculative bubble. To illustrate why this is the case, this article will overview six archetypical examples of failed EV startups in China to explain why their untimely implosions will probably not affect the long-term stability of China's EV market as a whole.

AI.tldr: 本文认为中国电动汽车行业并非泡沫，而是市场健康整合的过程。尽管大量EV初创企业倒闭，但这反映了市场自然淘汰而非泡沫破裂。
AI.research_question: 中国电动汽车行业是否存在泡沫？如果存在，泡沫是否已经破裂或何时破裂？
AI.motivation: 中国电动汽车行业经历了爆炸式增长，从2018年500多家初创企业到现在仅剩100家左右，超过400家企业倒闭。怀疑论者认为这是泡沫破裂的迹象，但作者认为需要深入分析这种现象的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场泡沫理论、产业生命周期理论、市场整合理论、初创企业失败分析框架
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过分析六个典型的中国EV初创企业失败案例来论证观点
AI.findings: 中国EV初创企业大量倒闭并非泡沫破裂，而是市场健康整合的表现。这些失败企业大多存在技术不足、商业模式缺陷、资金管理不善等问题，而幸存企业则具备更强的竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 区分了市场泡沫与健康市场整合的概念差异；2) 提供了新兴产业早期发展阶段的分析框架；3) 挑战了单纯以企业倒闭数量判断行业泡沫的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助投资者和政策制定者正确理解中国EV行业的现状；2) 为初创企业提供失败教训；3) 为行业长期发展提供理性分析框架；4) 减少对补贴取消和关税壁垒的过度恐慌

detail.abstract: There is a systematic pattern in communication management across organisational tiers because of inherent differences in strategic intent, tactical translation, and operational action that yield varied loads of information, pacing, and relationship work. This article integrates findings about vertical and horizontal interactions in hierarchical networks, leadership styles influencing transparency, trust, and voice, and digital technology's mitigation of organisational friction while creating new challenges of co-ordination. While at the strategic organisational level, communicative clarity, rhythm, and strategic-level signalling have a crucial bearing upon unmediated downward communication, in the middle organisational level, boundary-spanning activities and actionable strategic translation through 'feedback-brokering' have a decisive influence upon strategy operationalisation through tactical planning, at the operational organisational level, dense micro-level lateral networks and psychologically-safe micro-level interaction routines have a pivotal influence upon grassroots knowledge operationalisation through collective action. Social network analysis research reveals that such effectiveness is less a product of organisational charts than of social bridges and organisational rhythms, while an analysis of internal organisational communication points out that such link symmetry is a determinant of public trust, while transparency and digital leadership best practice have a decisive influence upon public engagement, commitment, and innovation. Organisational-design takeaway is multi-level organisational logic in which top organisational charts and strategic rhythms need to be anchored while middle-level organisational routine work needs to be professionalised while at micro-levels of organisation sense-making micro-communities need to be developed in which social fluencies in digital platforms have a key influence upon organisational resilience in an uncertain business environment through increased signal integration, speed of decision-making, and co-ordination under uncertainty in business organised through such digital platforms (Josephs, Peng, & Crawford, 2022; Wen, Chen, Syed, & Ghataoura, 2025; Lee & Kim, 2021; Meske, Kissmer, & Stieglitz, 2020; Qin & Men, 2022; Kim, 2021; Barnes et al., 2023; Darics, 2020; Zorlu & Korkmaz, 2021; Bright, 2021).

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了组织层级间沟通管理的系统性模式，分析了战略、战术和操作层面的不同沟通需求，以及数字技术如何影响组织协调和韧性。
AI.research_question: 组织层级间的沟通管理如何因战略意图、战术转换和操作行动的内在差异而形成系统性模式？数字技术如何影响这种模式并塑造组织韧性？
AI.motivation: 组织沟通管理存在系统性差异，但现有研究缺乏对多层级沟通模式的整合分析。数字技术既缓解了组织摩擦又带来了新的协调挑战，需要深入理解这种复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合了层级网络理论、领导风格理论（透明度、信任、声音）、社会网络分析理论、组织设计理论和数字平台理论。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论整合方法，综合了多个相关研究（包括社会网络分析研究和内部组织沟通分析）。
AI.findings: 1) 战略层：沟通清晰度、节奏和战略信号对下行沟通至关重要；2) 中层：边界跨越活动和"反馈中介"对战略操作化有决定性影响；3) 操作层：密集的横向网络和心理安全互动对基层知识操作化至关重要；4) 组织有效性更多来自社会桥梁而非组织结构图；5) 数字领导力和透明度影响公众信任和参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多层次组织逻辑框架，整合了垂直和水平互动模式，强调了社会网络而非正式结构的重要性，发展了数字平台时代组织沟通的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计提供指导：高层需要锚定战略节奏，中层需要专业化常规工作，基层需要发展意义建构微社区，数字平台的社会流畅性对组织韧性有关键影响。

A particular emphasis is placed on the challenges endemic to large-scale pharmaceutical manufacturing hubs, such as India, which include an inherently fragmented logistics network, escalating operational costs, the significant risk associated with maintaining a robust cold chain for temperature-sensitive biologics, and the critical public health threat posed by counterfeit drugs infiltrating legitimate channels.

title: Schrödinger Bridges in Mathematical Finance: Theory, Applications, and Computational Methods
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Schrödinger Bridges in Mathematical Finance: Theory, Applications, and Computational Methods
detail.abstract: We present a comprehensive treatment of Schrödinger bridge problems in path space and their applications to mathematical finance. The Schrödinger bridge provides an entropy-regularized formulation of optimal transport over path measures that connects stochastic control theory with variational inference. We develop the mathematical foundations including existence and uniqueness via convex analysis, duality theory through the Fenchel-Rockafellar framework, and characterization via forward-backward stochastic differential equations. For core results (existence, factorization, FBSDE characterization), we provide complete proofs; for supporting results (duality, Sinkhorn convergence, asymptotics), we give detailed sketches with precise references. Applications include robust option pricing under entropic model uncertainty, volatility surface calibration via martingale Schrödinger bridges, and generative modeling of financial time series. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical framework: in 1D, Sinkhorn achieves 10-9 marginal error in 150 iterations with observed contraction rate ρ obs = 0.92 matching theory (ρ th = 0.905); in 2D portfolio problems, convergence to the optimal transport map achieves W 2 distance < 0.03 at ε = 0.01. Real-data calibration to SPY options demonstrates 52% price RMSE improvement using temperature-scaled importance weights with optimal β = 0.1.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了路径空间中的薛定谔桥问题及其在金融数学中的应用。薛定谔桥提供了路径测度上最优传输的熵正则化表述，连接了随机控制理论与变分推断。论文建立了完整的数学基础，包括存在唯一性、对偶理论、FBSDE表征，并应用于稳健期权定价、波动率曲面校准和金融时间序列生成建模。
AI.research_question: 路径空间中的薛定谔桥问题如何为金融数学中的模型不确定性、定价校准和时间序列建模提供理论框架和计算方法？
AI.motivation: 传统金融模型面临模型不确定性问题，需要稳健的定价和校准方法。薛定谔桥作为熵正则化的最优传输框架，能够连接随机控制理论和变分推断，为处理金融中的路径依赖问题和模型不确定性提供统一的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 薛定谔桥理论、最优传输理论、随机控制理论、变分推断、凸分析、Fenchel-Rockafellar对偶理论、前向-后向随机微分方程(FBSDE)
AI.method: 数学分析（凸分析、对偶理论）、FBSDE表征、Sinkhorn算法、数值实验（1D和2D问题）、实证校准（SPY期权数据）
AI.findings: 1. 建立了薛定谔桥的完整数学基础，证明了存在唯一性；2. 在1D问题中，Sinkhorn算法150次迭代达到10^-9边际误差，收缩率ρ_obs=0.92与理论值ρ_th=0.905匹配；3. 在2D投资组合问题中，ε=0.01时W2距离<0.03收敛到最优传输映射；4. 实际数据校准显示，使用温度缩放重要性权重（最优β=0.1）可将SPY期权价格RMSE改善52%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为路径空间薛定谔桥提供了完整的数学基础，包括存在唯一性证明；2. 建立了Fenchel-Rockafellar框架下的对偶理论；3. 发展了FBSDE表征方法；4. 将熵正则化最优传输与金融数学问题系统连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为稳健期权定价提供了基于熵模型不确定性的新方法；2. 开发了通过鞅薛定谔桥进行波动率曲面校准的技术；3. 提出了金融时间序列的生成建模框架；4. 提供了高效的Sinkhorn算法实现和数值验证。

title: Doping: The Endless Race and The Interplay of Substances, Systems, and Sporting Laws
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Doping: The Endless Race and The Interplay of Substances, Systems, and Sporting Laws
detail.abstract: This paper, “Doping: The Endless Race and the Interplay of Substances, Systems, and Sporting Laws,” examines the persistent challenge of doping in global sport and the legal frameworks that seek to combat it. It traces the evolution of anti-doping regulation from the early Olympic interventions to the establishment of the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and the World Anti-Doping Code. Through analysis of landmark cases and comparative perspectives from the United States, the United Kingdom, and Nigeria, the study evaluates the effectiveness of strict liability, the role of the Court of Arbitration for Sport, and the intersection of sports, contract, and employment law. Despite significant progress, the paper identifies enforcement gaps and ethical concerns that undermine deterrence. It concludes by proposing reforms aimed at building a preventive, technology-driven, and rights-based global anti-doping framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了全球体育中兴奋剂问题的持续挑战及反兴奋剂法律框架的发展，分析了从早期奥运干预到WADA和世界反兴奋剂条例的演变，通过美英尼日利亚案例评估严格责任、CAS作用及体育法、合同法、劳动法的交叉，指出执法漏洞和伦理问题，提出预防性、技术驱动、权利导向的改革建议。

AI.findings: 1. 反兴奋剂法律框架从奥运早期干预发展到WADA和世界反兴奋剂条例体系化；2. 严格责任原则在实践中存在执行问题；3. 体育仲裁法院(CAS)在争议解决中发挥关键作用；4. 体育法、合同法、劳动法交叉产生复杂法律问题；5. 当前体系存在执法漏洞和伦理问题，削弱威慑效果。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了当前反兴奋剂体系的执法漏洞；2. 提出了预防性、技术驱动的改革方案；3. 建议建立权利导向的全球反兴奋剂框架；4. 为政策制定者、体育组织和法律从业者提供实践指导。

title: Written Statement of Alexander J. Titus, PhD, Before the U.S. Senate AI Insight Forum on “Risk, Alignment, & Guarding Against Doomsday Scenarios”

detail.title: Written Statement of Alexander J. Titus, PhD, Before the U.S. Senate AI Insight Forum on “Risk, Alignment, & Guarding Against Doomsday Scenarios”
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is poised to transform every domain of science and society, but in the life sciences, it carries both extraordinary promise and unprecedented peril. In testimony before the U.S. Senate AI Insight Forum on “Risk, Alignment, & Guarding Against Doomsday Scenarios,” Dr. Alexander J. Titus argues for a refined, evidence-based approach to policy and governance of AI in biology. Drawing on his experience as Principal Scientist at the University of Southern California’s Information Sciences Institute and as the Department of Defense’s inaugural Principal Director for Biotechnology, Titus emphasizes the need to quantify AI-enabled biosecurity risks through empirical baselines that measure how much AI increases risk beyond existing capabilities. He introduces the concept of Violet Teaming—a multidisciplinary expansion of red teaming that integrates economists, ethicists, providers, and social scientists—to balance the trade-offs between innovation and risk mitigation. The testimony warns against both over- and under-stepping: overregulation that could hinder lifesaving advances in medicine, food security, and sustainability, and under-regulation that could fail to anticipate novel biological threats. Titus concludes that responsible progress depends on three imperatives: context-specific action, diverse stakeholder input, and systematic measurement of risk over time. The same AI systems that raise new threats, he notes, can also power autonomous science for rapid defense and response, making responsible deployment not only a matter of safety, but of national and global resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文主张采用基于证据的方法来治理生物学中的人工智能，提出了"紫队"概念来平衡创新与风险，强调需要量化AI带来的生物安全风险，避免过度或不足的监管。
AI.research_question: 如何制定有效的政策和治理框架来平衡人工智能在生命科学领域的创新潜力与生物安全风险？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在生命科学领域既带来革命性机遇，也带来前所未有的风险，需要建立科学的治理框架来平衡创新与安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于证据的政策制定、风险量化框架、紫队概念（多学科扩展的红队演练）、创新与风险缓解的权衡理论。
AI.method: 通过实证基线量化AI增强的生物安全风险，采用多学科参与的紫队方法，结合专家证词和政策分析。
AI.findings: 需要建立具体的风险测量基准来评估AI如何增加现有能力之外的风险；紫队方法能更好地平衡创新与安全；过度监管和监管不足都会带来问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"紫队"概念作为红队演练的多学科扩展；建立了AI生物安全风险量化的理论框架；发展了基于证据的AI治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的治理建议：情境化行动、多元利益相关者参与、系统性风险测量；展示了AI既能制造威胁也能用于快速防御的双重性。

detail.abstract: The Agricultural Stability Doctrine: Preventing the Global Protein Gap Horizon (2080) Through Soil Infrastructure and MycoGenesis® Serving as a companion paper to The Panama Canal Resilience Accord (PCRA), this Doctrine extends the principle of infrastructural diplomacy from hydrological systems to agricultural ecosystems, establishing that the same logic of regenerative stability which safeguards trade corridors through water can also secure food corridors through soil. This doctoral framework defines soil chemistry as Tier-1 national infrastructure—equal in strategic weight to energy, water, and transportation—by demonstrating its measurable influence on economic solvency, public health, and national security. The work introduces the MycoGenesis® soil-amendment system, a biologically regenerative technology that enhances feed-grain nutrient density and thereby restructures the economic logic of the U.S. beef market. Using integrated models across Harvard Economics, USDA, and RAND–Brookings frameworks, the Doctrine shows that soil restoration functions as a macroeconomic stabilizer, translating biochemical improvements in feed into verifiable gains in feed efficiency, carcass quality, and national GDP performance. Empirical data from USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) grid reports, FAO livestock statistics, and peer-reviewed feed-conversion studies reveal that MycoGenesis® adoption improves feed conversion ratios (FCR) by 10–20%, increases carcass nutrient density (CLA, selenium, α-tocopherol) by 25–50%, and raises per-head grid value by $336–588 under current U.S. pricing schedules. When scaled nationally, these gains yield an estimated $2–3 billion uplift in annual producer income and a 0.05–0.08% GDP increase while reducing healthcare expenditure associated with nutrient-deficiency-related disease by up to $7.4 billion per decade. The Doctrine integrates these outcomes within a legal and policy framework compliant with Homeland Security Presidential Directive-9 (HSPD-9) and Presidential Policy Directive-21 (PPD-21), thereby aligning agricultural modernization with federal critical-infrastructure mandates.

title: KENFO's Allocation and Social Firepower

detail.title: KENFO's Allocation and Social Firepower
detail.abstract: By long-term cashflow projections we investigate the probability that Germany's nuclear waste fund Kenfo, with €24.8 billion assets as of December 2024, can meet €106 billion liabilities to 2100. We propose an alternative target allocation ("BEST") that raises alternatives from 30% to 85%, including 50% private equity and other assets with ESG or systemic appeal. At median expectations, Kenfo covers 175% of liabilities, while BEST reaches 256%. Even in the 1 in 100 worst markets, coverage remains 88% for Kenfo and 114% for BEST. Large expected surpluses invite political pressure for early extraction. We analyze a rule-based mechanism that releases capital above discounted liabilities plus a buffer to safeguard full payment. With a 50% buffer, Kenfo begins extracting around 2044 (~€2b/year, €35b present value), while BEST starts in 2036 (~€2.9b/year, €69b present value). A higher buffer delays extraction but increases total payout. Stress tests confirm that BEST is consistently safer and more rewarding. We show how highreturn assets reduce risk over very long horizons and create systemic social firepower. Thus, allocation strategy is not merely portfolio management but a matter of public interest with intergenerational implications that inform debates on "Generationenkapital" or "Kinderkapital.

detail.abstract: This chapter introduces the CXO e-FIT™ Framework, a structured model to guide leadership in digitally evolving organizations. Based on a focused review of recent academic research and real-world case insights, the framework defines leadership through three behavioral domains: Foresight, Integration, and Transformation. These represent the ability to think ahead, work across functions, and lead meaningful change. The framework addresses key gaps in existing leadership literature, especially the lack of emphasis on mid-level roles and the need for practical, observable competencies. Designed for real-world use, it helps organizations strengthen leadership pipelines, support succession planning, and align leadership development with shifting business demands. Its adaptable structure makes it suitable across sectors while keeping attention on outcomes like agility, resilience, and purpose-led direction.

detail.title: Toward Outcome-System Finance: Reframing Sustainable Finance Architecture

detail.abstract:
Global sustainable finance has expanded rapidly, yet its underlying architecture remains fragmented and inconsistent in linking capital flows to measurable climate and development outcomes. Current taxonomies and financing instruments largely rely on input-or label-based classifications (e.g., "green," "sustainable," "transition"), which signal intentions but do not consistently reflect real-economy results, systemic resilience, or longterm planetary value.

This misalignment between financial labeling and outcome-based climate logic-embedded in frameworks such as the Paris Agreement, national climate pathways, and global resilience mechanisms-has created structural inefficiencies in capital allocation, credibility gaps in sustainable finance markets, and persistent risks of greenwashing and impact dilution. 

This paper proposes a conceptual reframing of sustainable finance toward a functional, outcomes-first architecture grounded in climate and development system logic. Rather than introducing a proprietary framework, the paper synthesizes existing international structures, emerging regulatory trends, and climate-finance theory to argue for a global shift from input-designation to impact-orientation. The discussion explores theoretical foundations for aligning financial classification with mitigation, adaptation, and systemic resilience functions, while emphasizing the need for transparent measurement, feedback loops, and institutional cooperation between sovereigns, multilateral institutions, and private capital. This conceptual contribution aims to support ongoing academic and policy discourse on sustainable finance reform by articulating the gap between current market practice and system-level climate requirements, and by outlining directions for future empirical research, quantitative validation, and policy experimentation. The paper does not prescribe a finalized model; instead, it positions this work as a foundation for collaborative inquiry on how capital systems can more effectively reflect and accelerate global sustainability outcomes.

detail.abstract: Education systems serve various purposes, including the enhancement of later-life health, though its effect can differ by socio-political regime. This paper examines the effects of exposure to communist education, which exposed children to a distinct curcurriculum and ideological content on later-life health. We exploit a novel dataset that collects information on compulsory education reforms in several European countries, with different cohorts exposed and unexposed to Soviet communist education. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) design, we show that while the extension of compulsory education improved some relevant measures of health, communist education encompassed an additional health-enhancing effect. We document that the effect remains robust when using staggered DiD approaches and various robustness tests, and that it is explained by the priority given to physical education in school curricula, together with an increased likelihood of marriage.

detail.abstract: The expansion of remote job opportunities (RJOs) has decoupled employment from residential location, creating new possibilities for mobility but uncertain implications for migration. This paper examines how the expansion of RJOs shapes internal mobility in the United States. RJOs influence migration in two contrasting ways. They give new freedom to people who were previously tied to their job's location, making it possible to move without losing employment, but they also reduce moves that once occurred solely for career advancement. Using microdata on 11.5 million individuals from the American Community Survey, I estimate a shift-share instrumental variable within a recursive bivariate probit framework. The results show that RJOs decrease interstate migration by 33.9 percent, while increasing moves between local labor markets by 24 percent and within local labor markets by 49.2 percent. Taken together, the findings suggest that remote job opportunities make people's lives more flexible in two ways: they open doors for those who once felt tied to a place but wanted to move, and they let others stay where they feel rooted without sacrificing career options. In this sense, remote work reshapes mobility not by pushing people farther, but by giving them more control over where they live.

title: Climate Related Loss and Damages Tariff Support Program: Using Trade Concessions as a Mechanism for Climate Justice

detail.title: Climate Related Loss and Damages Tariff Support Program: Using Trade Concessions as a Mechanism for Climate Justice
detail.abstract:
Despite collective efforts to reduce emissions and build adaptive capacity developing countries continue to bear the greatest burden of climate change. Climate-related losses and damages will exceed what the current climate finance framework can address. After COP27, the Funding for Responding to Loss and Damages (FRLD) was developed with initial commitments of $800 million, but as the scale of climate related losses and damages grows, these commitments will likely fall short. To be transformative, FRLD needs to go beyond traditional modalities of climate finance and grants. 

This brief proposes that FRLD commitments not only include cash contributions but also include tariff concessions for FRLD-eligible countries. Many developing countries face high tariffs on key exports, such as agriculture, fisheries, and apparel. These restrict their growth potential and reduce the demand for their products. Lowering, if not eliminating, tariffs could increase income, investment, and jobs while providing governments a larger revenue base. This expanded fiscal space can support national loss and damage plans, further contribute to adaptation and mitigation efforts, and help overall economic development. This proposed mechanism can serve as a form of climate solidarity and economic-reparation from high-emitting developed countries to help achieve a more climate-equitable future.

AI.tldr: 该简报提出，应对损失与损害的资金（FRLD）不仅应包括现金捐款，还应包括对符合条件的国家的关税减让，以此作为气候团结和经济补偿的形式，帮助发展中国家应对气候变化损失。
AI.research_question: 如何使应对损失与损害的资金（FRLD）更具变革性，超越传统的气候融资和赠款模式？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球努力减少排放和建立适应能力，发展中国家仍承受着气候变化的最大负担。气候相关损失和损害将超过当前气候融资框架的应对能力。COP27后建立的FRLD初始承诺800亿美元，但随着损失规模扩大，这些承诺可能不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候正义理论、经济补偿理论、气候融资创新理论、发展经济学中的贸易与增长关系理论。
AI.method: 政策简报/概念性分析，基于现有气候融资框架和贸易政策的分析，提出创新的融资机制建议。
AI.findings: 关税减让可以增加发展中国家的收入、投资和就业，为政府提供更大的财政收入基础，从而支持国家损失与损害计划，促进适应和减缓努力，并帮助整体经济发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将贸易政策与气候融资相结合的新理论框架，扩展了气候正义理论，为气候补偿提供了新的实施路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FRLD提供了具体的实施建议：包括关税减让作为资金承诺的一部分；为高排放发达国家提供了实现气候团结和经济补偿的具体机制；为发展中国家创造了更大的财政空间来应对气候变化。

detail.title: The Jurisdictional Conundrum of Withholding Tax on Corporate Director Fees in Nigeria: A Statutory and Agency Theory Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study
