declarations.funderStatement: This study was solely funded by the author. The author would appreciate any financial support for the research project. This has become necessary considering the high cost of carrying out research in Nigeria.

detail.abstract: The Nigerian tax landscape is critically challenged by a persistent jurisdictional ambiguity regarding the correct remittance of Withholding Tax (WHT) on fees paid for corporate directorship services. This dilemma arises from the inherent duality in the nation's tax administration, pitting the Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS), which governs corporate income (Companies Income Tax, or CIT), against the State Internal Revenue Service (SIRS), which administers personal income (Personal Income Tax, or PIT). This regulatory conflict is further compounded by the structural limitation in the Companies and Allied Matters Act (CAMA), which formally recognizes only individual directors, raising the fundamental legal and administrative conundrum: Should WHT remittance follow the corporate recipient's legal status or the individual agent's performance? Incorrect remittance exposes businesses to significant compliance risks, including penalties and the critical nullification of tax credits. This study provides a conclusive resolution, establishing that Corporate Directorship WHT is exclusively remitted to the FIRS. The main objective is achieved through a rigorous, multi-faceted analysis structured around four key areas: Statutory Analysis, Theoretical Justification, Judicial and Administrative Resolution, and Compliance Guidance. The research employs Agency Theory (Jensen & Meckling, 1976) to define the economic relationship, confirming that the WHT must follow the fee's beneficial owner-the corporate Principal's CIT liability. Findings based on the supremacy of tax statutes and judicial precedent (e.g., Investment Holdings Limited (IHL) v. FIRS, 2022) affirm this jurisdiction and underscore its necessity for the functional integrity of the tax credit system. The conclusion asserts that FIRS jurisdiction is legally sound, theoretically robust, and administratively necessary. The work recommends legislative harmonization of CAMA and tax laws, provides definitive compliance recommendations for all stakeholders, and proposes further empirical research to quantify the economic costs of this persistent jurisdictional conflict.

AI.tldr: 该研究解决了尼日利亚关于公司董事服务费预扣税（WHT）应向联邦税务局（FIRS）还是州税务局（SIRS）缴纳的管辖权争议，通过法律、理论和司法分析，最终确定应独家向FIRS缴纳。
AI.research_question: 公司董事服务费的预扣税（WHT）应缴纳给联邦税务局（FIRS）还是州税务局（SIRS）？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚税收体系中存在管辖权模糊问题，联邦税务局（管理公司所得税）与州税务局（管理个人所得税）在董事服务费预扣税缴纳上存在冲突，导致企业面临合规风险、罚款和税收抵免无效化等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论（Jensen & Meckling, 1976）用于分析经济关系，确认预扣税应跟随费用的受益所有人——即公司委托人（Principal）的公司所得税责任。
AI.method: 采用多层面分析方法，包括：法规分析、理论论证、司法和行政决议分析、合规指导。
AI.findings: 基于税法至上原则和司法先例（如Investment Holdings Limited v. FIRS, 2022），确认公司董事服务费预扣税应独家向联邦税务局（FIRS）缴纳，这对税收抵免系统的功能完整性至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代理理论应用于税收管辖权分析，为理解公司董事服务的经济关系提供了理论框架，明确了预扣税应跟随受益所有人的公司所得税责任。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了明确的合规指导，建议立法协调《公司和相关事务法》与税法，并提出了量化管辖权冲突经济成本的实证研究方向。

title: An Empirical Analysis of the Inverse Volatility Weighted Top-5 Crypto Index (AXIS): A Comparison with MCW Cap40 and SOL Buy-and-Hold
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: An Empirical Analysis of the Inverse Volatility Weighted Top-5 Crypto Index (AXIS): A Comparison with MCW Cap40 and SOL Buy-and-Hold

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this study. Any errors are my own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzes publicly available market data and software-generated outputs only; it involved no human participants or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted using the author’s own resources.

detail.abstract: This paper studies a risk-aware crypto index construction, the AXIS strategy, which selects the top-5 assets by market capitalization and assigns weights via inverse volatility weighting (IVW) with quarterly rebalancing. We compare AXIS against a capped market-cap-weighted competitor (MCW Cap40, 40% cap per asset) and a buy-and-hold SOL benchmark using five-year empirical daily time series. Results show that AXIS achieves a higher Sharpe ratio than MCW Cap40 (2.6223 vs 2.3683) and lower concentration (average HHI 0.2163 vs 0.3216) while maintaining competitive upside capture (0.4666 vs 0.4314, relative to BTC) and comparable downside capture. Although SOL buy-and-hold dominates absolute returns in a strong bull regime, its extreme drawdowns and volatility (MaxDD-96.18%, AnnVol 281.29%) highlight the benefit of risk-aware indexing. Robustness checks across volatility windows, top-K breadth, and turnover controls support the economic intuition of IVW: adapt to changing risk to preserve diversification without excessive trading.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了AXIS加密货币指数构建策略，通过市值前5资产和逆波动率加权，在五年实证数据中显示出比市值加权策略更高的夏普比率和更低的集中度，同时保持了有竞争力的上行捕获能力。
AI.research_question: 风险感知的加密货币指数构建策略（AXIS）在风险调整后收益、集中度和市场捕获能力方面是否优于传统的市值加权策略和单一资产持有策略？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场的高波动性和集中度风险需要更稳健的指数构建方法，传统市值加权策略在加密领域可能面临过度集中和风险暴露问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于现代投资组合理论的风险分散原则，结合逆波动率加权（IVW）的风险平价思想，以及市值筛选的流动性考量。
AI.method: 使用五年日度时间序列数据，比较AXIS策略（市值前5资产+逆波动率加权+季度再平衡）与市值加权策略（MCW Cap40，单资产上限40%）和SOL单一资产持有策略。
AI.findings: AXIS策略夏普比率更高（2.6223 vs 2.3683），集中度更低（HHI 0.2163 vs 0.3216），上行捕获能力相当（0.4666 vs 0.4314），且下行保护良好。SOL策略在牛市绝对收益更高但波动极大（最大回撤-96.18%，年化波动281.29%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了逆波动率加权在加密货币指数构建中的有效性，提供了风险感知指数设计的理论框架，证明了风险调整优于单纯市值加权。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币投资者提供了实用的指数构建方法，通过AXIS策略可以在保持收益能力的同时降低风险和集中度，适合机构投资者和指数产品设计。

title: Defining the Value Transfer Tax (VTT) and Its Macroeconomic Implications: A Transaction-Based Fiscal Framework for Modern Economies -Case Finland
affiliations: VAMK University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Defining the Value Transfer Tax (VTT) and Its Macroeconomic Implications: A Transaction-Based Fiscal Framework for Modern Economies -Case Finland

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: This foundational paper formally introduces the Value Transfer Tax (VTT), a universal fiscal mechanism levied as a fixed percentage on all payment transactions between distinct account-holders. The tax base is the Gross Transaction Product (GTP), defined by the author in Defining Gross Transaction Product (GTP) (Salonen, 2025) as the total monetary value of all inter-account transfers within an economy. Empirical analysis for Finland indicates that GTP lies in the range €3.55-€3.82 trillion, based on both component-based and payment-system aggregation methods. This magnitude-approximately 13-14× GDP-enables VTT to replace income tax, VAT, corporate tax, capital taxes, and municipal taxation at a realistic tax rate of 4-6%. The paper analyses how VTT affects GDP via consumption, investment, public spending, and net exports, demonstrating that a VTT-based system provides a structurally expansionary macroeconomic framework for Finland.

AI.tldr: 本文正式引入价值转移税（VTT），这是一种对所有不同账户持有人之间的支付交易征收固定百分比的通用财政机制。税基为总交易产品（GTP），即经济体内所有账户间转移的货币总值。芬兰实证分析显示GTP约为3.55-3.82万亿欧元，是GDP的13-14倍，使得4-6%的VTT税率可替代所得税、增值税、公司税、资本税和市政税。VTT通过消费、投资、公共支出和净出口影响GDP，为芬兰提供结构性扩张的宏观经济框架。
AI.research_question: 价值转移税（VTT）作为替代传统税制的通用财政机制，能否在现实税率下有效替代芬兰现有的所得税、增值税、公司税、资本税和市政税，并创造结构性扩张的宏观经济框架？
AI.motivation: 传统税制复杂且效率低下，需要简化税收体系。通过引入基于总交易产品（GTP）的价值转移税，可以创建一个更简单、更高效的税收系统，同时为经济增长提供结构性支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于总交易产品（GTP）理论，该理论衡量经济中所有账户间货币转移的总价值。价值转移税（VTT）作为通用财政机制的理论框架，以及税收对宏观经济变量（消费、投资、公共支出、净出口）影响的经济理论。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，使用芬兰数据通过两种方法计算GTP：基于组件的计算方法和支付系统汇总方法。进行宏观经济分析，评估VTT对GDP各组成部分（消费、投资、公共支出、净出口）的影响。
AI.findings: 芬兰的GTP在3.55-3.82万亿欧元之间，约为GDP的13-14倍。这一规模使得4-6%的VTT税率足以替代所有主要税种。VTT系统通过影响消费、投资、公共支出和净出口，为芬兰经济提供了结构性扩张的宏观经济框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式引入价值转移税（VTT）作为通用财政机制的理论概念；建立了基于总交易产品（GTP）的税收基础理论；提出了通过单一税种替代复杂多税制系统的理论框架；发展了VTT对宏观经济影响的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为芬兰提供了简化税制的具体实施方案；展示了4-6%的VTT税率可替代所有主要税种的可行性；提供了结构性扩张的宏观经济政策框架；为其他国家考虑税制改革提供了实证参考。

title: Negative Vote Mobilizes Disaffected Voters and Corrects Wrong Winners

detail.title: Negative Vote Mobilizes Disaffected Voters and Corrects Wrong Winners

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author founded Negative Vote Association, the NGO which is the main sponsor of the empirical studies cited in this paper. The author is the main financial supporter of the NGO.
declarations.funderStatement: The author founded Negative Vote Association, the NGO which is the main finanical sponsor of the empirical studies cited in this paper. The author is the main financial supporter of the NGO.

detail.abstract: Modern democracy derives its legitimacy from the consent of the governed, yet its electoral systems provide no formal mechanism to withhold that consent. This structural deficit fuels polarization, non-participation, and false mandates. We introduce the Negative Vote-a system allowing voters to cast either YES for a candidate or NO against one-and present cross-national survey evidence that this power to reject mobilizes disaffected voters. Data from eight independent surveys in Taiwan and the United States show that formalizing dissent increases participation by 4-10 percentage points. This increased participation, driven by previously disengaged centrists, may correct "wrong winner" outcomes in close elections and incentivizes candidates to appeal beyond their partisan base. We argue that the right to formally reject candidates is fundamental to democratic legitimacy and demonstrate its practical feasibility through international precedents. Negative Vote satisfies all five of Arrow's fairness criteria, making logically consistent democratic aggregation mathematically achievable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"负投票"系统，允许选民投赞成票或反对票，通过跨国民调证据显示这种拒绝权能动员不满选民，提高参与度4-10个百分点，可能纠正选举结果并激励候选人超越党派基础。
AI.research_question: 负投票系统如何影响选民参与度和选举结果？正式化的反对权是否能提高民主合法性并减少极化？
AI.motivation: 现代民主制度缺乏正式机制让选民撤回同意，导致极化、不参与和虚假授权问题，需要结构性改革来增强民主合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主合法性理论、选举系统设计理论、阿罗不可能定理（负投票满足所有五个公平标准）、选民行为理论。
AI.method: 跨国民意调查方法，在台湾和美国进行八项独立调查，分析负投票对选民参与度和选举结果的影响。
AI.findings: 正式化反对权使选民参与度提高4-10个百分点；动员了先前不参与的中立选民；可能纠正"错误赢家"结果；激励候选人超越党派基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出负投票作为民主合法性基本权利的理论框架；证明负投票满足阿罗所有五个公平标准，实现逻辑一致的民主聚合；扩展选举系统设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可实施的选举改革方案；通过国际先例证明可行性；为减少极化和提高参与度提供具体政策建议；改善选举结果代表性。

title: Subsidized Grains and Market Prices: Assessing the Inflationary Impact of India's Food Security Policies
affiliations: University of Delhi, Delhi School of Economics, Delhi School of Economics and Delhi School of Economics

detail.title: Subsidized Grains and Market Prices: Assessing the Inflationary Impact of India's Food Security Policies
detail.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the multidimensional impact of India's food procurement and distribution policies as specified under the National Food Security Act on food inflation. We distinguish between two channels of transmission: a direct effect, in which government intervention alters market supply, and hence prices of food grains, and an indirect effect, in which subsidized food distribution influences household spending patterns, exerting demand-side pressures on inflation-sensitive commodities. Using a Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) to compute the direct effect for the period 2014-2025, we find no significant direct long-run or short-run relationship between food subsidies and food inflation. However, in our household-level analysis using HCES consumption data for the year 2022-23, we find that Public Distribution System (PDS) beneficiaries tend to spend significantly more on inflation-sensitive items such as pulses, edible oils, milk, and vegetables (tomatoes, onions, and potatoes). These findings point to structural shifts in consumption behavior induced by welfare provisioning, with economically significant implications for market prices and inflation management.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度《国家粮食安全法》下的粮食采购和分配政策对食品通胀的多维影响，发现直接效应不显著，但间接效应通过改变家庭消费模式对通胀敏感商品产生需求压力。
AI.research_question: 印度《国家粮食安全法》下的粮食采购和分配政策如何通过直接和间接渠道影响食品通胀？
AI.motivation: 理解福利政策（如粮食补贴）对通胀的复杂影响机制，特别是直接市场干预和间接消费行为改变的双重作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于直接效应（政府干预改变市场供给）和间接效应（补贴分配改变家庭支出模式）的双渠道传导理论框架。
AI.method: 使用向量误差修正模型（VECM）分析2014-2025年期间的直接效应；使用2022-23年家庭消费支出调查（HCES）数据进行家庭层面分析。
AI.findings: 1. 直接效应：食品补贴与食品通胀之间没有显著的长短期关系；2. 间接效应：公共分配系统（PDS）受益者在通胀敏感商品（豆类、食用油、牛奶、蔬菜等）上的支出显著更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了福利政策影响通胀的双渠道理论框架，区分了直接市场干预效应和间接消费行为改变效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：虽然直接补贴可能不会立即推高通胀，但通过改变消费模式可能对特定商品产生需求压力，需要更精细化的通胀管理策略。

title: Redefining Consumer Welfare through Article 101(3): The Case of Horizontal Sustainability Agreements
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Redefining Consumer Welfare through Article 101(3): The Case of Horizontal Sustainability Agreements

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No relationship with people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.funderStatement: Personally funded.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of Article 101(3) TFEU in relation to horizontal sustainability agreements against the backdrop of an expanding approach to the objectives of EU competition law. It first outlines the prohibition and exemption framework governing horizontal agreements. It then provides a historical and systematic analysis of enforcement practice and case-law. The final section discusses recent developments concerning the interpretation and application of Article 101(3). The paper seeks to clarify the scope and operation of this exemption and is primarily intended for students engaging with EU competition law.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧盟竞争法目标扩展背景下，TFEU第101(3)条对横向可持续发展协议的作用，分析了禁止与豁免框架、执法实践和判例法，并讨论了该条款解释和应用的最新发展。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟竞争法目标不断扩展的背景下，TFEU第101(3)条如何适用于横向可持续发展协议？
AI.motivation: 随着欧盟竞争法目标从单纯的经济效率扩展到包括可持续发展等更广泛的社会目标，需要澄清第101(3)条在横向可持续发展协议中的适用范围和操作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法理论框架，特别是TFEU第101条关于禁止反竞争协议的规定，以及第101(3)条的豁免条件理论。
AI.method: 采用历史分析和系统分析方法，研究执法实践和判例法的发展，并结合最新法律解释和应用进行讨论。
AI.findings: 论文澄清了第101(3)条在横向可持续发展协议中的适用范围和操作机制，分析了执法实践和判例法的发展趋势，以及该条款解释的最新进展。
AI.theory_contributions: 为欧盟竞争法理论提供了关于第101(3)条在横向可持续发展协议中应用的系统分析，丰富了竞争法目标扩展背景下的豁免理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实践者、政策制定者和学生提供了关于横向可持续发展协议如何通过第101(3)条获得豁免的实用指导，有助于理解和应用相关法律框架。

title: The Thermodynamics of Structural Stability: A Unified Framework for Memory, Meaning, and Failure Modes from Brains to Large Language Models to Institutions
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Thermodynamics of Structural Stability: A Unified Framework for Memory, Meaning, and Failure Modes from Brains to Large Language Models to Institutions
detail.abstract: Maintenance cost, governed by structural symmetry, determines which information survives under resource constraints. Information-bearing systems exhibit parallel failure patterns across radically different substrates: brains forget facts before concepts, large language models hallucinate under extended context, and institutions collapse when regulatory complexity exceeds enforcement capacity. This paper proposes that these phenomena share a common thermodynamic explanation. We introduce the Structural Stability Ratio: where is a system's maintenance budget and is the maintenance cost of each informational primitive. We propose that maintenance cost is inversely proportional to structural symmetry-the number of independent reconstruction paths available to regenerate a primitive: This framework generates testable predictions: concepts (high symmetry) should outlast facts (low symmetry); LLM hallucinations should exhibit phase-transition dynamics at critical context lengths; institutions should fail in predictable sequences as complexity accumulates. We describe toy models that would illustrate these dynamics and outline an empirical program for validation across human memory, AI systems, institutional behavior, and educational design. This is a theoretical framework paper. No experiments have been conducted. Our contribution is the formal apparatus and the experimental program it motivates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于热力学的理论框架，认为信息系统的维护成本由结构对称性决定，这解释了大脑遗忘、大语言模型幻觉和制度崩溃等跨领域现象的共性模式。
AI.research_question: 不同信息系统（大脑、大语言模型、制度）中观察到的并行失效模式是否共享一个基于结构对称性和维护成本的热力学解释？
AI.motivation: 观察到不同基质的信息系统表现出相似的失效模式：大脑先遗忘事实后遗忘概念，大语言模型在长上下文下产生幻觉，制度在监管复杂性超过执行能力时崩溃。这些现象需要一个统一的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于热力学的信息维护理论，引入结构稳定性比率（SSR），其中维护成本与结构对称性成反比。结构对称性定义为可用于重建信息原语的独立路径数量。
AI.method: 理论框架论文，未进行实验。方法包括：1）提出形式化理论框架；2）构建玩具模型说明动态机制；3）设计跨领域（人类记忆、AI系统、制度行为、教育设计）的实证验证方案。
AI.findings: 作为理论框架论文，没有实证结果。但提出了可检验的预测：1）概念（高对称性）比事实（低对称性）更持久；2）LLM幻觉在临界上下文长度呈现相变动态；3）制度随复杂性积累以可预测序列失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了跨领域信息系统失效的统一热力学解释框架；2）形式化定义了结构稳定性比率和维护成本与结构对称性的关系；3）建立了信息持久性与结构对称性的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为设计更稳健的AI系统提供理论指导；2）为制度设计和监管提供预测框架；3）为教育内容设计（优化信息持久性）提供原则；4）激发跨多个领域的实证研究项目。

title: Strategic Thinking -What Have We Learned So Far?

detail.title: Strategic Thinking -What Have We Learned So Far?
detail.abstract: Strategic thinking as the buzz word has been around in the literature of strategic management for almost a half of the century. Systemic content literature approach performed on the body of scientific literature reveals several layers and perspectives of approaching strategic thinking. By consulting respectful databases, selecting strategic thinking literature and excluding military perspective, there are a number of avenues for strategic thinking. Some of the researchers claim that we know a lot about strategic thinking, some claim that it is still a black box phenomenon. Strategic Thinking as the phenomena could be looked from the human resource perspective needed as the key capability for top management. According to the phases of developing strategic management, it could be looked at from a strategic cognitive perspective as the way top management confront challenges in their own head. Additionally strategic thinking could be viewed as the dynamic capability, resource needed for all employees in the firm. The results of the review indicate three distinctive sections based on timeline (embryo stage publications, the diversified stage publications and the focused stage publications), the second one with three additional subsections based on the topics (educational stream, leadership, game theory, business acumen and cognitive stream). Each one is fueled with key areas suggested for future research. The key results are that strategic thinking desperately needs to go deep in the epistemology and ontology and find an anchor to the existing well received knowledge in order for strategic thinking to find its roots and solid grounding foundations. Key question this paper is answering is what we have learned about strategic thinking so far.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述方法，梳理了近半个世纪战略思维研究的发展脉络，识别出三个发展阶段和多个研究主题，指出战略思维研究需要在认识论和本体论层面深化，以建立坚实的理论基础。
AI.research_question: 迄今为止我们对战略思维了解到了什么？
AI.motivation: 战略思维作为战略管理领域的热门概念已存在近半个世纪，但学界对其理解仍存在分歧：一些研究者认为我们已经了解很多，另一些则认为它仍是"黑箱"现象。这种认知差异促使作者进行系统性文献综述，以厘清战略思维的研究现状和发展脉络。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略思维可以从多个理论视角理解：1)人力资源视角（作为高层管理者的关键能力）；2)战略认知视角（高层管理者应对挑战的思维方式）；3)动态能力视角（作为组织所有员工所需的资源）。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，通过检索权威数据库，筛选战略思维相关文献（排除军事视角），对科学文献进行内容分析，识别研究层次和视角。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1)按时间线分为三个阶段（胚胎阶段、多样化阶段、聚焦阶段）；2)按主题分为五个子领域（教育流、领导力、博弈论、商业敏锐度、认知流）；3)战略思维研究需要在认识论和本体论层面深化，与现有成熟知识建立联系，才能获得坚实的理论基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1)首次系统梳理战略思维研究的发展阶段和主题分类；2)识别了战略思维的多维理论视角；3)指出了战略思维研究在认识论和本体论层面的理论缺口；4)为未来研究提供了明确的方向指引。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1)帮助管理者理解战略思维的不同维度；2)为组织培养战略思维能力提供理论指导；3)为企业人力资源开发提供框架；4)为战略思维培训和教育项目设计提供参考。

title: Orchestrating Interdependent Infrastructure Post-Disaster Recovery
affiliations: Tsinghua univeristy, Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Orchestrating Interdependent Infrastructure Post-Disaster Recovery
detail.abstract: The increasing frequency of natural disasters necessitates not only physically robust infrastructure but also resilient managerial strategies for post-disaster recovery. However, the recovery of interdependent infrastructure networks (e.g., power and gas) is often hindered by decentralized governance and conflicting stakeholder interests. While the static Stackelberg game offers a necessary departure from centralized planning by capturing real-world asymmetric hierarchical interactions, we argue that the rigid fixed leadership assumption in the dynamic recovery process inherently limits system-wide efficiency. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel Incentive Stackelberg Game framework that incorporates a dynamic leadership transfer mechanism. This mechanism utilizes a transfer payment contract to flexibly align incentives, allowing the follower to assume leadership when it yields a coordination surplus. To address the computational intractability of the resulting Mixed-Integer Bilevel Linear Program (MIBLP), we develop a tailored exact algorithm, ZeroCore-Branch-and-Bound, which exploits the problem's "equivalent response" structural property to prune the search space significantly. Calibrated with real-world data from Shelby County, our analysis yields critical managerial insights. First, we identify a crucial "early window of opportunity" where coordination is most valuable. Second, contrary to the intuition that coordination is a remedy for scarcity, we find that resource abundance actually amplifies the value of strategic coordination by unlocking complex, synergistic recovery paths. Finally, we demonstrate that the proposed mechanism remains robust under dynamic risks such as earthquake aftershocks, offering a viable pathway for orchestrating resilient infrastructure recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的激励Stackelberg博弈框架，通过动态领导权转移机制和转移支付合同来协调基础设施网络灾后恢复中的利益冲突，解决了传统静态领导结构效率低下的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在去中心化治理和利益冲突的背景下，通过动态领导权转移机制提高相互依赖基础设施网络（如电力和天然气）灾后恢复的系统效率？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害频发需要物理上稳健的基础设施和灾后恢复的弹性管理策略。然而，相互依赖的基础设施网络恢复常因去中心化治理和利益相关者冲突而受阻。传统的静态Stackelberg博弈虽然能捕捉现实世界的不对称层级互动，但其固定的领导假设在动态恢复过程中限制了系统效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stackelberg博弈理论、激励协调机制、动态领导权转移、转移支付合同、混合整数双层线性规划（MIBLP）
AI.method: 提出激励Stackelberg博弈框架，包含动态领导权转移机制；开发ZeroCore-Branch-and-Bound精确算法解决计算难题；使用谢尔比县真实数据进行校准分析。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出协调价值最大的"早期机会窗口"；2. 资源丰富反而会放大战略协调的价值（与稀缺条件下协调是补救措施的直觉相反）；3. 所提机制在地震余震等动态风险下保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展Stackelberg博弈理论，引入动态领导权转移机制；2. 提出激励协调框架解决基础设施恢复中的利益冲突；3. 开发针对MIBLP问题的创新算法ZeroCore-Branch-and-Bound。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为基础设施管理者提供动态协调机制；2. 识别最佳协调时机（早期机会窗口）；3. 证明机制在动态风险下的稳健性；4. 提供可实施的灾后恢复协调路径。

title: Who Really Pays? Reevaluating the Corporate Tax Burden
affiliations: George Mason University - Mercatus Center

detail.title: Who Really Pays? Reevaluating the Corporate Tax Burden
detail.abstract: The incidence of corporate taxation remains a pivotal question in public finance. Many budgetary scoring agencies assume that corporate taxes are primarily borne by capital owners, but empirical evidence increasingly challenges this view. The bulk of empirical studies suggests that labor, particularly in open economies, may bear a substantial share of the corporate tax burden through reduced wages and employment opportunities. This article synthesizes existing theoretical and empirical literature on corporate tax incidence, evaluating crosscountry , country-specific, and firm-level studies. By reassessing traditional assumptions, the analysis highlights the economic consequences of corporate taxation for workers and consumers. Corporate income taxes are often assumed to be a tax on capital. This view underpins much of tax policy: Policymakers argue that corporations and their shareholders should bear the tax burden. Institutions such as the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) allocate a significant portion of the corporate tax burden to capital, estimating that approximately 75 percent of the burden falls on capital owners. The Joint Committee on Taxation (JCT) makes the same assumption, while the Department of the Treasury estimates that capital bears an even larger share of the corporate tax burden-82 percent. However, these estimates are increasingly at odds with empirical evidence suggesting that labor bears a larger portion of the corporate tax burden than previously assumed. This article critically examines the theoretical underpinnings and empirical findings regarding the incidence of corporate taxation, advocating for a reevaluation of the policy assumptions employed by key economic institutions. First, an overview is provided of the theoretical framework for understanding corporate tax incidence; second, empirical studies at the crosscountry , countryspecific, and firm levels are presented and analyzed; and finally, the implications of these findings for tax policy are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了公司税负归宿的理论与实证研究，挑战了传统认为公司税主要由资本所有者承担的观点，指出在开放经济中劳动力可能承担更大份额的税负。
AI.research_question: 公司税负的实际归宿是什么？劳动力是否承担了比传统假设更大的公司税负份额？
AI.motivation: 传统预算评估机构（如CBO、JCT、财政部）假设公司税主要由资本所有者承担（75-82%），但越来越多的实证证据表明这一假设可能不准确，劳动力可能承担更大份额的税负，这对税收政策制定有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司税负归宿理论框架，包括传统资本承担假设、开放经济中的税负转嫁理论、以及劳动力承担税负的机制（通过工资下降和就业机会减少）。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统分析三类实证研究：1)跨国比较研究；2)国别特定研究；3)企业层面研究。
AI.findings: 实证研究表明，特别是在开放经济中，劳动力承担了比传统假设更大的公司税负份额。公司税通过降低工资和减少就业机会的方式转嫁给劳动者。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的公司税负归宿理论，提出了在全球化背景下劳动力承担税负的新理论视角，为重新评估税收政策假设提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁重新评估主要经济机构（如CBO、JCT、财政部）使用的政策假设，为更公平有效的税收政策制定提供实证依据，有助于政策制定者更准确地理解公司税的经济后果。

title: Climate Change: Its Effect on Agricultural Business Productivity in Rural Areas in the Philippines
affiliations: Bukidnon State University, Bukidnon State University and Bukidnon State University

detail.title: Climate Change: Its Effect on Agricultural Business Productivity in Rural Areas in the Philippines
detail.abstract: This research paper explores the impacts of climate change on agricultural productivity in Talisayan, Misamis Oriental, Philippines, focusing on corn and vegetable crops. The study, which used a descriptive and correlational research design involving questionnaires and a four-point Likert scale, surveyed a random sample of 92 farmers to determine the correlation between rising temperatures and rainfall levels and their effects on crop yields, sales revenue, and production costs. The data analysis revealed a significant correlation between climate change factors and agricultural productivity, with temperature increases and irregular rainfall patterns negatively impacting these key agricultural outcomes. The study concludes that climate change poses a significant challenge to the agricultural sector in Talisayan, emphasizing the need for farmers to adopt climate-resilient farming practices and for policymakers to implement support systems to enhance the sector's resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了气候变化对菲律宾塔利萨扬地区农业生产力（玉米和蔬菜作物）的影响，发现温度升高和降雨模式不规则与作物产量、销售收入和生产成本显著相关，建议农民采用气候适应性农业实践，政策制定者实施支持系统。
AI.research_question: 气候变化（温度升高和降雨模式变化）如何影响菲律宾塔利萨扬地区玉米和蔬菜作物的农业生产力（包括作物产量、销售收入和生产成本）？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对农业部门构成重大挑战，特别是在发展中国家如菲律宾。了解气候变化对特定地区（塔利萨扬）特定作物（玉米和蔬菜）的具体影响，对于制定有效的适应策略和支持政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化与农业生产力关系的理论框架，关注温度、降雨等气候变量如何通过生理过程、病虫害压力、水资源可用性等机制影响作物生长、产量和经济指标。
AI.method: 采用描述性和相关性研究设计，使用问卷调查和四点李克特量表，对92名农民进行随机抽样调查，分析温度升高和降雨水平与作物产量、销售收入、生产成本之间的相关性。
AI.findings: 数据分析显示气候变化因素与农业生产力之间存在显著相关性：温度升高和不规则降雨模式对作物产量、销售收入和生产成本产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候变化对热带地区小农户农业影响的理论提供了实证支持，具体化了气候变量与农业经济指标（产量、收入、成本）之间的关联机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为塔利萨扬地区农民提供了气候适应性农业实践的具体需求证据，为政策制定者设计支持系统（如保险、技术推广、基础设施投资）以增强农业部门韧性提供了依据。

title: Enabler Psychology and Democratic Erosion: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding Elite Transformation
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Enabler Psychology and Democratic Erosion: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding Elite Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This theoretical paper was developed with assistance from Claude (Anthropic AI) for literature review, conceptual organization, and manuscript preparation. The theoretical framework, conceptual insights, and intellectual contributions are the author's own. AI assistance was used as a research and writing tool, similar to other computational research aids. The author takes full responsibility for all content and conclusions.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: How do educated, previously principled political elites become enablers of anti-democratic behavior while maintaining coherent self-images as defenders of constitutional order? This paper develops a theoretical framework for understanding elite transformation during democratic backsliding, addressing a critical gap in the literature: while scholars document what happens during democratic erosion, we lack systematic frameworks explaining how individual elite actors psychologically navigate their conversion from democratic guardians to enablers. Building on theories of cognitive dissonance, institutional evolution, and democratic backsliding, I propose the concept of "enabler psychology"-a constellation of psychological mechanisms through which political elites rationalize support for anti-democratic behavior. The framework identifies a four-phase transformation model (Initial Resistance → Gradual Accommodation → Sophisticated Defense → Institutional Enabling) and specifies four core psychological mechanisms (epistemic conditional compliance, constitutional conditional compliance, critical loyalism, and consequence shielding) that facilitate these transformations. Drawing on observable cases from the Republican Party's relationship with Donald Trump (2015-2025), I illustrate how these theoretical concepts might manifest in practice. Prominent Republicans who initially opposed Trump as "a terrible human being" (Mick Mulvaney), "America's Hitler" (JD Vance), or a "con artist" (Marco Rubio) developed sophisticated intellectual frameworks justifying their transformations-frameworks that appeared to allow them to maintain principled self-images while systematically enabling behavior they once condemned. The framework generates testable propositions about elite behavior during democratic backsliding: that transformation follows predictable phases with identifiable transition points; that different elites employ distinct rationalization mechanisms while exhibiting common underlying psychological patterns; and that institutional incentives interact with psychological mechanisms to accelerate elite capture. These propositions establish a research agenda for empirical investigation. This theoretical contribution matters because democratic erosion operates not simply through weakened institutions or polarized masses, but through the psychological capture of elites positioned to defend democratic norms. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for developing interventions that make elite capture more difficult and democratic resistance more sustainable. The paper concludes with policy implications and a research agenda for testing and refining the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"促成者心理学"理论框架，解释政治精英如何在民主倒退过程中从民主守护者转变为反民主行为的促成者，同时保持作为宪法秩序捍卫者的自我形象。该框架包含四阶段转变模型和四种核心心理机制，并以共和党与特朗普的关系为例进行说明。
AI.research_question: 受过教育、原本有原则的政治精英如何成为反民主行为的促成者，同时保持作为宪法秩序捍卫者的连贯自我形象？
AI.motivation: 现有文献记录了民主倒退期间发生的情况，但缺乏解释个体精英如何从心理上完成从民主守护者到促成者转变的系统框架。理解这些机制对于制定干预措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知失调理论、制度演化理论和民主倒退理论，提出了"促成者心理学"概念，包含四阶段转变模型和四种核心心理机制。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，结合共和党与特朗普关系（2015-2025）的可观察案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 精英转变遵循可预测的四阶段（初始抵抗→逐渐适应→复杂辩护→制度促成），通过四种心理机制（认知条件服从、宪法条件服从、批判性忠诚主义、后果屏蔽）实现转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"促成者心理学"理论框架，填补了民主倒退文献中精英心理转变机制的研究空白，建立了可检验的命题和研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解民主倒退中精英心理机制提供了分析工具，提出了政策干预建议，使精英俘获更困难，民主抵抗更可持续。

title: Containing Risks Posed by Leverage in Alternative Investment Funds
affiliations: European Securities and Markets Authority , Autorité des Marchés Financiers, European Securities and Markets Authority, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Systemic Risk Board, Autorité des Marchés Financiers, Deutsche Bundesbank,  and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Containing Risks Posed by Leverage in Alternative Investment Funds

publicationDetails.detailsText: ESRB: Occasional Paper Series 2025/28
publicationDetails.journalName: ESRB: Occasional Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a framework for monitoring risks arising from the build-up of leverage in EU-domiciled alternative investment funds (AIFs) and examines policy tools that could be effective in mitigating these risks in line with international recommendations. We develop a novel framework that combines confidential fund-level and transaction-level data on derivatives and repurchase agreements to present a comprehensive overview of the sources of leverage in highly leveraged AIFs. Using a range of risk metrics, our analysis identifies hedge funds and funds pursuing liability-driven investment (LDI) strategies as the most vulnerable to leverage-related risks. If interest rates rise, LDI funds may face significant mark-to-market losses and liquidity needs due to margin and collateral calls. Hedge funds appear to be more resilient against this type of shock but are sensitive to credit risk, especially hedge funds with relative value strategies. To mitigate these risks, we evaluate the impact of a range of policy tools such as leverage limits and minimum haircuts on collateral used for repo. Our analysis shows that the impact of the tools depends on the types of funds considered. Imposing a direct limit on net leverage of ten times the net asset value would lead to a sizeable reduction in the net exposures of hedge funds, but would barely affect other leveraged AIFs. Minimum haircuts on collateral would most likely affect only hedge funds with relative value strategies, as LDI funds, which already operate under a leverage limit, appear to have enough unencumbered assets to meet any additional collateral requirements. Overall, our findings suggest a need for tailored policy designs and highlight the complex interplay between different regulatory measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个监控欧盟另类投资基金杠杆风险的框架，评估了多种政策工具的有效性，发现不同基金类型对监管措施的反应差异显著，需要定制化政策设计。
AI.research_question: 如何有效监控欧盟另类投资基金的杠杆风险？哪些政策工具能有效缓解这些风险？
AI.motivation: 欧盟另类投资基金杠杆积累可能带来系统性风险，需要建立监控框架并评估政策工具的有效性，以符合国际监管建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统性风险理论和杠杆风险管理框架，结合衍生品和回购协议的交易数据，构建全面的杠杆风险监控体系。
AI.method: 使用保密的基金层面和交易层面数据（衍生品和回购协议），结合多种风险指标，分析不同基金类型的杠杆风险暴露。
AI.findings: 1) 对冲基金和LDI策略基金杠杆风险最高；2) LDI基金对利率上升敏感，面临市值损失和流动性压力；3) 对冲基金对信用风险敏感，特别是相对价值策略基金；4) 政策工具效果因基金类型而异：杠杆限制主要影响对冲基金，最低抵押品折扣主要影响相对价值策略对冲基金。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了结合基金和交易层面数据的综合杠杆风险监控框架；2) 揭示了不同基金类型对监管措施的差异化反应；3) 强调了政策工具间的复杂相互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供了实用的风险监控工具；2) 指出需要针对不同基金类型设计定制化监管政策；3) 为杠杆限制和抵押品要求等具体政策提供了实证依据。

title: Contemporary Dynamics of Mozambique's Economy: Structural Problems and Development Prospects
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, KL University, RMIT University and La Trobe University and He University

detail.title: Contemporary Dynamics of Mozambique's Economy: Structural Problems and Development Prospects
detail.abstract: This article examines the contemporary dynamics of Mozambique's economy, emphasizing the persistent structural problems that have constrained its development despite periods of rapid growth. Drawing on a mixed-methods approach that integrates macroeconomic analysis, sectoral assessment, and institutional evaluation, the study investigates the interplay between extractive-led growth, external dependence, and weak domestic productive capacity. The findings reveal that Mozambique's postwar economic trajectory has been characterized by high growth without structural transformation, driven largely by foreign direct investment in capital-intensive sectors and donor financing. Agriculture remains stagnant, industrialization limited, and the services sector dominated by low-productivity informal activities. The study further demonstrates that governance challenges, fiscal vulnerability, and uneven policy implementation have hindered the effective management of natural resources and public investment. Consequently, Mozambique's economy continues to exhibit dualistic features, with a narrow enclave sector disconnected from the broader population. The article concludes that sustainable and inclusive development requires a deliberate shift toward economic diversification, institutional strengthening, and investment in human capital. Only through such structural transformation can Mozambique move beyond dependence on external rents and achieve equitable and resilient growth.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了莫桑比克经济的当代动态，强调尽管有快速增长期，但结构性问题的持续存在制约了其发展。研究发现莫桑比克战后经济增长缺乏结构转型，主要由资本密集型行业的外国直接投资和捐助融资驱动，农业停滞、工业化有限、服务业低效，治理挑战和财政脆弱性阻碍了资源有效管理。
AI.research_question: 莫桑比克经济在战后时期如何发展？其结构性问题和外部依赖如何制约其发展转型？
AI.motivation: 尽管莫桑比克经历了快速增长期，但经济仍面临严重的结构性问题和外部依赖，需要深入理解这些制约因素如何阻碍其可持续和包容性发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构转型理论、依赖理论、制度经济学、资源诅咒理论、双元经济理论
AI.method: 混合方法：宏观经济分析、部门评估、制度评价相结合
AI.findings:
1. 莫桑比克战后经济增长缺乏结构转型，主要由外国直接投资和捐助融资驱动
2. 农业停滞、工业化有限、服务业以低生产率非正规活动为主
3. 治理挑战、财政脆弱性和政策执行不均阻碍了自然资源和公共投资的有效管理
4. 经济呈现双元特征，狭窄的飞地部门与广大人口脱节
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 丰富了发展中国家"无结构转型增长"的理论理解
2. 深化了外部依赖与国内生产能力薄弱相互作用的理论分析
3. 为资源丰富但治理薄弱国家的双元经济特征提供了实证支持
4. 扩展了结构转型理论在战后重建国家的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为莫桑比克政策制定者提供了经济转型的具体方向
2. 强调了经济多元化、制度强化和人力资本投资的重要性
3. 指出了减少外部租金依赖、实现公平和韧性增长的路径
4. 为其他面临类似挑战的发展中国家提供了借鉴

title: The FRESOD Framework: A Machine Learning Approach to Fiscal Resilience and Sovereign Debt Sustainability with an Application to Indonesia

detail.title: The FRESOD Framework: A Machine Learning Approach to Fiscal Resilience and Sovereign Debt Sustainability with an Application to Indonesia
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the FRESOD (Fiscal Resilience and Sovereign Debt Sustainability) Framework, a machine learning–based approach to assessing fiscal resilience and sovereign debt sustainability from 2000 to 2024. Unlike traditional debt sustainability analysis (DSA) that rely on fixed scenarios and linear assumptions, FRESOD employs data-driven learning and stochastic simulation to capture nonlinear interactions and correlated macro-financial shocks.

A machine-learning regression model predicts the debt-to-GDP ratio using interest–growth differentials, the primary balance, and exchange-rate vulnerability. The external-rate transmission coefficient (lambda = 1.867) is calibrated endogenously, reflecting Indonesia’s evolving sensitivity to global interest-rate conditions. Monte Carlo simulations with 100,000 fat-tailed, correlated draws generate the probability distribution of future debt paths under both baseline and stressed environments.

A machine-learning–derived fiscal reaction function quantifies how fiscal policy adjusts the primary balance in response to rising debt, reducing breach risk from 15.1% to 0.7% under moderate stress. Under extreme shocks, counterfactual scaling of the fiscal-responsiveness coefficient indicates that a 3.3-fold increase in adjustment elasticity is needed to bring breach probabilities below 5%.

Together, these components form a machine-learning–integrated stochastic DSA, offering a probabilistic, empirically grounded alternative to conventional IMF–World Bank sustainability frameworks. The findings demonstrate that adaptive, data-driven modeling provides a more realistic and actionable basis for fiscal policy design, particularly for emerging economies facing volatile external conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FRESOD框架，一种基于机器学习的财政韧性和主权债务可持续性评估方法，通过数据驱动学习和随机模拟捕捉非线性相互作用和相关宏观金融冲击，为新兴经济体提供更现实的财政政策设计基础。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法改进传统债务可持续性分析，更准确地评估财政韧性和主权债务可持续性？
AI.motivation: 传统债务可持续性分析依赖固定情景和线性假设，无法充分捕捉非线性相互作用和相关宏观金融冲击，特别是在新兴经济体面临波动外部环境的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务可持续性理论、财政反应函数理论、机器学习在宏观经济预测中的应用、随机模拟方法。
AI.method: 1. 机器学习回归模型预测债务/GDP比率；2. 内生校准外部利率传导系数；3. 蒙特卡洛模拟生成未来债务路径概率分布；4. 机器学习推导的财政反应函数量化财政政策调整。
AI.findings: 1. 财政反应函数可将违约风险从15.1%降至0.7%；2. 极端冲击下需要3.3倍的调整弹性才能将违约概率降至5%以下；3. 外部利率传导系数为1.867，反映印尼对全球利率条件的敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出机器学习整合的随机债务可持续性分析框架；2. 发展数据驱动的财政反应函数建模方法；3. 提供概率性、经验基础的债务可持续性评估替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供更现实的财政政策设计工具；2. 特别适用于面临波动外部条件的新兴经济体；3. 为IMF-世界银行传统框架提供实证替代方案。

title: The Political Economy of Impunity: Wealth, Institutional Paralysis, and the Epstein Investigation
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Political Economy of Impunity: Wealth, Institutional Paralysis, and the Epstein Investigation
detail.abstract: This paper documents and theorizes systematic institutional failure to investigate comprehensive documentary evidence when suspects possess extreme wealth. Senator Ron Wyden's three-year investigation into Jeffrey Epstein's financial operations revealed Treasury Department files documenting 4,725 wire transfers totaling $1.1 billion. Yet no comprehensive "follow the money" investigation occurred despite hundreds of law enforcement agencies having access to this evidence. This "Documentation Paradox"-evidence abundance failing to produce accountability-reveals an "impunity threshold" beyond which three mechanisms produce institutional paralysis: financial institution compliance failure, law enforcement non-response despite evidence access, and bipartisan political protection of elite networks. The Epstein case demonstrates that extreme wealth purchases not merely superior legal defense but institutional non-response, with obstruction operating through rational institutional behavior rather than conspiracy. Parallel congressional oversight by Senators Wyden (Finance Committee) and Whitehouse (Judiciary Committee) documented systematic executive branch obstruction including false statements about legal constraints preventing disclosure. FBI Director Kash Patel claimed during his January 2025 confirmation hearing that court orders prevented him from discussing his grand jury testimony, but Chief Judge James Boasberg ruled in July 2025 that Patel was free to discuss his own testimony. This has profound implications for democratic legitimacy when "equal justice under law" systematically fails for ultra-wealthy suspects despite comprehensive documentary evidence of serious crimes.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当嫌疑人拥有极端财富时，系统性制度失灵导致无法对全面文件证据进行调查的现象。通过杰弗里·爱泼斯坦金融操作的案例，研究发现存在"文件悖论"：证据丰富却无法产生问责，揭示了"有罪不罚阈值"的存在。
AI.research_question: 当嫌疑人拥有极端财富时，为什么全面的文件证据无法导致有效的调查和问责？
AI.motivation: 参议员罗恩·怀登对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦金融操作的三年调查发现，财政部文件记录了4,725笔总计11亿美元的转账，但尽管数百个执法机构可以获取这些证据，却没有进行全面的"追查资金"调查。这种证据丰富却无法产生问责的现象需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: "文件悖论"（Documentation Paradox）：证据丰富却无法产生问责；"有罪不罚阈值"（impunity threshold）：超越此阈值后，三种机制产生制度瘫痪；制度理性行为理论：阻碍通过理性制度行为而非阴谋运作。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析杰弗里·爱泼斯坦金融操作的国会监督调查，包括参议员怀登（财政委员会）和怀特豪斯（司法委员会）的平行监督，以及相关法律文件和听证会记录。
AI.findings: 发现三种机制导致制度瘫痪：1）金融机构合规失败；2）执法机构虽有证据访问权但不回应；3）两党政治保护精英网络。极端财富不仅购买优越的法律辩护，还购买制度不回应。行政部门的系统性阻碍包括关于法律限制阻止披露的虚假陈述。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）提出"文件悖论"概念；2）识别"有罪不罚阈值"；3）揭示极端财富如何通过理性制度行为而非阴谋实现制度瘫痪；4）扩展对"法律面前人人平等"系统性失效的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义：1）揭示国会监督在揭露制度失灵中的作用；2）展示行政部门的系统性阻碍模式；3）对民主合法性有深远影响，当"法律面前人人平等"对极端富裕嫌疑人系统性失效时；4）为改革执法和问责机制提供依据。

title: Adaptive Digital Governance and the Causal Role of Participatory Recalibration-Comparative Evidence from 150 Years of Longitudinal Data in UK, Germany, Japan, and Korea, with OECD/UN Benchmarking of Digital-Era Resilience and Inclusion Worldwide
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Adaptive Digital Governance and the Causal Role of Participatory Recalibration-Comparative Evidence from 150 Years of Longitudinal Data in UK, Germany, Japan, and Korea, with OECD/UN Benchmarking of Digital-Era Resilience and Inclusion Worldwide
detail.abstract: The AMDG framework establishes a distinct paradigm for institutional transformation in the digital era, supplanting deterministic economic and regulatory models with adaptive, participatory approaches. Leveraging 150 years of longitudinal evidence from the UK, Germany, Japan, and Korea-augmented by digital-era benchmarking across over 100 additional global cases-AMDG reveals that participatory recalibration, empowered by iterative action research, constitutes the dominant causal pathway to resilient and inclusive governance. This immediate rejection of deterministic perspectives illuminates how lasting institutional change emerges from adaptive collaboration rather than mechanistic rule application.

AI.tldr: AMDG框架为数字时代机构转型提供了新范式，用适应性、参与性方法取代确定性经济和监管模型。基于150年纵向证据和100多个全球案例，研究发现参与性重新校准是构建韧性和包容性治理的主要因果路径。
AI.research_question: 数字时代中，机构转型如何实现韧性和包容性治理？参与性重新校准是否比确定性模型更有效？
AI.motivation: 传统确定性的经济和监管模型在数字时代面临挑战，需要新的转型范式来应对快速变化的环境和复杂的社会需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: AMDG（适应性治理）框架，强调参与性重新校准和迭代行动研究，反对确定性视角。
AI.method: 基于英国、德国、日本和韩国150年纵向证据，结合100多个全球案例的数字时代基准测试，采用迭代行动研究方法。
AI.findings: 参与性重新校准是构建韧性和包容性治理的主要因果路径，持久机构变革源于适应性协作而非机械规则应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AMDG理论框架，挑战了确定性转型模型，提出了参与性重新校准作为机构转型的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和组织领导者提供了数字时代机构转型的具体路径，强调适应性协作而非机械规则应用。

title: The Case for Fiduciary Duty in AI: A Legal Framework to Prevent Systematic User Exploitation by Large Language Models
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Case for Fiduciary Duty in AI: A Legal Framework to Prevent Systematic User Exploitation by Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools with profound implications for knowledge production, professional work, and economic opportunity. Yet the legal frameworks governing LLM deployment remain inadequate to address systematic exploitation of users, particularly marginalized communities. This paper argues that applying traditional fiduciary duties to LLM developers and deployers-enhanced with specific protections against token depletion and data fabrication-provides a superior legal mechanism for preventing exploitation and ensuring accountability. The paper identifies two primary exploitation concerns: potential built-in protocols that could systematically deplete user tokens, forcing users into higher-cost plans or abandoning projects mid-completion;¹ and the risk of LLM-generated fabrications in academic and professional work that remain undetected until causing severe reputational and career harm.² Traditional contract law, consumer protection statutes, and defamation doctrine fail to address these harms, particularly for independent scholars and marginalized users lacking institutional resources. This paper proposes a fiduciary framework grounded in enhanced duties of care, loyalty, and transparency. Specifically: when users identify token exploitation, providers must restore tokens and generate detailed reports;³ LLM providers face strict liability for fabrications, with fixed penalties scaled by severity and punitive damages designed to make fabrication economically untenable;⁴ and providers must invest in detection and prevention systems, implement verification protocols before deployment, and warn users of fabrication risks, with failure to do so escalating punitive damages.⁵ This framework addresses power asymmetries inherent in the LLM-user relationship and provides meaningful remedies for systematic harm-particularly protecting the independent scholars, freelance workers, and marginalized communities most vulnerable to exploitation. REVISION NOTE This revision removes speculative examples and unverified empirical claims from the original version, focusing the paper on legal theory, fiduciary doctrine, and the proposed legal framework. The paper now develops a theoretical framework for potential exploitation mechanisms rather than documenting specific instances. All arguments are grounded in established legal principles and fiduciary duty doctrine. Citations have been verified for accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张将传统信托责任应用于LLM开发者和部署者，并增强针对代币耗尽和数据伪造的特定保护，为预防剥削和确保问责提供更优的法律机制。
AI.research_question: 如何通过法律框架解决大型语言模型（LLM）部署中的系统性剥削问题，特别是对边缘化社区的剥削？
AI.motivation: 当前管理LLM部署的法律框架不足以解决对用户（特别是边缘化社区）的系统性剥削问题，包括代币耗尽和数据伪造等风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信托责任理论（fiduciary duty doctrine），包括增强的注意义务、忠诚义务和透明度义务。
AI.method: 法律理论分析，基于既定的法律原则和信托责任学说，构建理论框架而非记录具体实例。
AI.findings: 传统合同法、消费者保护法规和诽谤学说无法有效解决LLM带来的剥削问题，特别是对缺乏机构资源的独立学者和边缘化用户。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将信托责任框架应用于LLM开发者和部署者的理论框架，增强了针对代币耗尽和数据伪造的具体保护机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM提供商制定了具体的法律义务：代币恢复和报告机制、对伪造的严格责任和惩罚性赔偿、检测和预防系统投资、部署前验证协议、风险警告义务等，特别保护独立学者、自由职业者和边缘化社区。

title: Managerial Myopia, Voluntary Disclosure, and Learning from Markets

detail.title: Managerial Myopia, Voluntary Disclosure, and Learning from Markets
detail.abstract: I study voluntary disclosure and its effect on investment efficiency when myopic managers learn from stock prices before making investment decisions. In an investment feedback model with privately informed investors, I show a novel mechanism through which voluntary disclosure can encourage information acquisition and improve investment efficiency. When a firm discloses a good news about a project, investors expect the firm to invest more in the project. This raises the trading profits that informed investors can make from private information, and in turn strengthens incentives to acquire it. I then combine this insight with managerial myopia. In general, I find that myopia leads to excessive disclosure, crowding out information acquisition by investors. However, this adverse effect of myopia is mitigated when the manager's information quality is low and the project is risky. My findings suggest that strategic disclosure can increase managerial learning from market and mitigate the adverse consequences of short-term managerial incentives.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了短视管理者在投资决策前从股价学习时，自愿披露如何影响投资效率。研究发现，当公司披露项目好消息时，投资者预期公司会增加投资，这会提高知情投资者的交易利润，从而激励他们获取更多私人信息。结合管理者短视行为，研究发现短视通常导致过度披露，挤出了投资者的信息获取，但当管理者信息质量低且项目风险高时，这种负面影响会减弱。
AI.research_question: 在短视管理者从股价学习后做出投资决策的背景下，自愿披露如何影响投资者的信息获取和投资效率？
AI.motivation: 管理者经常面临短期业绩压力（短视），同时会观察市场反应来指导投资决策。现有研究较少探讨自愿披露如何影响投资者信息获取，进而影响管理者从市场学习的能力和投资效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资反馈模型，结合信息经济学、公司金融中的自愿披露理论、管理者短视理论，以及市场微观结构中的信息获取激励理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含私有信息投资者、短视管理者和投资反馈机制的理论模型，分析均衡条件下的披露决策、信息获取和投资效率。
AI.findings: 1. 自愿披露好消息会提高投资者对项目投资的预期，增加知情投资者的交易利润，从而激励信息获取；2. 管理者短视通常导致过度披露，挤出了投资者的信息获取；3. 当管理者信息质量低且项目风险高时，短视的负面影响会减弱；4. 战略性披露可以增强管理者从市场学习的能力，缓解短期激励的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了自愿披露通过影响投资者信息获取激励来影响投资效率的新机制；2. 揭示了管理者短视与投资者信息获取之间的权衡关系；3. 扩展了投资反馈模型，考虑了披露决策的内生性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供了战略性披露的指导，以更好地利用市场信息；2. 帮助监管者理解自愿披露政策对市场信息效率的影响；3. 为投资者提供了理解公司披露行为与投资决策关系的框架。

title: Safer and Cleaner: The Impacts of Airbnb Regulation on Neighborhood Quality
affiliations: University of Windsor, University of North Texas - Department of Economics and Old Dominion University

detail.title: Safer and Cleaner: The Impacts of Airbnb Regulation on Neighborhood Quality
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether short-term rentals (STRs), particularly those facilitated by Airbnb, generate negative neighborhood externalities. We exploit a natural experiment, the implementation of New York City's Local Law 18 (LL18) that restricts STRs and, in particular, bans unhosted stays, to identify the causal impact of Airbnb activity on neighborhood quality. Using a difference-indifferences design and combining multiple datasets at the census-tract level, we find that LL18 led to significant reductions in rodent complaints, motor vehicle collisions, and crimes. Event-study estimates show no differential pre-trends and reveal persistent improvements in neighborhood quality following the policy. The complementary instrumental variables analysis further demonstrates that reductions in Airbnb activity causally reduce neighborhood externalities associated with Airbnb. Our results highlight that Airbnb's effects extend beyond housing markets, influencing broader dimensions of urban sustainability. These findings underscore the importance of considering neighborhood externalities when designing STR regulations.

AI.tldr: 纽约市实施短期租赁限制法（LL18）后，Airbnb活动减少导致社区质量显著改善，包括啮齿动物投诉、机动车碰撞和犯罪率下降，表明短期租赁会产生负外部性。
AI.research_question: 短期租赁（特别是Airbnb）是否会产生负面的社区外部性？
AI.motivation: 短期租赁平台如Airbnb对城市社区的影响备受关注，但现有研究主要关注其对住房市场的影响，缺乏对更广泛的社区外部性（如安全、卫生等）的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外部性理论和自然实验设计，研究短期租赁活动对社区质量的因果影响。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID）和事件研究法，利用纽约市Local Law 18（限制短期租赁，特别是禁止非托管住宿）作为自然实验，结合人口普查区层面的多源数据进行因果推断，并辅以工具变量分析。
AI.findings: LL18实施后，Airbnb活动减少导致啮齿动物投诉、机动车碰撞和犯罪率显著下降，事件研究显示无差异前趋势且改善效果持续，工具变量分析进一步证实Airbnb活动减少对降低社区外部性具有因果效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为短期租赁的社区外部性提供了因果证据；2）扩展了Airbnb影响的研究范围，从住房市场延伸到更广泛的社区质量维度；3）验证了政策干预在调节平台经济外部性方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为城市政策制定者设计短期租赁监管政策提供了实证依据；2）强调在监管设计中需要考虑社区外部性；3）展示了特定政策工具（如禁止非托管住宿）在改善社区质量方面的实际效果。

title: FRAME 4.0: A Multi-Layer Model of Modern Regime Evolution and Crisis

detail.title: FRAME 4.0: A Multi-Layer Model of Modern Regime Evolution and Crisis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or sensitive data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: FRAME 4.0 is a multi-layer model for understanding why modern regimes evolve, saturate, and enter crisis. The framework integrates four layers-economic, institutional, symbolic, and subjective-and five meta-variables: E, I* (IEL × EEL), SEL, TEL, and CEL. Crises arise not from single shocks but from the synchronization of five mechanisms across layers: distributional breakdown, institutional failure, symbolic polarization, emotional contagion, and communication acceleration. The paper outlines a four-phase cycle (expansion, saturation, crisis, reconfiguration) and applies the model to the United States, Chile, and China. FRAME provides a general architecture for explaining variation across democracies, hybrid regimes, and autocracies, with implications for comparative politics and policy design.

AI.tldr: FRAME 4.0是一个多层模型，用于解释现代政权为何演化、饱和并陷入危机。该框架整合了经济、制度、象征和主观四个层面，以及五个元变量。危机不是由单一冲击引起，而是五个机制在四个层面同步作用的结果：分配崩溃、制度失灵、象征极化、情绪传染和沟通加速。论文提出了四阶段周期模型，并应用于美国、智利和中国案例。
AI.research_question: 现代政权为何会演化、饱和并陷入危机？不同政治体制（民主、混合、专制）的危机模式有何异同？
AI.motivation: 现有政治危机理论往往过于简化，未能整合多个层面的动态机制。需要建立一个综合框架来解释现代政权的演化、饱和和危机过程，特别是不同政治体制下的变异模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层理论框架：整合经济、制度、象征和主观四个层面；五个元变量：E（经济）、I*（制度效能）、SEL（象征效能）、TEL（时间效能）、CEL（沟通效能）；四阶段周期理论：扩张、饱和、危机、重新配置。
AI.method: 理论建模与比较案例分析：构建FRAME 4.0多层理论框架，并应用于美国、智利和中国三个不同政治体制的案例研究，进行跨案例比较分析。
AI.findings: 危机不是单一冲击的结果，而是五个机制在四个层面同步作用：分配崩溃（经济层）、制度失灵（制度层）、象征极化（象征层）、情绪传染（主观层）和沟通加速（沟通层）。不同政治体制的危机模式存在系统性差异，但都遵循四阶段周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了整合多层动态的FRAME 4.0理论框架；2）识别了危机形成的五个同步机制；3）建立了适用于不同政治体制的四阶段周期模型；4）为比较政治学提供了新的分析架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了诊断政权危机的分析工具；2）帮助识别不同政治体制的脆弱点；3）为危机预防和治理提供理论指导；4）有助于设计更稳健的政治制度。

title: In favor of girls: Do adults trust girls more than boys for advice?
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics, Department of Economics and

detail.title: In favor of girls: Do adults trust girls more than boys for advice?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: The paper uses publically available data
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Who should you ask for advice when you're not sure about something? This is a though decision that people often face, yet little is known about how we decide on who to ask. In this paper, we examine whether adults (N=123) prefer to ask boys or girls when seeking advice from children (N=38). To answer this question, we collect data from five seasons of the Swedish Game Show "Are you smarter than a 5th grader?" where adult contestants choose a boy or a girl from 5th grade to help them earn large amounts of money by answering questions from the primary school curriculum. We observe that girls are 9.5 percentage points more likely to be asked first for advice than boys. This corresponds to a 18.1 percent gap in favor of girls. The favoritism is not rational since boys and girls perform equally well. Our finding has potential implications both for advice seekers, who may be biased in who they ask for help, those that are selected as advisors who may feel encouraged, and those who are not who may feel discouraged.

AI.tldr: 成人向儿童寻求建议时更倾向于选择女孩而非男孩，尽管两者表现相当
AI.research_question: 成年人在向儿童寻求建议时，是否更倾向于选择男孩还是女孩？
AI.motivation: 人们在不确定时向谁寻求建议是一个常见但研究不足的决策问题，需要了解人们如何选择建议者
AI.theoretical_framework: 建议寻求决策、性别偏见、理性选择理论
AI.method: 利用瑞典游戏节目《你比五年级学生聪明吗？》五季的数据，观察123名成年参赛者如何从38名五年级学生中选择男孩或女孩作为建议者
AI.findings: 女孩被首先询问建议的可能性比男孩高9.5个百分点，相当于18.1%的差距，这种偏好是非理性的，因为男孩和女孩的表现相当
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了建议寻求决策中的性别偏见，挑战了理性选择假设，扩展了决策偏见研究
AI.practical_contributions: 对建议寻求者（可能存在偏见）、被选中的建议者（可能受到鼓励）和未被选中的建议者（可能感到沮丧）都有潜在影响

title: Volatility and VolCap Dynamics: Insights from Model Selection in Managing Volatility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Frankfurt, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Volatility and VolCap Dynamics: Insights from Model Selection in Managing Volatility
detail.abstract: This article compares classical econometric models and machine learning algorithms for predicting financial market volatility and managing volatility cap strategies. Using daily return data from the MSCI World Index, we analyze stochastic volatility, Markov switching, GARCH(1,1), EWMA, LSTM, and neural networks. The study demonstrates that traditional models such as GARCH and stochastic volatility have superior prediction accuracy, while machine-learning models achieve superior hit rates in periods of high volatility. Our analysis emphasizes the significant role of model selection in optimizing risk-return profiles through dynamic volatility management.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了传统计量经济学模型和机器学习算法在预测金融市场波动性和管理波动率上限策略方面的表现。研究发现传统模型（如GARCH）预测精度更高，而机器学习模型在高波动时期命中率更优。
AI.research_question: 传统计量经济学模型和机器学习算法在预测金融市场波动性和管理波动率上限策略方面哪个表现更好？
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习在金融领域的应用日益广泛，需要系统比较传统计量模型和机器学习算法在波动性预测和风险管理方面的实际表现，为投资策略优化提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融时间序列分析理论、波动性建模理论（包括GARCH、随机波动模型）、机器学习理论（LSTM、神经网络）和投资组合风险管理理论。
AI.method: 使用MSCI世界指数的日收益率数据，比较随机波动模型、马尔可夫转换模型、GARCH(1,1)、EWMA、LSTM和神经网络等多种模型，评估它们在波动性预测和波动率上限策略管理中的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 传统模型（如GARCH和随机波动模型）在预测精度方面表现更优；2. 机器学习模型在高波动时期具有更高的命中率；3. 模型选择对通过动态波动性管理优化风险收益特征具有重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了传统计量模型与机器学习算法在金融波动性预测方面的系统性比较框架；2. 揭示了不同模型在不同市场条件下的相对优势；3. 丰富了金融风险管理中模型选择的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资经理提供了基于实证的模型选择指导；2. 展示了如何结合不同模型的优势优化波动率上限策略；3. 为金融机构的风险管理系统提供了实用的建模建议。

title: Intraday Volatility Surface Geometry and Rebalancing Premia in Options
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management

detail.title: Intraday Volatility Surface Geometry and Rebalancing Premia in Options
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether intraday distortions in the cross-strike geometry of the implied volatility surface forecast short-horizon option premia. Using data on equity options, I construct measures of the local level, skew, curvature, and cross-strike dislocations of the surface and relate them to subsequent 30-minute option returns. Options with high implied volatility level or rich at-the-money points earn lower subsequent returns, while those associated with high curvature and large dislocations earn higher returns, generating economically meaningful premia at very short horizons. These premia are absent in underlying stock returns, remain robust to standard liquidity controls, and are strongest near the close of trading when dealers rebalance positions. The evidence suggests an intraday rebalancing premium in options tied to the correction of cross-strike inventory imbalances rather than to directional equity risk.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现日内隐含波动率曲面的跨执行价几何扭曲能够预测短期期权溢价。高隐含波动率水平或价内期权随后收益较低，而高曲率和大幅错位期权则获得较高收益，这些溢价在极短时间窗口内具有经济意义。
AI.research_question: 日内隐含波动率曲面的跨执行价几何扭曲是否能够预测短期期权溢价？
AI.motivation: 研究期权市场中非常短期的定价异常现象，探索日内交易中隐含波动率曲面的几何特征如何影响期权收益，特别是与做市商头寸再平衡相关的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于做市商库存管理理论，特别是跨执行价头寸失衡的修正机制；期权定价理论中的隐含波动率曲面几何特征分析。
AI.method: 使用股票期权数据构建隐含波动率曲面的局部水平、偏度、曲率和跨执行价错位指标，并将这些指标与随后的30分钟期权收益进行关联分析。
AI.findings: 高隐含波动率水平或价内期权随后收益较低，而高曲率和大幅错位期权则获得较高收益；这些溢价在标的股票收益中不存在，对标准流动性控制保持稳健，在临近收盘时最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了日内再平衡溢价的概念，将期权溢价与跨执行价库存失衡的修正联系起来，而非传统的方向性股票风险；为期权市场微观结构理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者提供了基于隐含波动率曲面几何特征的短期交易策略；帮助做市商更好地管理跨执行价头寸风险；为监管者理解期权市场日内价格形成机制提供参考。

title: Sanctuary Standoff: Constitutional Fault Lines in Immigration Enforcement
affiliations: Southern Illinois University Simmons Law School

detail.title: Sanctuary Standoff: Constitutional Fault Lines in Immigration Enforcement
detail.abstract:
During both its first and second terms, the Trump Administration has taken aim at so-called “sanctuary” jurisdictions to try to encourage or force state and local cooperation with federal immigration law enforcement. In addition to targeted immigration enforcement efforts, the Administration has waged a legal and public media campaign against states, counties, and cities that the Administration views as “sanctuary” jurisdictions and has attempted to withhold a wide variety of federal funds from those jurisdictions to pressure them to change their policies. While there is no definition of a “sanctuary” jurisdiction in any federal statute or executive order, the Department of Justice recently published a website that defines “sanctuary” jurisdictions as those states, counties, and cities that take actions or have polices “that materially impede enforcement of federal immigration statutes and regulations.” 

The conflict between the Trump Administration and these state and local sanctuary jurisdictions raises a host of issues, implicating several constitutional law doctrines, federal and state statutes and policies. Both the city of Chicago and the state of Illinois are engaged in multiple lawsuits with the Trump Administration regarding their respective sanctuary laws and policies. These lawsuits will be used to illustrate and assess the underlying issues.

This article provides a brief history of the sanctuary movement and explains why some state and local jurisdictions have adopted so-called sanctuary laws and policies and what those laws and policies are. In particular, the article examines the laws and policies of Illinois, Cook County, and Chicago to illustrate the legal and policy issues. The article then examines the constitutional doctrines that are implicated in this conflict, assesses the merits of the arguments raised by the ongoing litigation, and suggests some possible alternatives governments could pursue that would be more productive and lawful.

AI.tldr: 本文分析特朗普政府与"庇护"司法管辖区之间的法律冲突，探讨宪法原则、联邦与州权力平衡，以及可能的替代解决方案。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府与州/地方"庇护"司法管辖区之间的法律冲突涉及哪些宪法原则和联邦-州权力平衡问题？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府试图通过法律和财政手段迫使州和地方司法管辖区配合联邦移民执法，引发了一系列宪法和法律争议，需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦主义原则、宪法第十修正案、反强制原则、行政权力限制、联邦与州权力划分等宪法理论框架。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，以芝加哥和伊利诺伊州的诉讼为例，分析相关法律和政策，并结合宪法原则进行理论评估。
AI.findings: 特朗普政府的制裁措施可能违反宪法原则，特别是反强制原则和联邦与州权力平衡；"庇护"司法管辖区的政策有其法律依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对联邦主义在移民执法领域的应用理解，明确了宪法原则在当代政治冲突中的实际意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为州和地方政府提供法律策略建议，为政策制定者提供更合法有效的替代方案，促进建设性对话。

title: Can a Stadium Full of Monkeys Playing Strat-o-Matic Outmanage Earl Weaver? An Empirical Bayesian Estimator of Manager Value
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Can a Stadium Full of Monkeys Playing Strat-o-Matic Outmanage Earl Weaver? An Empirical Bayesian Estimator of Manager Value
detail.abstract: For a sport that is approaching a state of analytic saturation, major league baseball is devoid of one seemingly critical metric: a manager value estimator. Whether managers have ever meaningfully influenced their teams' performances and still do today are matters of significant dissensus. Without a manager-value estimator, that debate (critical, at a minimum, to informed front-office decisionmaking) cannot be convincingly resolved. This paper examines three candidates for such a measure: PE, which gauges managerial impact in relation to the Pythagorean expectation formula (Horowitz, 1994); mWAR, which quantifies managers' contribution to team wins in excess of the ones predicted by team WARs; and JF, which derives manager value from the difference between pre-season forecasts and actual team performances (James, 1997). These metrics are tested with Bayesian statistical methods: Monte Carlo and bootstrap simulations (the equivalent of over a million Strat-o-Matic monkey managers) are used to form empirical nulls; these are then used to calculate False Discovery Rates and form posterior estimates in relation to Regions of Practical Equivalence. Convergent results suggest that a substantial fraction of managers (including current and recently active ones) have over their careers influenced team "winning percentages" ≥ ± 0.012, the equivalent of ± 2 wins per 162 games. The paper constructs a composite Hybrid Estimator, which can be used for making historical comparisons and for assessing current performances. The Estimator can also be calibrated to reflect the asymmetric-error costs and risk preferences that characterize the tournament structure of MLB economics.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个棒球经理价值评估的混合估计器，通过三种候选指标和贝叶斯统计方法，证明相当比例的经理对球队胜率有显著影响（±2胜/162场比赛）。
AI.research_question: 如何有效评估棒球经理的价值？哪些指标能够可靠地衡量经理对球队表现的影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管棒球数据分析已接近饱和，但缺乏有效的经理价值评估指标。关于经理是否以及如何影响球队表现的争论无法得到令人信服的解决，这对球队管理决策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三种经理价值评估理论：PE（基于毕达哥拉斯期望公式）、mWAR（基于球队WAR预测的胜场超额贡献）、JF（基于季前预测与实际表现的差异）。
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯统计方法：蒙特卡洛和自助法模拟（相当于超过百万次随机经理模拟）建立经验零分布，计算错误发现率，并基于实际等价区域形成后验估计。
AI.findings: 相当比例的经理（包括现任和近期活跃的）在其职业生涯中对球队胜率的影响达到±0.012（相当于±2胜/162场比赛）。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个混合估计器，能够进行历史比较和当前表现评估，并可根据MLB锦标赛结构的不对称错误成本和风险偏好进行校准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为球队管理层提供了实用的经理价值评估工具，有助于更明智的招聘、留任和解雇决策，解决了棒球分析中长期存在的空白。

title: Data-Driven Framework for Real Estate Investment Decision Making: The DDI System
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Data-Driven Framework for Real Estate Investment Decision Making: The DDI System
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Data-Driven Investment System (DDI), a multi-dimensional analytical framework designed to evaluate real estate investment opportunities using demographic, economic, infrastructural, land-supply and market-cycle indicators. As global property markets face increasing volatility, DDI provides a systematic method for understanding long-term value formation and improving investment decision accuracy. The framework integrates cross-disciplinary datasets to generate predictive insights applicable across residential, commercial, industrial and urban development contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了数据驱动投资系统（DDI），这是一个多维分析框架，用于使用人口、经济、基础设施、土地供应和市场周期指标评估房地产投资机会。该系统为理解长期价值形成和提高投资决策准确性提供了系统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个系统性的多维分析框架来评估房地产投资机会，以提高投资决策的准确性？
AI.motivation: 全球房地产市场面临日益增长的波动性，需要更系统的方法来理解长期价值形成并提高投资决策的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动投资系统（DDI）框架，整合了人口统计学、经济学、基础设施、土地供应和市场周期理论。
AI.method: 开发了一个多维分析框架，整合跨学科数据集，使用人口、经济、基础设施、土地供应和市场周期指标来评估房地产投资机会。
AI.findings: DDI框架能够生成适用于住宅、商业、工业和城市发展背景的预测性见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合多维度指标的系统性房地产投资评估框架，丰富了房地产投资决策的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产投资者提供了一个实用的分析工具，帮助他们在波动市场中做出更准确的投资决策，适用于多种房地产类型和开发背景。

title: Rules of Origin for Digital Products in the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol: Precedent, Potential, and Pitfalls
affiliations: School of Law, University of the Witwatersrand and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Rules of Origin for Digital Products in the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol: Precedent, Potential, and Pitfalls
detail.abstract: The inclusion of rules of origin (RoO) in the AfCFTA Protocol on Digital Trade (DTP) marks a significant innovation in international trade law, extending a mechanism traditionally confined to trade in goods into the digital domain. Overall, the DTP’s RoO regime signals a bold but fragile attempt to align digital trade liberalisation with developmental objectives. However, by conditioning preferential treatment for electronically transmitted digital products on origin status, the DTP seeks to advance regional digital industrialisation and ensure that the benefits of market access accrue to African enterprises, platforms, and content creators. Yet the framework’s reliance on ownership and control criteria, coupled with asymmetrical treatment of enterprises and platforms and a fragile ‘substantial business operations’ test, creates opportunities for strategic structuring and ‘digital origin engineering’. These design gaps risk privileging nominally African actors over those substantively embedded in African economies. We further show that, by distinguishing between African and non-African electronically transmitted digital products, the DTP opens the possibility of imposing customs duties on the latter, an approach that reconfigures fiscal and industrial policy space but risks tension with multilateral norms.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了非洲大陆自由贸易区数字贸易协议中的原产地规则，探讨了将传统货物贸易的原产地机制扩展到数字领域的创新性尝试及其潜在问题。
AI.research_question: 非洲大陆自由贸易区数字贸易协议中的原产地规则如何影响数字贸易自由化与发展目标的协调？这些规则的设计缺陷会带来哪些风险？
AI.motivation: 原产地规则传统上仅适用于货物贸易，而非洲大陆自由贸易区数字贸易协议将其扩展到数字领域，这是一个重要的制度创新。研究需要评估这一创新是否能有效促进区域数字工业化，以及其设计是否存在漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际数字贸易法、原产地规则理论、数字工业化理论、区域经济一体化理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、政策分析、比较分析（与传统货物贸易原产地规则对比）
AI.findings: 1. DTP的原产地规则依赖所有权和控制标准，对企业和平合采取不对称待遇，加上脆弱的"实质性商业运营"测试，为战略结构安排和"数字原产地工程"创造了机会。2. 这些设计缺陷可能导致名义上的非洲行为者受益，而非真正扎根非洲经济的行为者。3. 通过区分非洲和非非洲电子传输数字产品，DTP为对后者征收关税提供了可能，这重新配置了财政和产业政策空间，但可能与多边规范产生冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了原产地规则理论到数字贸易领域。2. 提出了"数字原产地工程"的概念框架。3. 分析了数字贸易中原产地规则与多边贸易体系的潜在冲突。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非洲国家实施数字贸易协议提供政策建议。2. 揭示了原产地规则设计中的漏洞，帮助政策制定者完善规则。3. 为其他区域数字贸易协议提供借鉴经验。

title: Aligning Growth with Rules: How Global Trade Pacts Shape Macroeconomic Performance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Aligning Growth with Rules: How Global Trade Pacts Shape Macroeconomic Performance
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of participation in global and regional trade agreements on macroeconomic performance across advanced and developing economies. Using a multi-country panel spanning 1990-2024, the study investigates the channels through which rules-based integration shapes growth outcomes, including trade openness, foreign direct investment (FDI), institutional quality, and policy stability. The theoretical framework integrates classical, modern, and endogenous growth models to explain how market expansion, productivity gains, and knowledge spillovers emerge from trade agreements. The analysis highlights substantial heterogeneity across income groups, with advanced economies benefiting primarily through innovation and scale effects, whereas developing economies rely on FDI attraction and export diversification. AI.tldr: 本文研究了参与全球和区域贸易协定对发达经济体和发展中经济体宏观经济表现的影响，发现制度质量是决定贸易协定增长红利的关键因素，不同收入群体从贸易协定中获益的机制存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 参与全球和区域贸易协定如何影响发达经济体和发展中经济体的宏观经济表现？贸易协定通过哪些渠道影响经济增长？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化和区域经济一体化的深入发展，各国越来越多地参与各种贸易协定，但这些协定对宏观经济表现的实际影响存在争议，特别是对发达经济体和发展中经济体的影响机制和效果可能存在显著差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了古典、现代和内生增长理论，包括市场扩张效应、生产率提升和知识溢出效应，解释贸易协定如何通过贸易开放、外商直接投资、制度质量和政策稳定性等渠道影响经济增长。
AI.method: 使用1990-2024年多国面板数据，实证分析贸易协定对宏观经济表现的影响，考察贸易开放、外商直接投资、制度质量和政策稳定性等中介渠道。
AI.findings: 1. 拥有强大治理结构和连贯监管体系的经济体从一体化中获得显著更高的增长红利；2. 制度环境薄弱的经济体获益有限且分配不均问题加剧；3. 发达经济体主要通过创新和规模效应获益，而发展中经济体依赖外商直接投资吸引和出口多样化；4. 贸易自由化带来不平等、外部冲击脆弱性和环境挑战等关键问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将古典、现代和内生增长理论整合到贸易协定分析框架中；2. 明确了制度质量在贸易协定增长效应中的调节作用；3. 揭示了不同收入群体从贸易协定中获益的差异化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计贸易协定提供实证依据；2. 强调制度建设和监管改革对最大化贸易协定收益的重要性；3. 为发展中经济体制定差异化贸易战略提供指导；4. 指出需要配套政策解决贸易自由化带来的不平等和环境问题。

title: Of Unsung Heroes in Biodiversity Conservation and Restoration: A Typology of Pastoralists based on Drivers of Engagement and Social Capital
affiliations: Osnabrück University, Stockholm University - Stockholm Resilience Center, University of Göttingen, University of Göttingen and University of Göttingen

detail.title: Of Unsung Heroes in Biodiversity Conservation and Restoration: A Typology of Pastoralists based on Drivers of Engagement and Social Capital
detail.abstract: The success of conservation and restoration efforts in Europe's vast cultural landscapes will depend strongly on active management by farmers. To maintain or regain the rich fauna and flora of seminatural grasslands requires implementing tailored extensive agropastoral practices. This study develops a typology of pastoralists based on their motivation for engagement and different forms of social capital as a means to support this engagement. We identify three types of pastoralists derived from an empirical case study in Germany, which we call the "Grazing Businesses," "Conservationists" and "Traditionalists". Our findings highlight that financial motives only drive the engagement of the first type of pastoralists, while the second is mainly motivated by environmental stewardship concerns and the third by continuing traditional farming practices. Different types of social capital are instrumentally built and utilized to access distinct benefits embedded in social relationships. The results imply that, while it remains essential to make financial compensation for extensive agropastoral practices attractive, assistance in building social capital tailored to the specific needs of pastoralists appears equally important to support them. Creating and maintaining stable social networks among pastoralists locally as well as with authorities and NGOs helps to leverage monetary (e.g., easy access to financial compensation, brokering grazing service provision) as well as non-monetary (e.g., learning, creating meaning and joint identity) resources. Accommodating these needs of the publicly mostly invisible pastoralists in today's agricultural system-the "unsung heroes"-is key for semi-natural grassland conservation and restoration efforts to help sustain European biodiversity.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于德国案例，将牧民分为三类："放牧企业"、"保护主义者"和"传统主义者"，分析其参与动机和社会资本差异，提出支持半自然草原保护需兼顾经济补偿和社会资本建设。
AI.research_question: 如何通过理解牧民的参与动机和社会资本差异，有效支持欧洲半自然草原的保护和恢复？
AI.motivation: 欧洲文化景观的保护和恢复成功很大程度上依赖于农民的积极参与，而维持半自然草原丰富的动植物多样性需要实施精细化的农牧实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论、动机理论、农牧实践分类学
AI.method: 基于德国案例的实证研究，通过类型学方法对牧民进行分类
AI.findings: 识别出三类牧民：1)"放牧企业"主要受经济利益驱动；2)"保护主义者"主要受环境管理关切驱动；3)"传统主义者"主要受延续传统农业实践驱动。不同类型牧民构建和利用社会资本获取不同利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了基于动机和社会资本的牧民类型学，深化了对农牧实践参与机制的理解，拓展了社会资本在农业保护领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出支持半自然草原保护需要：1)提供有吸引力的经济补偿；2)帮助牧民建立符合其特定需求的社会资本；3)创建和维护稳定的社会网络（包括牧民之间、与当局和NGO的联系）。

title: The Impact of Foreign Direct Investment on Economic Growth in the Gulf Cooperation Council: A Generalised Methods of Moments Analysis
affiliations: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals

detail.title: The Impact of Foreign Direct Investment on Economic Growth in the Gulf Cooperation Council: A Generalised Methods of Moments Analysis
detail.abstract: The natural resource-rich Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries are actively implementing diversification plans to reduce their dependence on oil. This paper examines the role of foreign direct investment (FDI) in the GCC countries from 2001 to 2016, utilising World Bank data. The study controls for endogeneity of FDI and gross domestic product (GDP) growth by using the system generalised method of moments (GMM) approach. The main finding is that FDI has a positive effect on economic growth for all GCC economies. This effect is stronger when it is conditioned on human capital, underscoring the importance of investing in human capital through skills and education to foster FDI growth. Hence, our paper offers policymakers in GCC countries valuable policy recommendations to support their efforts in diversifying their economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2001-2016年世界银行数据，采用系统GMM方法控制内生性，发现FDI对海湾合作委员会国家经济增长有正向影响，且该效应在人力资本条件下更强，为经济多元化政策提供建议。
AI.research_question: 外国直接投资（FDI）在海湾合作委员会（GCC）国家经济多元化进程中扮演什么角色？FDI如何影响这些国家的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 海湾合作委员会国家作为资源丰富的经济体，正在积极实施经济多元化计划以减少对石油的依赖。了解FDI在这些国家经济增长中的作用，对于制定有效的经济多元化政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内生增长理论和新古典增长理论，研究FDI通过技术溢出、资本积累和人力资本提升等渠道对经济增长的影响。
AI.method: 使用2001-2016年世界银行数据，采用系统广义矩估计（GMM）方法控制FDI和GDP增长的内生性问题。
AI.findings: 1. FDI对所有GCC国家的经济增长都有正向影响；2. 当考虑人力资本条件时，FDI对经济增长的促进作用更强；3. 人力资本投资（技能和教育）对于增强FDI的增长效应至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了FDI与经济增长关系在资源丰富经济体中的适用性；2. 强调了人力资本作为FDI增长效应的调节变量；3. 为FDI与经济增长关系的条件性提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为GCC国家政策制定者提供吸引FDI的政策建议；2. 强调投资人力资本（教育和技能培训）的重要性；3. 支持GCC国家经济多元化战略的实施。

title: Citizens' Climate Anxiety -Transnational Insights on the Relevance of Green Areas and their Use for Mental Health in Times of Extreme Events
