title: Dual Monetization on Creator Platforms: The Interplay Between Advertising Revenue and Brand Sponsorship
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing

detail.title: Dual Monetization on Creator Platforms: The Interplay Between Advertising Revenue and Brand Sponsorship

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper No. 5907263
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Platforms featuring creator content generate revenue by showing ads against this content, and share this revenue with creators. In addition, brands pay creators upon including sponsored messages about their offerings in the content. We develop a game theory model to study the intricate strategic interactions that arise among the platform, brands, and creators in this ecosystem. A creator decides content quality and whether to include sponsored elements, where inclusion of sponsored elements implies "dual monetization" for the creator through the ad revenue shared by the platform and the payment from the brand for including sponsored elements in the content. Consumers like organic content but dislike both ads and sponsored content. We show that brand sponsorship weakly benefits the platform through a reduced revenue sharing rate because it can rely on the brand to partially compensate the creator. The creator may be worse off, even with two sources of income, because she may need to produce higher-quality content therefore incurring higher content production costs. Consumers benefit when content quality enhancements outweigh their aversion to sponsored elements. The total welfare of the ecosystem is weakly higher. Our model offers several actionable insights for practitioners and policy makers.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了内容平台生态中平台、品牌和创作者之间的战略互动。创作者决定内容质量和是否包含赞助元素，消费者喜欢有机内容但讨厌广告和赞助内容。研究发现品牌赞助通过降低平台收入分成率使平台受益，创作者可能因需生产更高质量内容而受损，消费者在内容质量提升超过对赞助内容厌恶时受益。
AI.research_question: 在内容平台生态系统中，平台、品牌和创作者之间的战略互动如何影响各方的收益和福利？特别是当创作者通过平台广告分成和品牌赞助实现"双重变现"时，这种互动会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 随着内容平台（如YouTube、TikTok等）的兴起，创作者通过广告分成和品牌赞助实现收入多元化。然而，这种双重变现模式引发了平台、品牌和创作者之间复杂的战略互动，需要理论模型来分析各方决策如何相互影响以及最终对消费者和整体福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析平台、品牌和创作者之间的战略互动。模型考虑了创作者的内容质量决策、是否包含赞助元素的决策，以及消费者对有机内容、广告和赞助内容的偏好差异。
AI.method: 建立博弈理论模型，分析三方参与者的战略互动。模型参数包括：创作者的内容质量、是否包含赞助元素、平台收入分成率、品牌赞助支付、消费者偏好等。通过均衡分析来研究各方的最优策略和福利影响。
AI.findings: 1. 品牌赞助通过降低平台收入分成率使平台受益（品牌部分补偿创作者）；2. 创作者可能受损，即使有两份收入来源，因为需要生产更高质量内容导致成本增加；3. 消费者在内容质量提升超过对赞助内容厌恶时受益；4. 生态系统总福利弱增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析了内容平台生态中平台、品牌和创作者的三方战略互动；2. 揭示了"双重变现"模式对各参与方福利的复杂影响；3. 提供了分析数字内容生态系统的新理论框架；4. 阐明了消费者偏好在平台经济中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台管理者提供收入分成策略的决策依据；2. 帮助创作者理解双重变现的利弊；3. 为品牌制定赞助策略提供参考；4. 为政策制定者监管数字内容生态系统提供分析框架；5. 提供了优化整体社会福利的政策建议。

title: Pension Pyramid Dynamics in Equity Markets: Is Crisis Avoidable?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Pension Pyramid Dynamics in Equity Markets: Is Crisis Avoidable?
detail.abstract: The global shift from pay-as-you-go public pensions toward funded systems has been widely adopted as a solution to demographic aging. This paper argues that the transition has created an unprecedented aggregation of capital in equity markets that faces inevitable reversal with potentially catastrophic consequences. In OECD countries, while pension assets have grown from 45% of GDP (1990) to 170% today, driving their share in equity market capitalization, and P/E ratios to apparently unreasonable levels. These trends suggest systematic asset price inflation driven by mandatory inflows largely independent of economic fundamentals. As worker-to-retiree ratios decline from 3:1 (2020) to 2:1 (2050), dividend and profit distributions can provide only 35-40% of average worker wages—far below the 70-75% replacement rates promised. To bridge this gap, funds holding ~70% of equity markets must become sustained net sellers with no offsetting demand. This structural imbalance implies market repricing of 60-70% or more. This is not merely a pension adequacy problem but a fundamental threat to financial stability. Unlike previous crashes driven by temporary imbalances, this selling pressure is structural and embedded in demographics. Standard stabilization mechanisms are unlikely to succeed. Meaningful mitigation would require rethinking the social contract—yet history suggests such transitions occur only after crises, not before.

AI.tldr: 全球养老金从现收现付制向基金制的转变导致股市资本过度集中，随着人口老龄化加剧，养老基金将被迫成为持续净卖家，可能引发60-70%的市场重定价，威胁金融稳定。
AI.research_question: 从现收现付制向基金制的养老金转型如何通过资本过度集中和结构性失衡威胁金融稳定？
AI.motivation: 全球为应对人口老龄化而广泛采用的养老金基金制转型，导致资本在股市过度集中，随着未来退休人口比例增加，养老基金将被迫大规模抛售资产，可能引发系统性金融风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、人口经济学、金融稳定理论、养老金经济学、市场供需失衡理论
AI.method: 基于OECD国家的历史数据分析（1990年至今），结合人口预测（2020-2050），通过养老金资产占GDP比例、股市市值占比、市盈率等指标，分析结构性失衡的规模和潜在影响。
AI.findings: 1. OECD国家养老金资产从1990年占GDP的45%增长到现在的170%；2. 养老基金推动了股市市值和市盈率至不合理水平；3. 随着工人与退休者比例从3:1降至2:1，股息和利润分配只能提供35-40%的平均工资替代率，远低于承诺的70-75%；4. 为弥补缺口，持有约70%股市的基金将成为持续净卖家；5. 结构性失衡可能导致60-70%或更多的市场重定价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了养老金基金制转型与金融稳定之间的结构性矛盾；2. 提出了"结构性抛售压力"概念，区别于传统周期性市场失衡；3. 建立了人口老龄化、养老金缺口与资产价格重定价之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示政策制定者养老金转型可能带来的系统性金融风险；2. 指出传统稳定机制可能失效；3. 强调需要重新思考社会契约，但历史表明重大改革往往在危机后才发生。

title: A 45-Year Community-Based Model for Preventing Homelessness and Poverty. An analysis of the Senior Citizens United Community Services Framework
affiliations: Rutgers- Camden

detail.title: A 45-Year Community-Based Model for Preventing Homelessness and Poverty. An analysis of the Senior Citizens United Community Services Framework
detail.abstract: Shared housing remains an underused strategy in U.S. homelessness prevention, despite decades of local successes. This study offers the first published longitudinal case study of a 40+ year U.S. shared housing prevention program. Detailing the case study of Senior Citizens United Community Services (SCUCS), a nonprofit in Camden County, NJ, operating a shared housing prevention program since 1982. Using structured staff interviews, program document analysis, and secondary data triangulation, the analysis documents operational best practices, participant outcomes, and public cost savings. Critical features-including compatibility-based matching (90% threshold), low-barrier intake, "Scary Hours" trial periods, $500-700 monthly rents, income verification, and ongoing case management-have driven 350% growth among home providers (from 2 to 7 in 2024) and long-term stability for both homeowners and tenants (up to 15 years, including inheritances and chosen-family bonds). Replication requires multiyear funding (minimum 3-year cycles), local government partnerships (e.g., Camden County referrals), legal clarity (homesharing vs. landlord-tenant), equity commitment (anti-bias training), and robust outreach (grassroots + digital). Policy recommendations highlight federal/state support to mainstream shared housing, reduce stigma, and leverage existing assets for upstream poverty prevention, yielding $16,282 annual public savings per person (Culhane et al., 2002).

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过对美国新泽西州Camden县一个运行40多年的共享住房预防项目（SCUCS）的纵向案例研究，分析了共享住房在预防无家可归方面的成功实践、关键特征和政策意义。
AI.research_question: 美国共享住房作为预防无家可归的策略为何未被充分利用？一个成功运行40多年的共享住房预防项目有哪些关键特征和最佳实践？
AI.motivation: 共享住房在美国预防无家可归方面长期未被充分利用，尽管地方层面已有数十年的成功经验。需要深入理解长期成功的共享住房项目的运作机制和关键要素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共享住房理论、无家可归预防理论、社会支持网络理论、资产利用理论（利用现有住房资源）
AI.method: 纵向案例研究（40多年历史），采用结构化员工访谈、项目文件分析和二手数据三角验证的方法
AI.findings: SCUCS项目的关键成功特征包括：基于兼容性的匹配（90%阈值）、低门槛准入、"恐怖时刻"试用期、500-700美元月租金、收入验证和持续个案管理。这些特征推动了住房提供者350%的增长（从2个到7个）和长期稳定性（长达15年，包括继承和选择家庭关系）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为共享住房作为无家可归预防策略提供了实证支持，识别了长期成功项目的关键运作机制，丰富了共享住房理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制的操作指南：多年期资金（至少3年周期）、地方政府合作、法律清晰化（住房共享vs房东-租客关系）、公平承诺（反偏见培训）和强有力的外展（基层+数字）。政策建议强调联邦/州支持以推广共享住房，减少污名化，利用现有资产进行上游贫困预防，每人每年可节省16,282美元公共开支。

title: Integration of Federal Government Information Systems and Marketplaces: Ensuring Traceability of Goods in Supply Chain
affiliations: MGIMO (Moscow State University of International Relations)

detail.title: Integration of Federal Government Information Systems and Marketplaces: Ensuring Traceability of Goods in Supply Chain
detail.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to identify opportunities, risks, and prospects for setting up trading platforms based on federal government information systems (FGISes).

In recent years, the federal government has developed a large number of FGISes, and according to unofficial estimates, their number exceeds 1,000 at present. However, entrepreneurs still question the feasibility of connecting to and transmitting data through these systems. 

The process of setting up a trading platform based on federal government information systems involves several key stages:

1) Market needs analysis and target audience selection
• assessment of supply and demand in the specific industry
• identification of the most demanded categories of goods and services
2) Development of platform functionality and architecture
• designing interfaces for easy navigation and transaction execution
• integration with existing FGISes to ensure continuity of processes
3) Legal support and coordination with regulatory authorities
• coordination of regulatory framework to ensure platform operability
• obtaining permits and licenses, if required by law
4) Testing and launching a beta version
• conducting testing of platform's functionality
• collecting feedback from first users and eliminating shortcomings
5) Scaling and popularization
• promoting platform to potential users
• organizing educational events and training
6) Constant updating and upgrading
• monitoring of changes in legislation and industry trends
• implementation of new technological solutions and optimization of processes

Despite the numerous advantages, there are a number of challenges that hinder the effective use of FGISes:
- information security issues: transfer of large amounts of confidential data creates potential risks of leaks and unauthorized access;
- technical failures: temporary unavailability of systems leads to delays in the execution of contracts and other negative consequences;
- insufficient readiness of market participants: many entities have difficulty adapting to modern digital tools;
- incompatibility of systems: lack of uniform standards makes it difficult for effective interaction between different FGISes.

However, there are also promising developments, such as:
- big data analysis: deploying big data methods makes it possible to identify hidden patterns, improve forecasts and increase the efficiency of decision-making;
- artificial intelligence and machine learning;
- unification of standards and protocols: standardization to ensure full compatibility between different FGISes, simplify information exchange and increase overall productivity;
- development of mobile applications: convenient mobile access will expand user audience and make services more accessible and convenient;
- cloud technologies: using cloud platforms will reduce maintenance costs and increase flexibility and scalability of systems;
- strengthening cybersecurity: continuous improvement of data protection mechanisms will be the critical factor in the successful development of digital government services.

Further research will focus on integration of existing FGISes between themselves, enhancement of trading platforms functionality, promotion and logistics support efforts in respect to marketplaces created on the basis of FGISes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨基于联邦政府信息系统(FGIS)建立交易平台的机遇、风险与前景，分析平台建设的关键阶段、面临的挑战以及未来发展趋势。
AI.research_question: 基于联邦政府信息系统(FGIS)建立交易平台存在哪些机遇、风险和前景？
AI.motivation: 尽管联邦政府已开发超过1000个信息系统，但企业家仍质疑连接这些系统的可行性，需要系统分析基于FGIS建立交易平台的实施路径和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字政府服务理论、平台经济学、信息系统集成理论、网络安全框架、技术创新采纳理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于文献综述和实践观察，系统梳理平台建设的关键阶段、挑战和机遇。
AI.findings:
1. 平台建设需经历六个关键阶段：市场需求分析、功能架构开发、法律协调、测试上线、推广普及、持续更新
2. 面临四大挑战：信息安全风险、技术故障、市场参与者准备不足、系统不兼容
3. 存在六大发展前景：大数据分析、人工智能、标准统一、移动应用、云技术、网络安全强化
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 构建了基于政府信息系统建立交易平台的理论框架
2. 识别了数字政府服务平台化的关键成功因素
3. 提出了政府信息系统向商业平台转型的路径模型
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业家提供基于FGIS建立交易平台的实施指南
2. 为政府机构优化信息系统设计提供参考
3. 识别了系统集成和安全防护的具体措施
4. 指出了未来技术发展方向和标准化需求

title: The Contradiction Trap: A Dialectical and Game-Theoretic Framework for Exposing Structural Bias

detail.title: The Contradiction Trap: A Dialectical and Game-Theoretic Framework for Exposing Structural Bias
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the contradiction trap: a formal, dialectical and gametheoretic instrument for exposing bias, inconsistency, or concealed motive by forcing a system to reconcile mutually exclusive commitments. Rooted in reductio ad absurdum yet extended through strategic design, the trap reframes contradiction from error into evidence: a measurable signal of reasoning integrity in human, organisational, and algorithmic decision-making. We model the trap as a one-move, strictly competitive epistemic game in which every available strategy for the responder incurs internal contradiction. Payoffs are informational rather than material, converting asymmetry into data and inconsistency into evidential gain. The framework yields a portable diagnostic for auditing neutrality claims across law, governance, and AI, and motivates a general principle: asymmetry without necessity increases the posterior probability of intent. We outline a research programme to quantify coherence cost, embed traps in audit pipelines, and study bounded coherence in human agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"矛盾陷阱"这一形式化、辩证且博弈论的工具，用于通过迫使系统调和相互排斥的承诺来暴露偏见、不一致性或隐藏动机。该工具将矛盾从错误重新定义为证据，成为衡量人类、组织和算法决策中推理完整性的可测量信号。
AI.research_question: 如何通过形式化的博弈论框架来检测和暴露决策系统中的偏见、不一致性和隐藏动机？
AI.motivation: 当前在审计法律、治理和人工智能系统时，缺乏有效的工具来检测表面中立声明下的偏见和不一致性。需要一种能够将矛盾转化为证据的框架来评估推理完整性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于归谬法（reductio ad absurdum）和博弈论，将矛盾陷阱建模为一回合严格竞争认知博弈，其中回应者的所有可用策略都会导致内部矛盾。强调信息性收益而非物质收益。
AI.method: 将矛盾陷阱建模为一回合严格竞争认知博弈，通过迫使系统调和相互排斥的承诺来产生矛盾。将不对称性转化为数据，将不一致性转化为证据增益。
AI.findings: 矛盾陷阱能够有效暴露偏见、不一致性或隐藏动机，为审计法律、治理和AI系统的中立声明提供可移植的诊断工具。提出一般原则：不必要的非对称性会增加意图的后验概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将矛盾从错误重新定义为证据；2. 提出形式化的矛盾陷阱框架；3. 建立信息性收益的博弈论模型；4. 提出"不对称性增加意图概率"的一般原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法律、治理和AI系统提供可移植的审计工具；2. 可用于检测决策系统中的偏见和不一致性；3. 支持将陷阱嵌入审计流程；4. 促进量化一致性成本的研究。

title: Consumer Behavior and the Incidence of Tariffs: Salience, Identity, and the Politics of Paying More
affiliations: University of Delaware and Oklahoma State University - Stillwater - Department of Agricultural Economics

detail.title: Consumer Behavior and the Incidence of Tariffs: Salience, Identity, and the Politics of Paying More
detail.abstract: Food prices are one of the most politically salient household expenses, shaping electoral outcomes and trade debates. After the 2024 election, the second Trump administration enacted broad import tariffss-including on food products-despite campaign promises to lower grocery costs. This study investigates how consumers respond to such politically framed price increases using a randomized dichotomous choice experiment. Participants were assigned to receive one of several tariff justifications-such as re-shoring production, countering unfair trade, or reducing illegal immigration-with or without exposure to an image of President Trump. Contrary to expectations, political rationales lowered willingness to pay (WTP) on average. This effect was driven by strong negative responses among Democrats and, to a lesser extent, Independents. Republicans' responses were largely unaffected by policy justification. The magnitude of our estimated effects varied across policy justifications and appears to be amplified when paired with Trump's image. These findings show that political framing can backfire and reduce public tolerance of tariff-induced food price increases.

AI.tldr: 研究发现政治理由会降低消费者对关税导致食品价格上涨的支付意愿，特别是对民主党和独立选民，而共和党基本不受影响。特朗普形象会放大这种负面效应。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何对政治框架下的食品价格上涨（特别是关税导致的）做出反应？政治理由和特朗普形象如何影响支付意愿？
AI.motivation: 食品价格是家庭最敏感的政治议题之一，影响选举和贸易辩论。特朗普政府在2024年大选后实施广泛进口关税（包括食品），尽管竞选时承诺降低食品成本。需要研究消费者对政治框架下价格上涨的反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、行为经济学、框架效应理论、党派认同理论、消费者行为理论
AI.method: 随机化二分选择实验，参与者被分配接受不同的关税理由（如回流生产、应对不公平贸易、减少非法移民），部分参与者暴露于特朗普形象
AI.findings: 1. 政治理由平均降低了支付意愿；2. 民主党反应最负面，独立选民次之，共和党基本不受影响；3. 效应大小因政策理由而异；4. 特朗普形象会放大负面效应
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了政治框架可能适得其反，降低公众对关税导致价格上涨的容忍度；2. 展示了党派认同如何调节对政策理由的反应；3. 扩展了框架效应理论在政治经济学中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供警示：政治理由可能削弱公众对价格上涨的接受度；2. 帮助理解党派分歧如何影响经济政策接受度；3. 为贸易政策沟通策略提供实证依据

title: Short-Term Rentals and Their Dual Impact in College Towns: A Multi-Site Panel Study on Housing Affordability and Hotel Market Displacement

detail.title: Short-Term Rentals and Their Dual Impact in College Towns: A Multi-Site Panel Study on Housing Affordability and Hotel Market Displacement
detail.abstract: This study measures how the rapid rise of short-term rentals (STRs), such as Airbnb listings, affects both long-term housing costs and hotel performance in U.S. college towns. We merge monthly data from AirDNA, Zillow, STR Global, the Bureau of Labor Statistics, and the National Center for Education Statistics for ten college communities between January 2020 and December 2021. Using a difference-indifferences design and two-way fixed-effects panel regressions, we relate changes in STR density to city-level median rents and hotel revenue per available room (RevPAR), while controlling for employment, income, enrollment, and event weeks. Results show that adding one STR for every 1,000 housing units raises median rent by just over four percent, with the effect climbing to six percent in towns where new construction is slow. In parallel, a one-unit increase in STR density is linked to a 1.8 percent drop in hotel RevPAR, a decline that grows during football and graduation months. These findings suggest that STR growth squeezes renters and trims hotel windfalls in college markets. Cities may therefore need locally tailored caps or licensing rules, while universities should expand student housing and open dorms during peak events to ease market pressure.

AI.tldr: 该研究测量了短期租赁（如Airbnb）在美国大学城的快速增长如何影响长期住房成本和酒店业绩。研究发现，每1000个住房单元增加一个短期租赁会使中位数租金上涨4%以上，在新建缓慢的城镇中效果达到6%。同时，短期租赁密度每增加一个单位会导致酒店每间可用客房收入下降1.8%，在足球赛季和毕业月份下降更明显。
AI.research_question: 短期租赁（如Airbnb）在美国大学城的快速增长如何影响长期住房成本和酒店业绩？
AI.motivation: 短期租赁平台如Airbnb的兴起改变了住房市场格局，特别是在大学城这种旅游需求季节性强的地区。了解其对长期住房成本和酒店业的影响对政策制定者和大学管理者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房经济学和酒店业竞争理论，研究短期租赁对住房供给和酒店需求的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用双重差分设计和双向固定效应面板回归分析，整合AirDNA、Zillow、STR Global、劳工统计局和国家教育统计中心的数据，涵盖2020年1月至2021年12月期间10个大学社区。
AI.findings: 1. 每1000个住房单元增加一个短期租赁会使中位数租金上涨4%以上，在新建缓慢的城镇中效果达到6%。2. 短期租赁密度每增加一个单位会导致酒店每间可用客房收入下降1.8%，在足球赛季和毕业月份下降更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了短期租赁对大学城住房市场的具体影响程度。2. 揭示了短期租赁对酒店业的竞争效应及其季节性变化。3. 提供了短期租赁在不同市场条件下（如新建速度）影响差异的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议城市制定本地化的短期租赁上限或许可规则。2. 建议大学扩大学生住房供应，在高峰活动期间开放宿舍以缓解市场压力。3. 为政策制定者提供了基于实证的政策干预依据。

reference: Journal of Tax Reform, volume 11, issue 4, 2025[10.15826/jtr.2025.11.4.228]
title: Effect of Corporate Taxes on Business R&D Expenditure in Central Europe
affiliations: University of Eldoret, Southwest University, Southwest University,  and

detail.title: Effect of Corporate Taxes on Business R&D Expenditure in Central Europe

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Tax Reform, volume 11, issue 4, 2025[10.15826/jtr.2025.11.4.228]

detail.abstract: Governments progressively rely on taxes and incentives to reassure business research and development (R&D) and innovation investment. They make qualified investments that are financially gainful to firms, pouring growth but reducing governments' direct tax intake. Taxation and incentive policies determine organizations' capability to invest in innovation. The study investigates the effect of corporate taxes on business R&D investment for the period 2000-2022. The empirical analysis examines four Central European countries-Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, and Slovakia-which are similar in terms of economic and technological development. The study focuses on four primary indicators influencing the decision-making underlying the business R&D expenditure process: corporate tax, tax incentives, government expenditure on R&D, and human capital accumulation. In this context, panel data and the ARDL model are used to investigate the effect of exogenous variables on the business R&D intensity of Europe. The research findings show that corporate tax has a substantial and adverse impact on the business expenditure on R&D. In contrast, tax incentives and government expenditure on R&D positively and significantly impact the business expenditure on R&D in the long run. Furthermore, all exogenous variables significantly increased the intensity of business research in the short run. The empirical results suggest that policymakers in Central Europe should develop targeted corporate tax policy that addresses innovation bottlenecks but simultaneously creates strategic incentives. More specifically, governments are expected to develop targeted tax credit mechanisms that mitigate financial barriers to R&D investment, especially for businesses.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了2000-2022年间公司税收对中欧四国企业研发投资的影响，发现公司税对企业研发支出有显著负面影响，而税收激励和政府研发支出则有长期正面影响。
AI.research_question: 公司税收如何影响中欧国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰、斯洛伐克）的企业研发投资？
AI.motivation: 政府越来越依赖税收和激励政策来促进企业研发和创新投资，但这些政策会影响企业的投资能力，同时减少政府的直接税收收入。需要了解税收政策对企业创新投资的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收政策与企业创新投资关系的理论框架，探讨公司税、税收激励、政府研发支出和人力资本积累对企业研发决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用面板数据和ARDL（自回归分布滞后）模型，分析2000-2022年间捷克、匈牙利、波兰、斯洛伐克四个中欧国家的数据，研究外生变量对企业研发强度的影响。
AI.findings: 公司税对企业研发支出有显著负面影响；税收激励和政府研发支出在长期对企业研发支出有显著正面影响；所有外生变量在短期内都显著提高了企业研发强度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为税收政策与企业创新投资关系提供了实证证据，特别在中欧转型经济体的背景下，验证了不同税收工具对企业研发决策的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议中欧政策制定者制定有针对性的公司税政策，既要解决创新瓶颈，又要创造战略激励，特别是建立有针对性的税收抵免机制来减轻企业研发投资的财务障碍。

title: Human Emotions- Fear, Greed and Hope Influence on Market

detail.title: Human Emotions- Fear, Greed and Hope Influence on Market
detail.abstract: This research paper analyses the impact of human emotion on the the the functioning of the financial market. It is grounded within the framework of behavioural finance which examines market irrationality, investor irrationality, and the economic cycles associated with the market. It was found that fear brings about panic selling and undervaluation, greed results in overvaluation and the creation of bubbles, and hope prolongs the irrational, losing of the the asset. It was also that emotions, are a part of the human decision making and it must be accompanied with increased focus of the the market. This muted the adverse impact of such emotions is possible with the use of well defined understanding of emotions .Individual investors, financial advisers, policymakers, and regulators must focus on the the of emotions to encourage market stability. This study underscores the need for integrating psychological factors into traditional economic models for a holistic understanding of market dynamics. Money and markets are not merely about numbers they are very much human. This paper reveals that one of the main reasons stock prices go up and down wildly are the actions driven by the emotional states of people to fear, greed, and hope. Along the path of the emotional rollercoaster of investing, we go through the instances of the COVID-19 crash and the dot-com bubble to understand why people are likely to follow the crowd or keep a bad decision. There are also simple mood indicators for the market and calmness strategies that can be used by anyone to make better decisions. By borrowing insights from be-Research Paper Manya Hora havioural finance, this paper argues that recognising your emotions is not only essential for better investing but also for a more stable financial world shared by everyone.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了人类情绪对金融市场运作的影响，发现恐惧导致恐慌性抛售和低估，贪婪导致高估和泡沫形成，希望则延长非理性资产持有。研究强调将心理因素纳入传统经济模型的重要性，并提出了情绪管理策略。
AI.research_question: 人类情绪如何影响金融市场的运作和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统经济模型往往忽视心理因素，但金融市场中观察到的非理性行为（如恐慌性抛售、泡沫形成）表明情绪对市场动态有重要影响。理解情绪在市场中的作用对于改善投资决策和市场稳定性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论框架，包括市场非理性、投资者非理性、经济周期理论，以及恐惧、贪婪、希望等情绪对决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 基于行为金融学理论的分析方法，结合历史案例研究（如COVID-19崩盘和互联网泡沫），分析情绪对市场行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 恐惧导致恐慌性抛售和资产低估；2. 贪婪导致资产高估和泡沫形成；3. 希望延长非理性资产持有；4. 情绪是人类决策的内在组成部分，对市场有显著影响；5. 通过理解和管理情绪可以减轻其负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将心理学因素系统性地整合到金融理论中，扩展了行为金融学框架，强调了情绪在解释市场非理性行为中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人投资者、财务顾问、政策制定者和监管机构提供了情绪管理策略，包括简单市场情绪指标和冷静策略，以改善投资决策和促进市场稳定。

title: "Revolutionizing Drug Discovery: Embracing Open-source Models and Navigating Intellectual Property Frontiers for Collaborative Innovation In The Pharmaceutical Industry"
affiliations: and Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University - School of Excellence in Law (SOEL)

detail.title: "Revolutionizing Drug Discovery: Embracing Open-source Models and Navigating Intellectual Property Frontiers for Collaborative Innovation In The Pharmaceutical Industry"
detail.abstract: The need for more effective drug discovery procedures and the rising demand for novel treatments are driving a significant transition in the pharmaceutical sector. The idea of using open-source models in drug discovery is examined in this study as a way to boost industry collaboration and innovation. Open-source projects have the ability to expedite drug development processes and lower the time and expense involved in bringing novel medications to market by exchanging data, resources, and expertise. However, there are significant concerns about intellectual property (IP) rights and protection raised by the pharmaceutical industry's use of open-source methods. This article explores the potential and difficulties that open-source methods provide while negotiating the intricate intellectual property (IP) landscape of drug research. It goes over how businesses can use licensing agreements, patents, and other IP protection tools to secure their unique interests while strategically utilizing open-source partnerships. This article also emphasizes how legislators and regulatory agencies support open innovation in the pharmaceutical sector. Regulators can accelerate the development of novel medicines and more successfully address unmet medical needs by fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing regulatory environment. This study makes the case that encouraging collaborative innovation in the pharmaceutical sector requires embracing open-source approaches and navigating the boundaries of intellectual property. The industry can open up new avenues for medication discovery and development by tearing down conventional barriers to cooperation and sharing, which will eventually improve patient outcomes for people all around the world.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了开源模式在药物发现中的应用，分析了其在促进产业合作与创新的潜力，同时讨论了知识产权保护的挑战，并提出了平衡开源协作与IP保护的策略。
AI.research_question: 如何在药物发现中有效利用开源模式来促进创新合作，同时应对知识产权保护的挑战？
AI.motivation: 制药行业面临提高药物发现效率和满足新疗法需求的压力，开源模式有望通过共享数据、资源和专业知识加速药物开发，但知识产权保护问题成为主要障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开放式创新理论，结合知识产权管理框架，探讨开源协作与专利保护的平衡策略。
AI.method: 概念性分析研究，通过文献综述和案例分析，探讨开源模式在制药行业的应用场景、IP挑战及解决方案。
AI.findings: 开源模式能显著加速药物开发并降低成本，但需要精心设计的IP保护策略；企业可通过许可协议、专利组合等工具保护核心利益；监管环境的支持对促进开放创新至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了开放式创新理论在制药行业的应用，提出了平衡开源协作与知识产权保护的理论框架，为药物发现领域的合作创新提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制药企业提供了利用开源模式的具体策略，包括IP保护工具的选择和监管环境的应对；为政策制定者提供了促进开放创新的监管建议；有助于加速新药开发并改善患者治疗效果。

title: Electrical capacity of products and its impact on regional economy
affiliations: Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration North-West Institute of Management

detail.title: Electrical capacity of products and its impact on regional economy
detail.abstract: Introduction. The legislative acts adopted by the country’s leadership determine the relevance of the research topic, while their execution brings forward certain difficulties. It is considered to be a challenge for the state to simultaneously promote the economic growth of the Russian regions, comply with the requirements for sustainable development of territories, and reduce the use of energy resources for production. Purpose. The purpose of the research is to determine the electrical capacity of products and its impact on the sustainable development of regional economies in order to adopt appropriate typological decisions by authorities. To do this, the growth rates of industrial production and electricity consumption were calculated. Materials and Methods. The study refers to 2017–2022 Rosstat data on industrial production, energy consumption, and gross regional product. The basic method is applied to calculate the growth rates, and the grouping method is used to analyze the findings. Results. The article considers a possible solution to a two pronged problem when the authorities manage the growth rates of both industrial production and its electrical capacity. The findings reveal similar characteristics among the regions, which could categorize them intro groups. These groups show region-oriented electricity consumption, electrical intensity, and the developed structure of branches in regional economies, and could determine the impact of ongoing processes (indicators in questions) on the gross regional product. The proposed approach has both theoretical and practical significance: it facilitates the adoption of reference management decisions by regional authorities to manage the growth rates of independent variables. Conclusion. The study is relevant as it words the research problem, proposes the assessment methodology for the growth rate of electrical capacity of industrial products, determines its impact on the sectoral structure of gross value added (sections B, C, D, E), which constitutes the gross regional product.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了俄罗斯地区工业生产的电力容量及其对区域经济可持续发展的影响，通过计算工业生产增长率和电力消耗增长率，为政府制定区域能源政策提供参考依据。
AI.research_question: 工业产品的电力容量如何影响区域经济的可持续发展？政府应如何基于电力容量指标制定区域分类决策？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯政府在促进区域经济增长、遵守可持续发展要求和减少生产能源消耗方面面临挑战，需要科学依据来制定平衡的政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、区域经济增长理论、能源效率理论，以及电力容量与经济发展关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2017-2022年俄罗斯统计局数据，采用基本方法计算工业生产增长率和电力消耗增长率，运用分组方法分析研究结果。
AI.findings: 研究发现各地区具有相似特征，可按电力消耗、电力强度和区域经济部门结构进行分类。这些分类可确定相关指标对地区生产总值的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估工业产品电力容量增长率的方​​法论，建立了电力容量与区域经济可持续发展的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域政府提供了参考管理决策工具，帮助管理独立变量的增长率，优化区域能源政策和经济结构。

title: SecureFinAI: Integrating LLM-Generated Signals with Reinforcement Learning for High-Frequency Crypto Trading
affiliations: and

detail.title: SecureFinAI: Integrating LLM-Generated Signals with Reinforcement Learning for High-Frequency Crypto Trading
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a high-frequency cryptocurrency trading framework that integrates sentiment signals derived from large language models (LLMs) into reinforcement learning (RL)-based decision-making. Developed for the FinAI 2025 Competition, the proposed system-FinRL-DeepSeek-combines Alpha101 technical indicators with LLM-generated sentiment embeddings to train an ensemble of deep RL agents. The framework employs a multistage pipeline encompassing supervised feature aggregation, Transformer-based sentiment modeling, and Deep Q-Network (DQN) portfolio optimization. Empirical results demonstrate that incorporating LLM-driven sentiment representations substantially enhances trading stability and overall performance under volatile market conditions. All trading policies are learned end-to-end from structured market features and unstructured text embeddings, without reliance on prompt engineering or rule-based heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个高频加密货币交易框架，将大语言模型生成的情感信号与强化学习决策相结合，通过技术指标和情感嵌入训练深度强化学习代理，显著提升了交易稳定性和性能。
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合大语言模型生成的情感信号与强化学习框架，以提升高频加密货币交易的稳定性和整体性能？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场高度波动，传统技术指标难以捕捉市场情绪变化。需要结合非结构化文本信息和结构化市场数据，开发更稳健的交易策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合行为金融学（市场情绪影响资产价格）、强化学习理论（序列决策优化）、以及自然语言处理（文本情感分析）。
AI.method: 多阶段管道：1）监督特征聚合（Alpha101技术指标）；2）基于Transformer的情感建模（LLM生成情感嵌入）；3）深度Q网络（DQN）组合优化；4）深度强化学习代理集成训练。
AI.findings: 实证结果表明，整合LLM驱动的情感表征显著增强了交易稳定性，并在波动市场条件下提升了整体交易性能。系统能够端到端学习结构化市场特征和非结构化文本嵌入。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了结合LLM情感信号与RL决策的新型交易框架；2）开发了无需提示工程或基于规则启发式的端到端学习系统；3）验证了情感嵌入在高频交易中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为FinAI 2025竞赛开发的FinRL-DeepSeek系统；2）提供了可应用于实际加密货币交易的高频交易框架；3）展示了在波动市场中提升交易稳定性的实用方法。

title: Determinants of Energy Consumption in Kenya: A Macroeconomic Perspective
affiliations: University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret and University of Eldoret

detail.title: Determinants of Energy Consumption in Kenya: A Macroeconomic Perspective
detail.abstract: To achieve reliable and sustainable energy access in Kenya, it is crucial to explore alternatives to traditional biomass and fossil fuels to address the challenges of limited electricity, affordable and clean cooking energy. Using the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) technique, this study assessed macroeconomic factors affecting energy consumption in Kenya from 1980 to 2024. The results indicate that interest rates (β =-0.034, p = 0.038) and trade openness (β =-0.015, p = 0.006) negatively impact energy consumption, while foreign direct investment (FDI) has a positive effect (β = 0.020, p = 0.029). Economic growth and inflation were found to be statistically insignificant. Short-term energy consumption is characterised by inertia, driven by the immediate effects of interest rate fluctuations and trade liberalisation. Initially, FDI seems to reduce energy use due to project delays. The study concludes that structural and external factorsspecifically FDI, interest rates, and trade openness-play a more significant role in energy consumption than economic growth or inflation. Recommendations include promoting energy-efficient investments through green FDI and aligning monetary policy with energy objectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ARDL模型分析了1980-2024年肯尼亚能源消费的宏观经济影响因素，发现利率和贸易开放度对能源消费有负向影响，而外国直接投资有正向影响，经济增长和通胀则不显著。
AI.research_question: 哪些宏观经济因素影响肯尼亚的能源消费？利率、贸易开放度、外国直接投资、经济增长和通胀对能源消费有何影响？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚面临可靠和可持续能源获取的挑战，需要探索传统生物质和化石燃料的替代方案，以解决电力有限、可负担清洁烹饪能源的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源经济学理论，研究宏观经济变量（利率、贸易开放度、FDI、经济增长、通胀）与能源消费之间的关系，使用ARDL模型分析长期和短期效应。
AI.method: 使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）技术，分析1980年至2024年肯尼亚的时间序列数据，检验宏观经济因素对能源消费的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 利率（β=-0.034, p=0.038）和贸易开放度（β=-0.015, p=0.006）对能源消费有显著负向影响；2. 外国直接投资（β=0.020, p=0.029）有显著正向影响；3. 经济增长和通胀统计上不显著；4. 短期能源消费存在惯性，受利率波动和贸易自由化的即时效应驱动；5. 初期FDI因项目延迟似乎会减少能源使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了在发展中国家背景下，结构性因素（FDI、利率、贸易开放度）比传统宏观经济变量（经济增长、通胀）对能源消费的影响更显著；2. 揭示了FDI对能源消费的复杂动态效应（短期负向、长期正向）；3. 为能源消费的宏观经济决定因素理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策建议：通过绿色FDI促进能源高效投资；2. 将货币政策与能源目标协调一致；3. 关注贸易政策对能源消费的影响；4. 为肯尼亚可持续能源转型提供实证依据。

title: Inference for Nonlinear Functionals in Nonparametric Quantile IV Models under Non-identification and Non-smoothness

detail.title: Inference for Nonlinear Functionals in Nonparametric Quantile IV Models under Non-identification and Non-smoothness
detail.abstract: This paper studies inference for nonlinear functionals in nonparametric quantile instrumental variable (NPQIV) models, a setting known to be challenging due to ill-posedness, non-identification, and the nonsmoothness of economically relevant functionals. I construct a Tikhonov-regularized estimator in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space and prove consistency under compact and potentially non-injective operators. For functionals that are directionally but not Fréchet differentiable, I establish a non-Gaussian limit characterized by the support functional over the Clarke subdifferential. I show that a directional multiplier bootstrap consistently approximates this distribution, and I derive a Berry-Esseen-type bound. Under mild entropy and continuity conditions, the bootstrap is uniformly valid over quantile indices. For linear functionals, I develop a data-driven tuning rule that achieves the minimax rate without prior knowledge of smoothness. I further extend the theory to shape-constrained estimators, with limiting distributions governed by directional derivatives along tangent cones. These results provide a general and rate-optimal framework for uniform inference on nonlinear functionals in NPQIV models, even when the model is only partially identified. Simulations support the theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非参数分位数工具变量模型中的非线性泛函推断问题，提出了一种基于Tikhonov正则化的核空间估计方法，建立了非高斯极限理论，并开发了方向乘子自助法进行一致分布逼近，为部分识别模型提供了统一的、速率最优的推断框架。
AI.research_question: 如何在非参数分位数工具变量模型中，对非线性泛函进行统计推断，特别是在模型存在病态性、非识别性和泛函非光滑性的挑战下？
AI.motivation: 非参数分位数工具变量模型在经济计量学中具有重要应用，但由于病态性、非识别性和非线性泛函的非光滑性，其统计推断面临理论挑战。现有方法在处理这些复杂情况时存在局限，需要开发更稳健的推断框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于再生核希尔伯特空间的Tikhonov正则化估计理论、方向微分与Clarke次微分理论、方向乘子自助法、Berry-Esseen类型边界理论、切线锥方向导数理论。
AI.method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间中构造Tikhonov正则化估计器；对方向可微但非Fréchet可微的泛函建立非高斯极限理论；开发方向乘子自助法进行分布逼近；提出数据驱动的调参规则实现极小极大速率；扩展理论到形状约束估计器。
AI.findings: 1) 在紧致且可能非单射算子下证明了估计的一致性；2) 建立了由Clarke次微分支撑泛函刻画的非高斯极限分布；3) 方向乘子自助法能够一致逼近该分布；4) 在温和的熵和连续性条件下，自助法在分位数指数上具有均匀有效性；5) 线性泛函的数据驱动调参规则无需先验光滑知识即可达到极小极大速率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为NPQIV模型中非线性泛函推断提供了统一的理论框架；2) 建立了方向可微泛函的非高斯极限理论；3) 证明了方向乘子自助法的均匀有效性；4) 将理论扩展到形状约束估计器；5) 提供了速率最优的推断方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为经济计量学中复杂模型的推断提供了实用工具；2) 数据驱动调参规则简化了实际应用；3) 即使在部分识别情况下也能进行有效推断；4) 模拟研究验证了理论结果的实际可行性。

title: An Anatomy of Tax Burden

detail.title: An Anatomy of Tax Burden

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for conducting this study.

detail.abstract: A tax affects not only the liable party but also others through market adjustments induced by the liable party's response. Because tax liability alone cannot account for these indirect effects, modern economics measures tax burden primarily through the concept of incidence, which captures agents' ultimate burdens as welfare differences between equilibria before and after a tax policy change. However, once a new equilibrium is reached, the liable party retains an ongoing obligation to remit tax for as long as the policy remains in force---continuously transferring economic value to the government. Since incidence measures effects only through changes between equilibria, it does not fully capture this ongoing structural dimension. This paper investigates tax-shifting phenomena by closely tracing the temporal sequence and the flow and change of economic value, considering the potential influence of judgment heuristics. The analysis demonstrates that this ongoing structural obligation has distinct significance beyond incidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出传统税收归宿理论仅关注税收政策变化前后的均衡比较，但忽略了纳税人持续向政府转移经济价值的结构性义务。作者通过追踪经济价值的时间序列和流动变化，分析税收转嫁现象，发现这种持续的结构性义务具有超越传统归宿理论的重要意义。
AI.research_question: 税收的持续结构性义务（纳税人长期向政府转移经济价值的义务）如何影响税收负担分析？这种结构性义务与传统税收归宿理论相比有何独特意义？
AI.motivation: 传统税收归宿理论仅测量税收政策变化前后均衡状态下的福利差异，但忽略了纳税人一旦达到新均衡后，只要税收政策持续有效，就存在持续向政府转移经济价值的结构性义务。这种持续义务在传统分析框架中被忽视，需要新的分析视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收归宿理论、均衡分析、福利经济学、行为经济学中的判断启发式、经济价值流动分析、时间序列分析
AI.method: 通过追踪经济价值的时间序列、流动和变化来分析税收转嫁现象，考虑判断启发式的潜在影响，比较传统均衡分析与结构性义务分析的区别。
AI.findings: 税收的持续结构性义务具有超越传统税收归宿理论的重要意义。这种义务不仅体现在均衡变化中，还体现在纳税人长期持续向政府转移经济价值的过程中，这一维度在传统分析中被忽视但对理解税收负担有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了税收负担分析的理论框架，从仅关注均衡变化扩展到包含持续结构性义务的维度
2. 揭示了传统税收归宿理论的局限性，提出了更全面的税收负担分析视角
3. 将时间序列分析和经济价值流动纳入税收理论分析
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供更全面的税收负担评估工具
2. 帮助企业更好地理解长期税收义务对经营决策的影响
3. 为税收政策设计和改革提供更准确的分析基础

title: Reappraising the Startup Capital Stack: A Dual-Class Equity Model to Rebalance Control and Protect Founders and Employees
affiliations: Mercer

detail.title: Reappraising the Startup Capital Stack: A Dual-Class Equity Model to Rebalance Control and Protect Founders and Employees
detail.abstract:
This paper reexamines the startup capital structure and proposes a dual class equity model that rebalances governance and control between founders, employees, and investors. The prevailing venture capital framework systematically transfers decision authority away from the individuals responsible for building enterprise value toward those who finance it, often before product validation or market maturity. In response, this paper introduces an A share and B share structure that explicitly separates dilution risk by function. A shares, capped at twenty six percent of total equity, are reserved for active founders and full time employees and carry double voting rights tied to ongoing contribution. B shares, held by investors, retain standard voting and economic rights. Departing employees automatically convert to B share status, ensuring governance remains with those executing the business.

The model embeds staged adoption, allowing founders to introduce the structure upon reaching Series A scale, and includes safeguards for fiduciary alignment, investor rights, and legal defensibility under Delaware law. Key design refinements include a six month grace period for A share conversion, balanced board composition, revenue based sunset provisions, and a ten percent employee participation guarantee at exit. Through illustrative cap table modeling and scenario analysis, the paper demonstrates that this framework preserves investor economics while reducing executional misalignment and founder churn.

By tying governance to operational contribution rather than status, the proposed structure modernizes early stage ownership to reflect the new scarcity of executional capability rather than capital. It offers a practical pathway for founders and long term investors to align growth, control, and value creation within a transparent and legally sound capital stack.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视初创企业资本结构，提出双重股权模型，重新平衡创始人、员工和投资者之间的治理与控制权。传统风投框架将决策权从创造企业价值的人转移到提供资金的人，而新模型通过A股（创始人/员工，双重投票权）和B股（投资者，标准权利）分离稀释风险，将治理权与运营贡献挂钩。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种初创企业资本结构，能够更好地平衡创始人、员工和投资者之间的治理与控制权，将决策权与运营贡献而非资本投入挂钩？
AI.motivation: 传统风险投资框架在初创企业产品验证或市场成熟前，系统性地将决策权从创造企业价值的创始人/员工转移到提供资金的投资者，导致执行错位和创始人流失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、代理理论、资本结构理论、创业融资理论，特别是关于控制权与所有权分离、激励对齐的理论框架。
AI.method: 概念模型设计、说明性资本表建模、情景分析、法律可行性分析（基于特拉华州法律）。
AI.findings: 提出的双重股权结构（A股：创始人/员工，26%上限，双重投票权；B股：投资者）能保护投资者经济利益，同时减少执行错位和创始人流失，将治理权与持续运营贡献挂钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出将治理权与运营贡献而非资本投入挂钩的新理论框架；2）重新概念化早期阶段所有权，反映执行能力而非资本的稀缺性；3）为创业融资中的控制权分配提供新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供可实施的资本结构模板；2）包含阶段性采用、受托责任对齐、投资者权利保护等保障措施；3）包含6个月宽限期、平衡董事会构成、基于收入的日落条款、10%员工参与保证等设计优化；4）为创始人和长期投资者提供透明合法的增长、控制和价值创造对齐路径。

detail.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Amid the COVID-19 pandemic in the Russian Federation, social care providers received incentives such as bonuses and welfare payments. The study examines the association between COVID-19 pandemic indicators and distribution of incentives to care providers in Russia. 

METHODS: To test the hypotheses, regression analysis is employed. RESULTS: Hypothesis H 1, regarding the correlation between the COVID-19 case rate in a specific region of the Russian Federation and the actual monetary amount of bonus payments compensating for challenging working conditions of care workers in that region is supported. Hypotheses H 2-H 3, regarding the relationship between the COVID-19 cases/recovery rate and the monetary amount of special welfare payments to care workers distributed across the country during a given calendar month are also supported. Hypothesis H 4, pertaining to the relationship between the Fiscal Year End and the monetary amount of special welfare payments distributed throughout the country to care providers during a given calendar month, is likewise supported. 

CONCLUSION: There is a correlation between payments to social care providers and coronavirus pandemic indicators (Tab. 5, Ref. 31).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了俄罗斯联邦COVID-19疫情指标与社会护理工作者激励措施分配之间的关联，发现疫情严重程度与奖金和福利支付金额存在显著相关性。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情指标与俄罗斯社会护理工作者激励措施分配之间是否存在关联？
AI.motivation: 在COVID-19疫情期间，俄罗斯政府为护理工作者提供了奖金和福利支付等激励措施，但缺乏对这些激励措施分配与疫情指标之间关系的实证研究。

AI.method: 采用回归分析方法，检验四个假设：H1（地区病例率与奖金支付金额相关）、H2（全国病例率与福利支付金额相关）、H3（康复率与福利支付金额相关）、H4（财政年度结束与福利支付金额相关）。

AI.theory_contributions: 为公共卫生危机期间的人力资源激励政策提供了实证支持，扩展了危机管理与激励理论在护理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了疫情应对期间护理工作者激励措施分配的实证依据，有助于优化未来公共卫生危机中的资源分配策略。

detail.title: The Power and Peril of the ACA's Universality at Fifteen

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a

publicationDetails.detailsText: Boston Univ. School of Law Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Boston University School of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
As part of the symposium "15th Anniversary of the ACA: A Health Equity Review," this essay explores the ACA's mix of private law and public law provisions that rendered measurable improvements in health equity and health outcomes, especially for populations that experienced longstanding health disparities before its enactment.  Congress’s central objective was near-universal health insurance coverage, and the ACA employed a variety of mechanisms to reach that goal. The law’s health equity successes grew from establishing a principle of inclusion across federal statutes. This principle, which I have called “universality,” centered a human right to health approach: No longer would federal law permit exclusion of people who could not pay, or were otherwise deemed undesirable or unworthy of assistance, from health insurance coverage or health care.  The principle of universality was fundamentally a health equity policy that brought the U.S. in line with other wealthy nations; yet, it also has been a source of conflict, driving political fighting over the ACA since the law’s enactment in 2010 and slowing its implementation.

Whereas anyone who needed medical care before 2010 had to be able to pay or could be turned away, the ACA made it so people became eligible for coverage as well as insurable through placing limits on actuarial practices that restricted coverage, eligibility, and benefits.  For political expediency, Congress built on the fragmented U.S. non-system of health care, using the federalism-based governance structures already in place.  The ACA relied heavily on Medicaid, the public health insurance program for low-income individuals, to anchor universal health insurance coverage and operationalize access to care for people who had no other paths to coverage.  The law’s reliance on federal/state partnerships became central to negotiating ACA implementation during the Obama administration, however, federalism also created ongoing barriers to implementation by allowing states to opt out of Medicaid expansion, resist health insurance exchange establishment, and reject other policy partnerships. This made federalism both a strength and a weakness, paradoxically a feature of the ACA that has both served and undermined health equity.

In other words, the ACA’s animating universality principle was powerful, but it did not end the political fights over who gets assistance or which level of government is responsible for that help.  To explore these tensions, Part II provides context, very briefly explaining historical norms of health care exclusion in the U.S. Part III examines the ACA’s greatest health equity tool—Medicaid expansion—and describes three phases of implementation that roughly have corresponded to policy variation, but also historical events, from one presidential administration to the next.  States’ differing paths to ACA implementation illuminate the political fights against the universal coverage goal but also democratic successes along the way.  In Part IV, the essay considers whether the ACA has become a durable statutory foundation for improving health equity, drawing lessons from Medicaid expansion and the health insurance exchanges to tell a broader story about ACA-based coverage leading to improved health in expansion states and ongoing problems (i.e. rural hospital closures) for non-expansion states. Finally, the essay considers new and ongoing challenges, such as the policies in the 2025 H.R.1 Medicaid cuts. Congress employed tools like work reporting requirements to enervate the ACA’s universality by reintroducing concepts of deservingness and creating barriers that will produce sharp decreases in insurance coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了《平价医疗法案》（ACA）如何通过公共与私法结合的方式改善健康公平，特别是通过"普遍性"原则扩大医保覆盖，但联邦制结构既促进了实施也造成了障碍，导致各州实施差异和政治冲突。
AI.research_question: ACA如何通过公共与私法结合的方式改善健康公平？联邦制结构如何既促进又阻碍ACA的实施？"普遍性"原则在实现健康公平中的作用和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: ACA实施15周年之际，需要评估其在改善健康公平方面的成就与挑战，特别是针对历史上存在健康差距的人群。文章旨在分析ACA如何通过法律机制改变美国的医保体系，以及政治和联邦制因素如何影响其效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 普遍性原则（Universality）：作为健康公平的核心政策原则，强调健康作为人权的理念；2. 联邦制理论：分析联邦与州政府关系如何影响政策实施；3. 健康公平框架：关注系统性健康差距的消除；4. 公共与私法结合：分析法律工具如何共同作用实现政策目标。
AI.method: 政策分析法和历史分析法：1. 分析ACA的法律条款和机制；2. 考察Medicaid扩张的三个实施阶段及其政策变化；3. 比较扩张州与非扩张州的实施效果；4. 分析联邦制结构对政策实施的影响。
AI.findings: 1. ACA通过"普遍性"原则显著改善了医保覆盖，特别是通过Medicaid扩张；2. 联邦制结构既是ACA实施的工具也是障碍，允许各州选择是否扩张Medicaid；3. 扩张州在健康结果上有所改善，而非扩张州面临持续问题（如农村医院关闭）；4. 政治冲突持续存在，新的政策（如工作要求）可能削弱ACA的普遍性原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"普遍性"作为健康公平的核心分析框架；2. 深化了对联邦制在医保改革中双重作用的理解；3. 揭示了公共与私法结合在实现社会政策目标中的机制；4. 为理解政策实施中的政治冲突提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供ACA实施的经验教训；2. 指出Medicaid扩张对健康公平的关键作用；3. 警示新政策（如工作要求）可能逆转健康公平进展；4. 为未来医保改革提供基于证据的建议。

title: Words Matter: Forecasting Economic Downside Risks with Corporate Textual Data

detail.title: Words Matter: Forecasting Economic Downside Risks with Corporate Textual Data
detail.abstract: Accurate forecasting of downside risks to economic growth has become critically important for policymakers and financial institutions, particularly following recent economic crises. This paper builds upon the Growth-at-Risk (GaR) approach, introducing a novel daily sentiment indicator derived from textual analysis of mandatory corporate disclosures (SEC 10-K and 10-Q reports) to forecast downside risks to economic growth. Utilizing the Loughran-McDonald dictionary and word-count methodology, I calculate firm-level tone growth by measuring the year-overyear difference between positive and negative sentiment expressed in corporate filings. These firm-specific sentiment metrics are aggregated into a weekly tone index, weighted by firms' market capitalizations to capture broader, economy-wide sentiment dynamics. Integrated into a Mixed Data Sampling (MIDAS) Quantile regression framework, this sentiment-based indicator enhances the prediction of GDP growth downturns, outperforming traditional financial market indicators such as the National Financial Conditions Index (NFCI). The findings underscore corporate textual data as a powerful and timely resource for macroeconomic risk assessment and informed policymaking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于企业强制披露文件（SEC 10-K和10-Q报告）文本分析的新型每日情绪指标，用于预测经济增长的下行风险。该指标通过混合数据抽样（MIDAS）分位数回归框架，显著提升了GDP增长下滑的预测能力，优于传统金融市场指标。
AI.research_question: 如何利用企业强制披露文件的文本情绪信息来更准确地预测经济增长的下行风险？
AI.motivation: 在经济危机频发的背景下，准确预测经济增长的下行风险对政策制定者和金融机构变得至关重要。传统金融市场指标可能存在滞后性，而企业披露文件中的文本信息可能提供更及时、前瞻性的风险信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于增长风险（GaR）方法，结合文本分析和情绪指标构建理论框架。使用Loughran-McDonald词典和词频统计方法量化企业情绪，通过市场价值加权构建宏观情绪指数。
AI.method:
1. 使用Loughran-McDonald词典分析SEC 10-K和10-Q报告的文本情绪
2. 计算企业层面的情绪增长率（年度正负情绪差异）
3. 按市值加权构建每周情绪指数
4. 将情绪指标整合到混合数据抽样（MIDAS）分位数回归框架中
5. 与传统指标（如国家金融状况指数NFCI）进行预测性能比较
AI.findings: 基于企业文本情绪构建的指标显著提升了GDP增长下滑的预测准确性，表现优于传统的金融市场指标（如NFCI）。企业文本数据提供了及时且有效的宏观经济风险评估资源。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将文本分析与企业强制披露文件相结合，扩展了增长风险（GaR）方法的应用范围
2. 提出了基于企业文本情绪的新型宏观经济风险预测框架
3. 验证了企业微观文本信息对宏观经济增长风险的预测价值
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了更及时、准确的经济下行风险预警工具
2. 帮助金融机构改进风险管理策略
3. 展示了企业强制披露文件作为宏观经济监测数据源的实用价值
4. 提供了可操作的情绪指标构建方法，便于实际应用
